                (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapDerivedCategory).obj KB)),
          Triangle.mk f g δ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))

declarations.name: Dualizing.exists_distinguishedTriangle_quotient_nonZeroDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A7T.** Dividing a Noetherian local ring by a nonzerodivisor in
its maximal ideal produces a normalized dualizing complex fitting into the distinguished
triangle induced by multiplication by that element.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_distinguishedTriangle_quotient_nonZeroDivisor
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} K)
    (f : A) (hf : f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hfreg : f ∈ nonZeroDivisors A) :
    letI : Nontrivial (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
      (lt_of_le_of_lt (Ideal.span_le.2 (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hf))
        (inferInstance : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A).IsMaximal).lt_top).ne
    letI : IsLocalRing (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}))
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    ∃ (KB : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}))),
      IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} KB ∧
        ∃ (i : ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}))).mapDerivedCategory).obj KB ⟶ K)
          (δ : K ⟶ (shiftFunctor (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A)) (1 : ℤ)).obj
            (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}))).mapDerivedCategory).obj KB)),
          Triangle.mk i (f • 𝟙 K) δ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))

declarations.name: Dualizing.depth_eq_least_nonzero_negative_ext
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A7U, part (3).** For a nonzero finite module over a
Noetherian local ring, depth is the least nonnegative integer `δ` for which
`Ext^(-δ)(M, ω_A^•)` is nonzero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem depth_eq_least_nonzero_negative_ext
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {M : Type (max v u)}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M]
    (omega : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (homega : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex omega)
    (hM : Nontrivial M) :
    ∃ delta : ℕ,
      IsLeast
          {i : ℕ |
            Nontrivial
              (DerivedCategory.Ext
                ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} A) 0).obj
                  (ModuleCat.of A M))
                omega (-(i : ℤ)))}
          delta ∧
        Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) M = (delta : ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: depth_from_ext

declarations.name: Dualizing.ext_degree_mem_Icc_of_nontrivial
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A7U.** For a nonzero finite module `M` of support dimension `d`,
Ext from `M` into a normalized dualizing complex can be nonzero only in the integer degrees
from `-d` through `0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem ext_degree_mem_Icc_of_nontrivial
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {M : Type (max v u)} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M] [Nontrivial M]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex K)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : Module.supportDim A M = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (i : ℤ)
    (hi : Nontrivial
      (DerivedCategory.Ext
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} A) 0).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A M)) K i)) :
    i ∈ Set.Icc (-(d : ℤ)) 0
declarations.comment: ext_degree_bounds

declarations.name: Dualizing.supportDim_ext_le_neg_degree
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A7U, support bound.** If `K` is a normalized dualizing
complex over a Noetherian local ring `A` and `M` is a nonzero finite `A`-module, then
the support of `Ext^i_A(M, K)` has dimension at most `-i` for every integer `i`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem supportDim_ext_le_neg_degree
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A)) (M : Type (max v u))
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module.Finite A M] [Nontrivial M]
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex K) (i : ℤ) :
    Module.supportDim A
        (DerivedCategory.Ext
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} A) 0).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A M)) K i) ≤
      if i ≤ 0 then (((Int.toNat (-i) : ℕ) : ℕ∞) : WithBot ℕ∞) else ⊥
declarations.comment: ext_support_bound

declarations.name: Dualizing.nontrivial_localized_homology_iff_eq_neg_dimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A7V.** Let `A` be a Noetherian local ring with a normalized dualizing
complex `K`, and let `p` be a minimal prime of `A` with `dim(A/p) = e`. Then the localization at
`p` of the cohomology module `H^i(K)` is nonzero if and only if `i = -e`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nontrivial_localized_homology_iff_eq_neg_dimension
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} K)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (hp : IsMinimalPrime p.asIdeal) (e : ℕ)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (A ⧸ p.asIdeal) = (e : WithBot ℕ∞)) (i : ℤ) :
    Nontrivial (LocalizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} A) i).obj K)) ↔
      i = -(e : ℤ)

declarations.name: Dualizing.dualizingDimension
declarations.doc:
The **dimension function** of a dualizing complex `K` over a Noetherian ring `A`: the value
at a prime `p` is the unique integer `n` for which the localization `K_p`, shifted by `-n`, is a
normalized dualizing complex over `A_p`. The infimum is a device for naming that integer; it is
attained and unique by `Dualizing.dualizingDimension_eq_iff`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def dualizingDimension {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A)) (p : PrimeSpectrum A) : ℤ
declarations.comment: the function δ attached to a dualizing complex over a Noetherian ring

declarations.name: Dualizing.dualizingDimension_eq_iff
declarations.doc:
**The defining property of the dimension function.** A shift of the localization of a
dualizing complex at a prime is normalized exactly when the shift is the value of the dimension
function there.
declarations.statement:
theorem dualizingDimension_eq_iff {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A)) (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A) (n : ℤ) :
    IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v}
        (((StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.derivedExtensionScalars
          (algebraMap A (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).obj K)⟦-n⟧) ↔
      n = dualizingDimension.{u, v} K p
declarations.comment: δ(p) is the unique integer n with K_p⟦-n⟧ normalized over A_p

declarations.name: Dualizing.existsUnique_nontrivial_localized_homology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A7X.** Let `A` be a Noetherian ring with a dualizing complex `K` and
let `p` be a minimal prime of `A`. Then the localization at `p` of the cohomology module `H^i(K)`
is nonzero for exactly one `i`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_nontrivial_localized_homology
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} A)) (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime] (hp : p ∈ minimalPrimes A) :
    ∃! i : ℤ, Nontrivial
      (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} A) i).obj K))

declarations.name: Dualizing.dualizingDimension_derivedHom_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0A7Y.** For a surjection `f : A → B` of Noetherian rings and a dualizing complex
`K` over `A`, the dimension function of the dualizing complex `RHom_A(B, K)` over `B` is the
restriction of the dimension function of `K` along the induced closed immersion
`Spec B → Spec A`.

The hypothesis of
`Dualizing.dualizingDimension_derivedHom_of_surjective_of_localizationComparison` is discharged
here: the localization at `q` of `RHom_A(B, K)` is `RHom_{A_p}(B_q, K_p)`, where `g : A_p → B_q`
is the surjection of local rings induced by `f`. Both sides are computed by one and the same
complex of `B_q`-modules, namely the degreewise localization of the degreewise coextension of
scalars of a bounded complex of injectives representing `K`; the identification of the two
complexes is `Dualizing.coextendExtendScalarsIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dualizingDimension_derivedHom_of_surjective
    (f : A →+* B) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A)) (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    (q : PrimeSpectrum B) :
    dualizingDimension.{u, v} ((derivedHom.{u, v} f).obj K) q
      = dualizingDimension.{u, v} K (PrimeSpectrum.comap f q)

declarations.name: Dualizing.dualizingDimension_eq_succ_of_isImmediateSpecialization
declarations.doc:
The dimension function of a dualizing complex drops by exactly one along an immediate
specialization.
declarations.statement:
theorem dualizingDimension_eq_succ_of_isImmediateSpecialization
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A)) (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    {p q : PrimeSpectrum A} (himm : IsImmediateSpecialization p q) :
    dualizingDimension.{u, v} K p = dualizingDimension.{u, v} K q + 1
declarations.comment: δ(p) = δ(q) + 1 for an immediate specialization p ⤳ q

declarations.name: Dualizing.dualizingDimension_lt_of_specializes
declarations.doc:
The dimension function of a dualizing complex drops strictly along a non-trivial
specialization.
declarations.statement:
theorem dualizingDimension_lt_of_specializes
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A)) (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    {p q : PrimeSpectrum A} (hpq : p ⤳ q) (hne : p ≠ q) :
    dualizingDimension.{u, v} K q < dualizingDimension.{u, v} K p
declarations.comment: δ(q) < δ(p) for a non-trivial specialization p ⤳ q

declarations.name: Dualizing.dualizingDimensionFunction
declarations.doc:
The dimension function `δ_K` of a dualizing complex `K` over a Noetherian ring `A`, as a
dimension function on `Spec A`.
declarations.statement:
def dualizingDimensionFunction {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A)) (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) :
    TopologicalSpace.DimensionFunction (PrimeSpectrum A)
declarations.comment: the function δ of a dualizing complex is a dimension function on Spec A

declarations.name: Dualizing.ringKrullDim_lt_top_of_isDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A80.** A Noetherian ring admitting a dualizing complex has finite
Krull dimension.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_lt_top_of_isDualizingComplex {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)} (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) :
    ringKrullDim A < ⊤
declarations.comment: of finite dimension

declarations.name: Dualizing.isUniversallyCatenary_of_isDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A80.** A Noetherian ring admitting a dualizing complex is universally
catenary: every algebra of finite type over it is catenary.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUniversallyCatenary_of_isDualizingComplex {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)} (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) :
    Ring.IsUniversallyCatenary A
declarations.comment: universally catenary

declarations.name: Dualizing.LocalDuality.exists_isInjectiveHull_homology_zero_localCohomology
declarations.doc:
The degree-zero local cohomology of a normalized dualizing complex at the closed point is an
injective hull of the residue field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isInjectiveHull_homology_zero_localCohomology
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex K) :
    let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
    let hm : m.FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian m
    let L := (derivedPowerTorsionProperty A m hm).ι.obj
      ((localCohomologyFunctor A m hm).obj K)
    let E := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} A) 0).obj L
    ∃ (i : (ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{v} A).obj
          (ModuleCat.of A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) ⟶ E)
        (hi : Mono i),
      @Module.IsInjectiveHull (ModuleCat.{max v u} A) _ _ _ _ _ i hi
declarations.comment: injective hull

declarations.name: Dualizing.LocalDuality.nonempty_localCohomology_iso_single_homology_zero
declarations.doc:
Local cohomology of a normalized dualizing complex at the closed point is its degree-zero
cohomology module placed in degree zero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_localCohomology_iso_single_homology_zero
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hK : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex K) :
    let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A
    let hm : m.FG := IsNoetherian.noetherian m
    let L := (derivedPowerTorsionProperty A m hm).ι.obj
      ((localCohomologyFunctor A m hm).obj K)
    let E := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} A) 0).obj L
    Nonempty (L ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} A) 0).obj E)
declarations.comment: concentration in degree zero

declarations.name: Dualizing.LocalDuality.nonempty_localCohomology_iso_localCohomology
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a Noetherian local ring and let `Z = V(𝔪)`. If `ω` and `ω'` are normalized
dualizing complexes for `A`, then `RΓ_Z(ω) ≅ RΓ_Z(ω')` in `D(A)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_localCohomology_iso_localCohomology
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (ω ω' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} A))
    (hω : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} ω)
    (hω' : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, v} ω') :
    Nonempty
      ((derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
              (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).ι.obj
            ((localCohomologyFunctor A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
              (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).obj ω) ≅
          (derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
              (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).ι.obj
            ((localCohomologyFunctor A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
              (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).obj ω'))
declarations.comment: the realization is independent of the normalized dualizing complex

declarations.name: Dualizing.LocalDuality.injectiveHullUnitsMulEquivUnitsAdicCompletion
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a Noetherian local ring and let `i : κ ⟶ E` present `E` as an injective
hull of the residue field. The units of `End_A(E)` are the units of the `𝔪`-adic completion
`A^∧` of `A`.
declarations.statement:
public def injectiveHullUnitsMulEquivUnitsAdicCompletion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (E : Type u) [AddCommGroup E] [Module A E]
    (i : ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ⟶ ModuleCat.of A E)
    [Mono i] (hi : Module.IsInjectiveHull i) :
    (Module.End A E)ˣ ≃* (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)ˣ
declarations.comment: the automorphism group of an injective hull of the residue field is the units of the completion

declarations.name: Dualizing.IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.nonempty_iso
declarations.doc:
**A normalized dualizing complex over a Noetherian local ring is unique up to isomorphism.**
Two dualizing complexes differ by derived tensor product with an invertible object
([Stacks, Tag 0A7F]); over a local ring such an object is the ring placed in a single degree
([Stacks, Tag 0FNT]), so the two complexes differ by a shift; and the normalization convention of
[Stacks, Tag 0A7M] admits exactly one normalizing shift, so that shift is zero.

This is the uniqueness half of the comparison made in [Stacks, Tag 0A83], whose other side —
uniqueness of an injective hull of the residue field — is [Stacks, Tag 08Y4].
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.nonempty_iso
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {ω ω' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)}
    (hω : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, u} ω)
    (hω' : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, u} ω') :
    Nonempty (ω ≅ ω')
declarations.comment: a normalized dualizing complex is unique up to isomorphism; stated at the ring's own module universe

declarations.name: Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex.autMulEquivUnits
declarations.doc:
**The automorphism group of a dualizing complex is the unit group of the base ring.** Reading
off the units of `Dualizing.IsDualizingComplex.endAlgEquiv`: an automorphism of `ω` in `D(A)` is
multiplication by a unique unit of `A`.

This is the automorphism-group half of the comparison made in [Stacks, Tag 0A83]. The source
states it for a normalized dualizing complex over a Noetherian local ring; no normalization and
no local hypothesis are needed, so the statement here is more general. The other side of the
comparison is `Dualizing.LocalDuality.injectiveHullUnitsMulEquivUnitsAdicCompletion`, where the
automorphism group is instead the units of the `𝔪`-adic completion.
declarations.statement:
public def IsDualizingComplex.autMulEquivUnits
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)} (hω : IsDualizingComplex ω) :
    Aut ω ≃* Aˣ
declarations.comment: the automorphism group of a dualizing complex is the group of units of the base ring; proved for every dualizing complex, not only a normalized one, and stated at the ring's own module universe

registrations.name: exists_isInjectiveHull_homology_zero_localCohomology
registrations.comment: the opening sentence, that `RΓ_Z(ω)` is an injective hull of the residue field: the hull half, read from Stacks 0A82

registrations.name: nonempty_localCohomology_iso_single_homology_zero
registrations.comment: the opening sentence, that `RΓ_Z(ω)` is an injective hull of the residue field placed in degree zero: the concentration half, read from Stacks 0A82

registrations.name: Module.exists_iso_of_isInjectiveHull
registrations.comment: an injective hull of the residue field is unique up to isomorphism; proved for an arbitrary object of an arbitrary abelian category, which is Stacks 08Y4

declarations.name: Dualizing.LocalDuality.nonempty_derivedCompletion_derivedHom_iso_derivedHom_injectiveHull
declarations.doc:
The local duality theorem. Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a Noetherian local ring, let `ω` be a
normalized dualizing complex, let `i : κ ⟶ E` be an injective hull of the residue field, and let
`Z = V(𝔪)`. Then derived `𝔪`-adic completion of `RHom_A(K, ω)` is `RHom_A(RΓ_Z(K), E[0])`, for
every `K` in `D(A)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_derivedCompletion_derivedHom_iso_derivedHom_injectiveHull
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hω : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, u} ω)
    {E : ModuleCat.{u} A}
    (i : (ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{u} A).obj
      (ModuleCat.of A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) ⟶ E)
    [Mono i] (hi : Module.IsInjectiveHull i)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :
    Nonempty
      ((DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A f).obj
          ((derivedHomAdjunction (R := A)).hom.obj (Opposite.op K, ω)) ≅
        (derivedHomAdjunction (R := A)).hom.obj
          (Opposite.op ((derivedPowerTorsionProperty A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
              (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).ι.obj
            ((localCohomologyFunctor A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
              (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).obj K)),
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj E))

declarations.name: Dualizing.LocalDuality.nonempty_localDualityNatIso
declarations.doc:
The local duality theorem, natural in `K`. Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a Noetherian local ring, let
`ω` be a normalized dualizing complex, let `i : κ ⟶ E` be an injective hull of the residue
field, and let `Z = V(𝔪)`. Then derived `𝔪`-adic completion of `RHom_A(-, ω)` is
`RHom_A(RΓ_Z(-), E[0])`, as an isomorphism of contravariant functors on `D(A)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_localDualityNatIso
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A) (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (ω : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A))
    (hω : IsNormalizedDualizingComplex.{u, u} ω)
    {E : ModuleCat.{u} A}
    (i : (ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{u} A).obj
      (ModuleCat.of A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) ⟶ E)
    [Mono i] (hi : Module.IsInjectiveHull i) :
    Nonempty (Dualizing.derivedHomInto A ω ⋙ DerivedCompletion.derivedCompletionFunctor A f ≅
      (Stacks.LocalCohomology.CechFormula.localCohomologyEndofunctor A
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (IsNoetherian.noetherian _)).op ⋙
        Dualizing.derivedHomInto A
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj E))
declarations.comment: natural in K

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isDualizingComplex_iff_exists_affineOpenCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A86.** On a locally Noetherian scheme an object of `D(𝒪_X)` is a
dualizing complex — it carries a dualizing model at every affine open — exactly when it carries
one at the members of a single affine open cover.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDualizingComplex_iff_exists_affineOpenCover {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} :
    IsDualizingComplex K ↔
      ∃ (ι : Type u) (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)),
        (⨆ i, U i = ⊤) ∧ ∀ i, HasDualizingModelOn K (U i) (hU i)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.IsDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A87.** A *dualizing complex* on a locally Noetherian scheme `X` is an
object of `D(𝒪_X)` which, over every affine open `U ⊆ X`, is the associated sheaf of a dualizing
complex over `Γ(X, U)`.

By [Stacks, Tag 0A86] it is enough to check this on the members of a single affine open cover.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsDualizingComplex (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_affineDerivedTildeHomComparison_of_finite_homology
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0A88.** Let `R` be a Noetherian ring and `X = Spec R`. For `K` an object of
`D_Coh(R)` — all of whose cohomology modules are finite, with no boundedness hypothesis — and `L`
an object of `D(R)` of finite injective dimension, the canonical comparison

`(R Hom_R(K, L))~ ⟶ R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(K̃, L̃)`

is an isomorphism, which is the asserted equality of the two objects in `D(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_affineDerivedTildeHomComparison_of_finite_homology (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite R
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj K))
    (hL : StacksDraft.InjectiveDimension.HasFiniteInjectiveDimension L) :
    IsIso (affineDerivedTildeHomComparison R K L)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_affineDerivedTildeHomComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0A88, for a perfect source.** For `X = Spec R` and `K, L` in `D(R)` the
canonical comparison

`R SheafHom_{O_X}(K̃, L̃) ⟶ (R Hom_R(K, L))̃`

is invertible when `K` is perfect, with no hypothesis on `L`. This is the conclusion of Tag 0A88
— that the two objects agree in `D(O_X)` — read for the canonical morphism between them, which
is what `affineDerivedTildeHomComparison_perfect` identifies it as.

The source's hypotheses are `K` in `D_Coh(R)` and `L` of finite injective dimension, over a
Noetherian `R`. The form proved here replaces the condition on `K` by perfectness and drops the
condition on `L` and the Noetherian hypothesis on `R` altogether: the proof is the reduction of
clause (3)(b) of Tag 0A6H to bounded finite-projective sources with K-injective targets, where
both the comparison and the model isomorphism are the same five-fold composite, and that
reduction asks nothing of `L`. Neither hypothesis set contains the other, so this is Tag 0A88 in
the form this development's proof supports rather than in the source's form.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isIso_affineDerivedTildeHomComparison (R : CommRingCat.{u})
    (K L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    (hK : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect K) :
    IsIso (affineDerivedTildeHomComparison R K L)
declarations.comment: proved for K perfect and L arbitrary over any R, rather than for K in D_Coh(R) and L of finite injective dimension over a Noetherian R; the comparison is the canonical morphism, identified as such by affineDerivedTildeHomComparison_perfect

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.dualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A89.** The functor `D = R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(-, K)` of the lemma: derived
internal Hom into `K` as a contravariant functor `D(𝒪_X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ D(𝒪_X)` on a scheme.

As on the affine side (`Dualizing.dualizingDerivedHomFunctor`, which carries the corresponding
fragment of [Stacks, Tag 0A7C]) it is defined for an arbitrary `K`; that `K` be a dualizing
complex is what makes `D` an anti-equivalence of `D_Coh(𝒪_X)`, a separate assertion of the tag,
which is `Stacks.Duality.coherentDualizingDerivedSheafHom_isEquivalence` — see the section
"Where the rest of Tag 0A89 lives" above.
declarations.statement:
def dualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor :
    (DerivedCategory X.Modules)ᵒᵖ ⥤ DerivedCategory X.Modules
declarations.comment: the functor D = R SheafHom(-, K) on D(O_X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.dualizingDerivedSheafHomBiduality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A89.** The canonical morphism `id → D ∘ D` of the lemma, for
`D = R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(-, K)` on a scheme: the natural transformation
`𝟭 ⟶ opOp ⋙ D.op ⋙ D` whose component at `L` is the biduality morphism

`L ⟶ R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(L, K), K)`

of `Stacks.SheafOfModules.derivedSheafHomBidualMap`.

Here the morphism is constructed, for an arbitrary `K`, exactly as `Dualizing.derivedBiduality`
constructs the affine one; that it is an isomorphism at every object of `D_Coh(𝒪_X)` is
`Stacks.Duality.isIso_dualizingDerivedSheafHomBiduality_app`, the counterpart of
`Dualizing.dualizingDerivedHom_biduality_isIso`.
declarations.statement:
def dualizingDerivedSheafHomBiduality :
    Functor.id (DerivedCategory X.Modules) ⟶
      opOp (DerivedCategory X.Modules) ⋙ (dualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor X K).op ⋙
        dualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor X K
declarations.comment: the canonical biduality morphism id → D ∘ D

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_dualizingDerivedSheafHomBiduality_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A89.** The canonical biduality morphism

`L ⟶ R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(L, K), K)`

is an isomorphism, for `K` a dualizing complex on a locally Noetherian scheme `X` and `L` an
object of `D_Coh(𝒪_X)`.

The morphism is the left unitor read backwards, the homothety of `K` whiskered by `L`, and the
derived evaluation morphism of [Stacks, Tag 0A8U] at `(L, K, K)`
(`Stacks.SheafOfModules.isIso_derivedSheafHomBidualMap`). The homothety of a dualizing complex
is invertible (`Stacks.Duality.isIso_derivedSheafHomothety_of_isDualizingComplex`), and the
evaluation morphism is invertible at a source with coherent cohomology sheaves
(`Stacks.Duality.isIso_derivedSheafHomEvaluation_of_isDualizingComplex`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_dualizingDerivedSheafHomBiduality_app [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) (L : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hL : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj L).IsCoherent) :
    IsIso ((dualizingDerivedSheafHomBiduality X K).app L)
declarations.comment: canonical biduality

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.coherentDualizingDerivedSheafHom_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A89.** `D = R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(-, K)` is an anti-equivalence of
`D_Coh(𝒪_X)`, for `K` a dualizing complex on a locally Noetherian scheme `X`: canonical
biduality is a natural isomorphism, and a contravariant functor whose square is naturally
isomorphic to the identity is an equivalence.
declarations.statement:
theorem coherentDualizingDerivedSheafHom_isEquivalence (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) :
    (coherentDualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor X hK).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: the anti-equivalence on coherent objects

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.boundedCoherentDualizingDerivedSheafHom_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A89.** `D = R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(-, K)` is an anti-equivalence of
`D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)`, for `K` a dualizing complex on a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem boundedCoherentDualizingDerivedSheafHom_isEquivalence (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X] {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules}
    (hK : IsDualizingComplex K) :
    (boundedCoherentDualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor X hK).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: the bounded anti-equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.derivedCategoryBMinus_isCoherent_dualizingDerivedSheafHom
declarations.doc:
On a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme, `D = R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(-, K)` carries `D⁺_Coh(𝒪_X)`
into `D⁻_Coh(𝒪_X)`, for `K` a dualizing complex.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryBMinus_isCoherent_dualizingDerivedSheafHom [CompactSpace X]
    {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    (L : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hL : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X) L) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBMinus (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X)
      ((dualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor X K).obj (op L))
declarations.comment: exchange of bounded below and bounded above

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.derivedCategoryBPlus_isCoherent_dualizingDerivedSheafHom
declarations.doc:
On a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme, `D = R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(-, K)` carries `D⁻_Coh(𝒪_X)`
into `D⁺_Coh(𝒪_X)`, for `K` a dualizing complex.

Together with `Stacks.Duality.derivedCategoryBMinus_isCoherent_dualizingDerivedSheafHom` this is
the assertion that `D` **exchanges** the two subcategories.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryBPlus_isCoherent_dualizingDerivedSheafHom [CompactSpace X]
    {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    (L : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hL : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBMinus (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X) L) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X)
      ((dualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor X K).obj (op L))
declarations.comment: exchange of bounded above and bounded below

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.derivedCategoryBBounded_isCoherent_dualizingDerivedSheafHom
declarations.doc:
On a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme, `D = R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(-, K)` carries
`D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)` into itself, for `K` a dualizing complex.

This is the preservation statement, the counterpart of the
`"preservation of bounded coherent objects"` fragment of the affine decomposition of
[Stacks, Tag 0A7C]; it is what makes `D` a functor on `D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)`, and the anti-equivalence
the tag asserts there is
`Stacks.Duality.boundedCoherentDualizingDerivedSheafHom_isEquivalence`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryBBounded_isCoherent_dualizingDerivedSheafHom [CompactSpace X]
    {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    (L : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hL : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBBounded (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X) L) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBBounded (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X)
      ((dualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor X K).obj (op L))
declarations.comment: preservation of bounded coherent objects

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.derivedCategoryB_isCoherent_dualizingDerivedSheafHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A89.** `D = R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(-, K)` carries `D_Coh(𝒪_X)` into
`D_Coh(𝒪_X)`, for `K` a dualizing complex on a locally Noetherian scheme `X`.

This is the second assertion of the lemma, the one the anti-equivalence of `D_Coh(𝒪_X)` is
phrased against. `D_Coh(𝒪_X)` is unbounded: the hypothesis on `L` and the conclusion are both
membership in `DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (Stacks.Duality.isCoherentSheaf X)`, the
`D_B(A)` construction of [Stacks, Tag 06UP] at coherence, which is what
`Stacks.Duality.CoherentDerivedCategory` is the full subcategory on.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCategoryB_isCoherent_dualizingDerivedSheafHom
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    {K : DerivedCategory X.Modules} (hK : IsDualizingComplex K)
    (L : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hL : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X) L) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X)
      ((dualizingDerivedSheafHomFunctor X K).obj (op L))
declarations.comment: preservation of coherent objects

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.mem_coherentDerivedCategory_of_isDualizingComplex
declarations.doc:
A dualizing complex on a locally Noetherian scheme is an object of `D_Coh(𝒪_X)`: every one of
its cohomology sheaves is coherent.
declarations.comment: K is an object of D_Coh(O_X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.coherentDuality_spec
declarations.doc:
Let `K` be a dualizing complex on a locally Noetherian scheme
`X`. Then `K` is an object of `D_Coh(𝒪_X)`, and `D = R𝓗om(-, K)` carries `D_Coh(𝒪_X)` into itself
and induces an anti-equivalence `D : D_Coh(𝒪_X) → D_Coh(𝒪_X)` which comes with the canonical
isomorphism `id → D ∘ D`, the biduality morphisms `L → R𝓗om(R𝓗om(L, K), K)`. If `X` is
quasi-compact, `D` exchanges `D^+_Coh(𝒪_X)` and `D^-_Coh(𝒪_X)` and induces an anti-equivalence
`D^b_Coh(𝒪_X) → D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem coherentDuality_spec :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X) K ∧
    (∀ L : DerivedCategory X.Modules,
      DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X) L →
      DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X)
        (((derivedSheafHom X.sheaf).obj (op L)).obj K)) ∧
    (coherentDuality X hK).IsEquivalence ∧
    IsIso (coherentBiduality X hK) ∧
    (∀ [CompactSpace X],
      (∀ L : DerivedCategory X.Modules,
        DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (A := X.Modules) (isCoherentSheaf X) L →
        (DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow L ↔
          DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedAbove (((derivedSheafHom X.sheaf).obj (op L)).obj K)) ∧
        (DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedAbove L ↔
          DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow (((derivedSheafHom X.sheaf).obj (op L)).obj K))) ∧
      (boundedCoherentDuality X hK).IsEquivalence)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.qcohDerived_smallEtaleDerivedSheafHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0A8A.** Let `X` be an algebraic space and `K`, `L` objects of `D(𝒪_X)`. If either
`L` lies in `D^+_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `K` is pseudo-coherent, or `L` lies in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `K` is
perfect, then `R𝓗om(K, L)` lies in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem qcohDerived_smallEtaleDerivedSheafHom (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (K L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B S hS X)))
    (h : (RingedSite.IsPseudoCoherent (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2) K ∧
        DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus
          (A := SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B S hS X))
          (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
            ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))) L) ∨
      (RingedSite.IsPerfect (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2) K ∧ QcohDerived B S hS X L)) :
    QcohDerived B S hS X (((smallEtaleDerivedSheafHom B S hS X).obj (op K)).obj L)

registrations.comment: the commutation of the right adjoint with the shift

registrations.name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.right_adjoint_additive
registrations.comment: additivity of the right adjoint
