declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_refinementXi
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9K] for the cartesian square of an interior-preserving morphism of
compactifications.**  The base change morphism of that square is the open immersion `j₂` of the
target compactification, so this is
`Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_isOpenImmersion`;
no hypothesis is carried.
declarations.statement:
instance isIso_refinementXi (hg : CompactificationOf.PreservesInterior g) :
    IsIso (refinementXi f g hg)
declarations.comment: for the cartesian square of an interior-preserving morphism of compactifications of a morphism of AlgebraicGeometry.FTS S over a Noetherian base, whose base change morphism is the open immersion of the target compactification. See Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_isOpenImmersion for the scope of the registration and for why the general Tor-independent case is not proved. What this discharges is the instance argument IsIso (Stacks.Duality.refinementXi ..) of Stacks.Duality.refinementBaseChange and of Stacks.Duality.refinementIso; the other instance argument, Stacks 0A9P, is Stacks.Duality.isIso_refinementBaseChangePlus

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_isOpenImmersion
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9K] for a cartesian square whose base change morphism is an open
immersion.**  In the Situation of [Stacks, Tag 0A9J], if `j : V ⟶ Y` is an open immersion — so
flat, and the square is Tor independent — then the transformation
`ξ : Rj'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rj_*` is an isomorphism.

The arguments are the four quasi-coherence conditions of [Stacks, Tag 08D5] and the two
adjointness instances of [Stacks, Tag 0A9E], without which `ξ` does not exist; no further
hypothesis is carried.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_isOpenImmersion
    [(Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f hpushf).IsLeftAdjoint]
    [(Stacks.Duality.quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f' hpushf').IsLeftAdjoint]
    (sq : IsPullback j' f' f j) :
    IsIso (Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange j' f' f j hpushj' hpushf
      hpushf' hpushj sq)
declarations.comment: for a cartesian square of schemes whose base change morphism g is an OPEN IMMERSION, hence flat, hence Tor independent of f: the transformation xi = Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange of the Situation of Stacks 0A9J is invertible, with nothing assumed beyond the quasi-coherence of the cohomology of the four derived direct images (Stacks 08D5) and the existence of the two twisted inverse images (Stacks 0A9E), which is what makes xi exist. The general Tor-independent case is NOT proved: by Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_iff it is equivalent to Stacks 08IB, whose route Stacks 0DJ9 is carried in this repository over three unproved hypotheses (AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeAffineOpenCase, AlgebraicGeometry.BaseChangeMayerVietorisStep, and the localization step) at AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_derivedBaseChangeComp_of_affineCase. Along an open immersion none of that is needed, Stacks 08IB being replaced by Stacks 08FE

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9K].** Let
```
X' --g'--> X
|          |
f'         f
v          v
Y' --g---> Y
```
be a cartesian square of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes (Situation [Stacks, Tag 0A9J]:
all four schemes), and let `a`, `a'` be the right adjoints of `Rf_*`, `Rf'_*` on `D_QCoh`
([Stacks, Tag 0A9E]). If `f` and `g` are Tor independent (for instance if `g` is flat,
`AlgebraicGeometry.torIndependent_of_flat_right`), the transformation
`ξ : Rg'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rg_*` is invertible.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X'] [CompactSpace X]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y'] [CompactSpace Y]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (hTor : TorIndependent f g) :
    IsIso (twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange g' f' f g
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g) sq)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A9L.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of quasi-compact and
quasi-separated schemes and a quasi-compact open `V ⊆ Y`, with `U = f⁻¹(V)`, `j : V ⟶ Y` and
`j' : U ⟶ X` the inclusions, the transformation `(j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*` of functors
`D_QCoh(𝒪_Y) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_U)`, where `a` and `a'` are the right adjoints of `Rf_*` and
`R(f|_U)_*`: the unit of `j^* ⊣ Rj_*`, then the inverse of the isomorphism
`ξ : Rj'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rj_*` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9K], then the counit of `(j')^* ⊣ Rj'_*`.

It is `Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap` for the square
`AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_morphismRestrict`, every argument of which is proved here.
declarations.statement:
def qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap :
    twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f) ⋙
        quasiCoherentDerivedRestrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι) ⟶
      quasiCoherentDerivedRestrict V.ι (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict V.ι) ⋙
        twistedInverseImage (f ∣_ V) (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs _)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.isIso_qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A9L, the criterion.** The transformation
`Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap` is an isomorphism when
evaluated on `K` if and only if `a(K)|_U ⟶ a(Rj_*(K|_V))|_U`, the restriction to `U` of `a`
applied to the unit of `j^* ⊣ Rj_*` at `K`, is an isomorphism: the other two arrows of the
composite are invertible.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_iff
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    IsIso ((qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap f V).app K) ↔
      IsIso ((quasiCoherentDerivedRestrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)).map
        ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).map
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedRestrictAdjunction V.ι
            (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict V.ι)
            (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs _)).unit.app K)))
declarations.comment: the isomorphism criterion: invertible at `K` iff `a(K)|_U ⟶ a(Rj_*(K|_V))|_U` is

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.exists_not_isIso_qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A9M.** There is a finite morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of Noetherian schemes, a
quasi-compact open `V ⊆ Y` and an object `K` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` with coherent cohomology sheaves,
such that the map `(j')^*(a(K)) ⟶ a'(K|_V)` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9L]
(`Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap`) is not an isomorphism.

The witnesses are those of the source, over the field `k = ℚ`: `f : Spec k[x] ⟶ Spec k[x][ε]`
(`Stacks.SquareZeroExt.specProj`), `V = D(x)` (`Stacks.SquareZeroExt.basicOpenX`) and
`K = ⨁ₙ Mₙ[n]` with `Mₙ = k[x][ε]/(ε, xⁿ)` (`Stacks.SquareZeroExt.coefficientSumTilde`). The
same holds over every field, which is
`Stacks.SquareZeroExt.not_isIso_qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_not_isIso_qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app :
    ∃ (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Y) (_ : IsFinite f) (_ : IsNoetherian X) (_ : IsNoetherian Y)
      (V : Y.Opens) (_ : CompactSpace V) (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y),
      (∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor Y.Modules i).obj K.obj).IsCoherent) ∧
        ¬ IsIso ((qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap f V).app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.qcqs_cohomologySupportedOn_iff_isIso_restrictionMap
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9N], part (2), at the source's hypotheses, with nothing carried.** Let
`f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, let `a` be the right
adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, let `V ⊆ Y` be a quasi-compact open with inverse
image `U = f⁻¹(V)`. Then for every `Q ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` supported on `Y ∖ V` the image `a(Q)` is
supported on `X ∖ U` if and only if the comparison of [Stacks, Tag 0A9L] is an isomorphism on all
`K` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem qcqs_cohomologySupportedOn_iff_isIso_restrictionMap :
    (∀ Q : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y,
        Stacks.Cohomology.PushforwardRestriction.CohomologySupportedOn Y.ringCatSheaf
            (Set.range V.ι.base)ᶜ Q.obj →
          Stacks.Cohomology.PushforwardRestriction.CohomologySupportedOn X.ringCatSheaf
            (Set.range (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι.base)ᶜ
            ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
              Q).obj) ↔
      (∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y,
        IsIso ((qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap f V).app K))
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_isIso_iff
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9N].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes,
`a` the right adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, `j : V ⟶ Y` the inclusion of a
quasi-compact open and `j' : U ⟶ X` its base change, with `f' : U ⟶ V` and `a'` the right adjoint
of `Rf'_*`. Then, writing `φ : (j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*` for the map of [Stacks, Tag 0A9L]:
1. `a` carries every `Q ∈ D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` supported on `Y ∖ V` to an object supported on `X ∖ U` if
   and only if `φ` is invertible on `D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`;
2. the same holds with `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` in place of `D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`;
3. if `a` commutes with direct sums, the conditions of (1) imply those of (2).
"Supported on `Y ∖ V`" is "restricts to zero on `V`". The square is an arbitrary cartesian square
along `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_isIso_iff (sq : IsPullback j' f' f j) :
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion j' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq.flip inferInstance
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace V := j.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace U := j'.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    haveI : CompactSpace U := compactSpace_of_isPullback sq
    let a := twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
    let φ := twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap j' f' f j
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j) (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j') sq
    ((∀ Q : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow Q.obj →
        IsZero ((derivedRestrict j).obj Q.obj) → IsZero ((derivedRestrict j').obj (a.obj Q).obj)) ↔
      ∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj →
        IsIso (φ.app K)) ∧
    ((∀ Q : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y,
        IsZero ((derivedRestrict j).obj Q.obj) → IsZero ((derivedRestrict j').obj (a.obj Q).obj)) ↔
      ∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, IsIso (φ.app K)) ∧
    ((∀ α : Type u, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete α) a) →
      (∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj →
        IsIso (φ.app K)) → ∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, IsIso (φ.app K))

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.qcqs_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_isIso_iff
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, `a` the right adjoint
of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, `j : V ⟶ Y` the inclusion of a quasi-compact open and
`j' : U ⟶ X` its base change, with `f' : U ⟶ V` and `a'` the right adjoint of `Rf'_*`. The
transformation `ξ : Rj'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rj_*` is invertible by [Stacks, Tag 0A9K] (`j` is flat, so Tor
independent from `f`). Writing `φ : (j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*` for the map of [Stacks, Tag 0A9L]:
1. `a` carries every `Q ∈ D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` supported on `Y ∖ V` to an object supported on `X ∖ U` if
   and only if `φ` is invertible on `D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`;
2. the same holds with `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` in place of `D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`;
3. if `a` commutes with direct sums, the conditions of (1) imply those of (2).
"Supported on `Y ∖ V`" is "restricts to zero on `V`".
declarations.statement:
theorem qcqs_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_isIso_iff (sq : IsPullback j' f' f j) :
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion j' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq.flip inferInstance
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace V := j.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace U := j'.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    haveI : CompactSpace U := compactSpace_of_isPullback sq
    haveI : IsIso (twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange j' f' f j
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j) sq) :=

      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j) (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j') sq
    ((∀ Q : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow Q.obj →
        IsZero ((derivedRestrict j).obj Q.obj) → IsZero ((derivedRestrict j').obj (a.obj Q).obj)) ↔
      ∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj →
        IsIso (φ.app K)) ∧
    ((∀ Q : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y,
        IsZero ((derivedRestrict j).obj Q.obj) → IsZero ((derivedRestrict j').obj (a.obj Q).obj)) ↔
      ∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, IsIso (φ.app K)) ∧
    ((∀ α : Type u, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete α) a) →
      (∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj →
        IsIso (φ.app K)) → ∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, IsIso (φ.app K))

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_flat
declarations.doc:
Let `Y` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, `f : X ⟶ Y` a proper, flat morphism of
finite presentation, and `j : V ⟶ Y` a quasi-compact open immersion with base change
`j' : U ⟶ X`. The map `(j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9L] is invertible on
`D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_flat (sq : IsPullback j' f' f j)
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) (hK : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj) :
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion j' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq.flip inferInstance
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : CompactSpace V := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace j
    haveI : CompactSpace U := compactSpace_of_isPullback sq
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace V := j.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace U := j'.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    IsIso ((twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap j' f' f j
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j) (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j')
      sq).app K)
declarations.comment: (1): f flat and of finite presentation

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9P] (2).** Let `Y` be Noetherian, `f : X ⟶ Y` proper and `j : V ⟶ Y` an open
immersion with base change `j' : U ⟶ X`. The map `(j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9L]
is invertible on `D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. Part (1) is
`Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_flat`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_isProper (sq : IsPullback j' f' f j)
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) (hK : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj) :
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion j' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq.flip inferInstance
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_isProper f
    haveI : IsProper f' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq inferInstance
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion j
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_isProper f'
    IsIso ((twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap j' f' f j
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j) (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j')
      sq).app K)
declarations.comment: (2): Y Noetherian

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.restrictionSupport_and_isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9P] (1).** Let `Y` be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme, `f : X ⟶ Y` a
proper, flat morphism of finite presentation, `j : V ⟶ Y` the inclusion of a quasi-compact open and
`j' : U ⟶ X` its base change, with `f' : U ⟶ V`; let `a`, `a'` be the right adjoints of `Rf_*`,
`Rf'_*` on `D_QCoh`. With `ξ : Rj'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rj_*` invertible by [Stacks, Tag 0A9K], the
equivalent conditions of [Stacks, Tag 0A9N] (1) hold: `a` carries every `Q ∈ D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`
supported on `Y ∖ V` to an object supported on `X ∖ U`, and the map `φ : (j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*`
of [Stacks, Tag 0A9L] is invertible on `D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionSupport_and_isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_of_flat
    (sq : IsPullback j' f' f j) :
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion j' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq.flip inferInstance
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : CompactSpace U := compactSpace_of_isPullback sq
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace V := j.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace U := j'.isOpenEmbedding.quasiSeparatedSpace
    haveI : IsIso (twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange j' f' f j
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j) sq) :=
      isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent sq
        (torIndependent_of_flat_right f j)
    let a := twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
    let φ := twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap j' f' f j
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j) (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j') sq
    (∀ Q : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow Q.obj →
        IsZero ((derivedRestrict j).obj Q.obj) → IsZero ((derivedRestrict j').obj (a.obj Q).obj)) ∧
      ∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj →
        IsIso (φ.app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.restrictionSupport_and_isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_of_isNoetherian
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9P] (2).** Let `Y` be a Noetherian scheme, `f : X ⟶ Y` a proper morphism,
`j : V ⟶ Y` the inclusion of an open (quasi-compact, as `Y` is Noetherian) and `j' : U ⟶ X` its
base change, with `f' : U ⟶ V`; let `a`, `a'` be the right adjoints of `Rf_*`, `Rf'_*` on
`D_QCoh`. With `ξ : Rj'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rj_*` invertible by [Stacks, Tag 0A9K], the equivalent
conditions of [Stacks, Tag 0A9N] (1) hold: `a` carries every `Q ∈ D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` supported on
`Y ∖ V` to an object supported on `X ∖ U`, and the map `φ : (j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*` of
[Stacks, Tag 0A9L] is invertible on `D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictionSupport_and_isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_of_isNoetherian
    (sq : IsPullback j' f' f j) :
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion j' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq.flip inferInstance
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_isProper f
    haveI : IsProper f' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq inferInstance
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion j
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_isProper f'
    haveI : IsIso (twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange j' f' f j
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j) sq) :=
      isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent sq
        (torIndependent_of_flat_right f j)
    let a := twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
    let φ := twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap j' f' f j
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j) (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j') sq
    (∀ Q : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow Q.obj →
        IsZero ((derivedRestrict j).obj Q.obj) → IsZero ((derivedRestrict j').obj (a.obj Q).obj)) ∧
      ∀ K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y, DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj →
        IsIso (φ.app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_coherator_map_sheafyTrace_of_qcqs
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9Q].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated
schemes, let `a = f^×` be the right adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`
([Stacks, Tag 0A9E]), and let `DQ_Y : D(𝒪_Y) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` be the coherator, the right adjoint
of the inclusion ([Stacks, Tag 0CR0]). For `L` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `K` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` the map
of [Stacks, Tag 0B6H]

`Rf_*R𝓗om_{𝒪_X}(L, a(K)) ⟶ R𝓗om_{𝒪_Y}(Rf_*L, K)`

becomes an isomorphism after applying `DQ_Y`. The trace map is built, as in the source, from the
tensor–internal-Hom adjunctions of [Stacks, Tag 08J8] on `X` and on `Y`,
`Stacks.Cohomology.ProjectionFormulaInternalHomOnRingedTopoi.derivedTensorHomAdjunction`.

The source's argument: the reduction to morphisms out of the quasi-coherent objects,
`Stacks.Duality.isIso_coherator_map_of_bijective`, and the chain of five bijections,
`Stacks.Duality.bijective_comp_sheafyTrace`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_coherator_map_sheafyTrace_of_qcqs
    (L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X) (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    IsIso ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (A := Y.Modules)
        (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent Y.ringCatSheaf)).ι.rightAdjoint.map
      (sheafyTrace f
        (derivedTensorHomAdjunction (Stacks.SheafOfModules.ringedSite X.sheaf))
        (derivedTensorHomAdjunction (Stacks.SheafOfModules.ringedSite Y.sheaf))
        (StandardModel.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward f)
        (twistedInverseImageAdjunction f
          (StandardModel.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward f)) L K))

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.preservesColimitsOfShape_rightAdjoint_quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect proper morphism of Noetherian schemes and let `a` be a right
adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. Then `a` commutes with direct sums.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesColimitsOfShape_rightAdjoint_quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsNoetherian Y] [Perfect f] [IsProper f]
    {a : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y ⥤ quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X}
    (adj : quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f) ⊣ a) (J : Type u) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J) a

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.preservesColimitsOfShape_twistedInverseImage
declarations.doc:
For a perfect proper morphism of Noetherian schemes `f : X ⟶ Y`, the twisted inverse image
`f^× : D_QCoh(𝒪_Y) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, the right adjoint `twistedInverseImage f` of `Rf_*`, commutes
with direct sums.
declarations.statement:
instance preservesColimitsOfShape_twistedInverseImage [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [Perfect f] [IsProper f] (J : Type u) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J)
      (twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f))

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.preservesCoproducts_twistedInverseImage_of_perfect_proper
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9R].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect proper morphism of Noetherian schemes.
The twisted inverse image `a = f^×`, the right adjoint of
`Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` ([Stacks, Tag 0A9E]), commutes with direct sums: it
preserves coproducts indexed by every `J : Type u`, the universe of the schemes, which is the
universe of the hom-sets of `D_QCoh` and the one at which it has all direct sums.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesCoproducts_twistedInverseImage_of_perfect_proper (J : Type u) :
    PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete J)
      (twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f))
declarations.comment: a = f^× commutes with direct sums indexed by every type J in the universe of X and Y, the universe of the hom-sets of D_QCoh

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.compareWithPullbackTensor
declarations.doc:
**The two-variable comparison map of Equation 48.8.0.1 of [Stacks, Tag 0A9S]**:
`Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(L) ⟶ a(K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} L)`, for a right adjoint `a` of
`Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. It is the map adjoint to the inverse of the projection
formula `Rf_*(Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(L)) ≅ K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} Rf_*(a(L))` followed by the identity of `K`
tensored with the trace map `adj.counit.app L : Rf_*(a(L)) ⟶ L`.
declarations.statement:
def compareWithPullbackTensor (K L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj K)).obj (a.obj L) ⟶
      a.obj (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K).obj L)
declarations.comment: variant: the two-variable map for an arbitrary cotensorator α and right adjoint a; the tag is Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.homEquiv_symm_compareWithPullbackTensor
declarations.doc:
**The adjunction characterization of the comparison map.** Its adjoint transpose is the
inverse projection formula followed by the identity of `K` tensored with the trace map; this
determines the comparison map uniquely.
declarations.statement:
theorem homEquiv_symm_compareWithPullbackTensor (K L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm (compareWithPullbackTensor f hpush α adj K L) =
      inv (projectionFormulaMap f hpush α (a.obj L) K) ≫
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K).map (adj.counit.app L)
declarations.comment: variant: the adjunction characterization of the two-variable map for an arbitrary α and a; the tag is Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.projectionFormulaMap_comp_map_compareWithPullbackTensor_comp_counit
declarations.doc:
**Equation 48.8.0.1 as the source states it**: the projection formula, followed by `Rf_*` of
the comparison map and the trace map, is the identity of `K` tensored with the trace map. This is
the characterization with no inverse in it.
declarations.statement:
theorem projectionFormulaMap_comp_map_compareWithPullbackTensor_comp_counit
    (K L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    projectionFormulaMap f hpush α (a.obj L) K ≫
        (quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward f hpush).map
            (compareWithPullbackTensor f hpush α adj K L) ≫
          adj.counit.app (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K).obj L) =
      ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K).map (adj.counit.app L)
declarations.comment: variant: the characterization without the inverse for an arbitrary α and a; the tag is Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.compareWithPullbackTensor_naturality
declarations.doc: The comparison map is natural in `K` and `L` jointly.
declarations.statement:
theorem compareWithPullbackTensor_naturality {K K' L L' : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y}
    (h : K ⟶ K') (g : L ⟶ L') :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).map
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).map h)).app (a.obj L) ≫
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj
            ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj K')).map (a.map g) ≫
          compareWithPullbackTensor f hpush α adj K' L' =
      compareWithPullbackTensor f hpush α adj K L ≫
        a.map (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).map h).app L ≫
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K').map g)
declarations.comment: variant: naturality of the two-variable map for an arbitrary α and a; the tag is Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullbackTensor
declarations.doc:
**Equation 48.8.0.1 for the twisted inverse image `f^×`** of
`Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImage`: the comparison map
`Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} f^×L ⟶ f^×(K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} L)`, obtained from `compareWithPullbackTensor` at the
adjunction `Rf_* ⊣ f^×`.
declarations.statement:
def twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullbackTensor (K L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj K)).obj
        ((twistedInverseImage f hpush).obj L) ⟶
      (twistedInverseImage f hpush).obj (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K).obj L)
declarations.comment: variant: the two-variable map at a = f^× for an arbitrary α; the tag is Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullbackTensor
declarations.doc:
**The two-variable map of [Stacks, Tag 0A9S]** for a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of quasi-compact
quasi-separated schemes: `Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(L) ⟶ a(K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} L)`, where `a = f^×` is the right
adjoint of `Rf_*` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9E]. It is adjoint to the inverse of the projection formula
`Rf_*(Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ a(L)) ≅ K ⊗ᴸ Rf_*(a(L))` of [Stacks, Tag 08EU] followed by the identity of `K`
tensored with the trace map `Rf_*a(L) ⟶ L`.
declarations.statement:
def qcqsCompareWithPullbackTensor (K L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj K)).obj
        ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj L) ⟶
      (twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
        (((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K).obj L)
declarations.comment: the two-variable map Lf^*K ⊗ a(L) ⟶ a(K ⊗ L) from which the source obtains the equation, for a morphism of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes and a = f^× of Tag 0A9E

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.homEquiv_symm_qcqsCompareWithPullbackTensor
declarations.doc:
**The defining property of the two-variable map**: its adjoint transpose for `Rf_* ⊣ a` is
the inverse of the projection-formula isomorphism followed by the identity of `K` tensored with
the trace map `Rf_*a(L) ⟶ L`. This determines the map uniquely.
declarations.statement:
theorem homEquiv_symm_qcqsCompareWithPullbackTensor (K L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    ((twistedInverseImageAdjunction f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        (qcqsCompareWithPullbackTensor f K L) =
      inv (projectionFormulaMap f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (pullbackCotensorator f)
          ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj L)
          K) ≫
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K).map
          ((twistedInverseImageAdjunction f
            (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).counit.app L)
declarations.comment: defining property of the two-variable map: its adjoint is the inverse projection formula of Tag 08EU followed by K tensored with the trace map

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullback
declarations.doc:
**Equation 48.8.0.1 of [Stacks, Tag 0A9S].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes and let `a = f^×` be the right adjoint of
`Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9E]. The canonical map

  `Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)`,

functorial in `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`: the two-variable map `qcqsCompareWithPullbackTensor` at
`L = 𝒪_Y`, followed by `a` of the right unitor `K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} 𝒪_Y ≅ K`.
declarations.statement:
def qcqsCompareWithPullback :
    quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f ⋙
        (quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).flip.obj
          ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ⟶
      twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.homEquiv_symm_qcqsCompareWithPullback_app
declarations.doc:
**The defining property of Equation 48.8.0.1**: the adjoint transpose of
`Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)` for `Rf_* ⊣ a` is the inverse of the projection formula
`Rf_*(Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ a(𝒪_Y)) ≅ K ⊗ᴸ Rf_*a(𝒪_Y)`, followed by the identity of `K` tensored with the
trace map `Rf_*a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ 𝒪_Y` and the right unitor `K ⊗ᴸ 𝒪_Y ≅ K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem homEquiv_symm_qcqsCompareWithPullback_app (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    ((twistedInverseImageAdjunction f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((qcqsCompareWithPullback f).app K) =
      inv (projectionFormulaMap f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (pullbackCotensorator f)
          ((twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj
            (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) K) ≫
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).obj K).map
          ((twistedInverseImageAdjunction f
            (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).counit.app
            (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ≫
          quasiCoherentRightUnitor.hom.app K
declarations.comment: defining property of the map: its adjoint is the inverse projection formula of Tag 08EU, then K tensored with the trace map, then the unitor

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.commShift_qcqsCompareWithPullback
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9S]: Equation 48.8.0.1 is compatible with distinguished triangles.** For a
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, the map
`Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)` commutes with the shift, `Lf^*` carrying its commutation with
the shift as the left adjoint of `Rf_*` and `a` its commutation as the right adjoint of `Rf_*`.
Its source and target are exact functors (`isTriangulated_qcqsCompareWithPullback_source`,
`isTriangulated_qcqsTwistedInverseImage`), so it is a morphism of exact functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem commShift_qcqsCompareWithPullback :
    letI := commShift_quasiCoherentDerivedPullback f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
    letI := (twistedInverseImageAdjunction f
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).rightAdjointCommShift ℤ
    NatTrans.CommShift (qcqsCompareWithPullback f) ℤ
declarations.comment: compatible with distinguished triangles: the map of 48.8.0.1 commutes with the shift, between exact functors

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.compareWithPullback
declarations.doc:
**Equation 48.8.0.1 of [Stacks, Tag 0A9S]**: the comparison map
`Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)`, the two-variable comparison map at `L = 𝒪_Y` followed by `a`
applied to the right unitor `K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} 𝒪_Y ≅ K`.
declarations.statement:
def compareWithPullback (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj K)).obj
        (a.obj (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ⟶
      a.obj K
declarations.comment: variant: the map for an arbitrary cotensorator α, right adjoint a and unitor ρ; the tag is Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.compareWithPullback_naturality
declarations.doc: Equation 48.8.0.1 is functorial in `K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem compareWithPullback_naturality {K K' : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y} (h : K ⟶ K') :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).map
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).map h)).app
          (a.obj (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ≫
        compareWithPullback f hpush α adj ρ K' =
      compareWithPullback f hpush α adj ρ K ≫ a.map h
declarations.comment: variant: functoriality in K for an arbitrary α, a and ρ; the tag is Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback
declarations.doc:
**Equation 48.8.0.1 for the twisted inverse image `f^×`** of
`Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImage`: the comparison map `Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} f^×𝒪_Y ⟶ f^×K` of
[Stacks, Tag 0A9S].
declarations.statement:
def twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback
    (ρ : (quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).flip.obj (derivedStructureSheaf Y) ≅ 𝟭 _)
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    ((quasiCoherentDerivedTensor X).obj
        ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' f).obj K)).obj
        ((twistedInverseImage f hpush).obj (derivedStructureSheaf Y)) ⟶
      (twistedInverseImage f hpush).obj K
declarations.comment: variant: the map at a = f^× for an arbitrary α and ρ; the tag is Stacks.Duality.qcqsCompareWithPullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_compareWithPullbackTensor_and_compareWithPullback_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9T] (Lemma 48.8.1).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-compact and
quasi-separated morphism of schemes with `Y` quasi-compact (for instance a morphism of
quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes), and let `a` be a right adjoint of
`Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. If `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` is perfect, then

* the map `Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(L) ⟶ a(K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_Y} L)` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9S] is an isomorphism for
  every `L ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, and
* in particular Equation 48.8.0.1, `Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)`, is an isomorphism, for any
  identification `ρ` of `- ⊗ᴸ 𝒪_Y` with the identity (such as the right unitor).
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_compareWithPullbackTensor_and_compareWithPullback_of_isPerfect
    {K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y}
    (hK : Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := Y.toRingedSpace) K.obj) :
    (∀ L : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y,
      IsIso (compareWithPullbackTensor f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
        (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom adj K L)) ∧
    ∀ ρ : (quasiCoherentDerivedTensor Y).flip.obj (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf Y) ≅
        𝟭 _,
      IsIso (compareWithPullback f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
        (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom adj ρ K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_of_perfect_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A9U (Lemma 48.13.3).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect proper morphism of
Noetherian schemes. The map `Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9S] is an
isomorphism for every object `K` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback_of_perfect_of_isProper
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    IsIso (twistedInverseImageCompareWithPullback f
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (quasiCoherentDerivedPullbackTensorIso f).hom
      (quasiCoherentDerivedTensorRightUnitor Y) K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_compareWithPullback_twistedInverseImage
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect proper morphism of Noetherian schemes and
let `a = f^×` be the right adjoint of `Rf_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` ([Stacks, Tag 0A9E]).
The map `Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ_{𝒪_X} a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a(K)` of Equation 48.8.0.1 ([Stacks, Tag 0A9S]) is an
isomorphism for every object `K` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.

The same holds at any right adjoint of `Rf_*`, by
`Stacks.Duality.isIso_compareWithPullback_of_perfect_of_isProper`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_compareWithPullback_twistedInverseImage [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [IsProper f] [AlgebraicGeometry.Perfect f] (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    IsIso (compareWithPullback f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (pullbackCotensorator f)
      (twistedInverseImageAdjunction f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f))
      quasiCoherentRightUnitor K)
declarations.comment: complete: X, Y Noetherian, f perfect and proper, every K in D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ExampleGenerator.twist_mem_gen_of_le
declarations.doc: Each of the `n + 1` displayed twists is a direct summand of `E`, hence lies in `⟨E⟩`.
declarations.statement:
theorem twist_mem_gen_of_le (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    twist A n (-(i : ℤ)) ∈ gen (twistSum A n)
declarations.comment: each of the twists O, O(-1), …, O(-n) lies in the subcategory generated by E

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ExampleGenerator.twist_neg_mem_gen
declarations.doc:
**Every twist `𝒪_X(-m)`, `m ≥ 0`, lies in `⟨E⟩`.** For `X = P^n_A` and
`E = 𝒪_X ⊕ 𝒪_X(-1) ⊕ ⋯ ⊕ 𝒪_X(-n)`, every twist `𝒪_X(-m)` with `m ≥ 0` lies in the subcategory
`⟨E⟩` of [Stacks, Tag 09SI] generated by `E`.

Strong induction on `m`. For `m ≤ n` the twist is a direct summand of `E`. For `m ≥ n + 1` the
one-step descent `twist_mem_gen_of_shift_mem_gen` at `a = -m` reduces the claim to the twists
`𝒪_X(-m+p)` for `1 ≤ p ≤ n + 1`, and `-m + p = -(m - p)` with `m - p < m`.
declarations.statement: theorem twist_neg_mem_gen (m : ℕ) : twist A n (-(m : ℤ)) ∈ gen (twistSum A n)
declarations.comment: the subcategory generated by E contains every twist O(-m), m ≥ 0

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ExampleGenerator.isWeakTriangulatedGenerator_twistSumDerivedQCoh
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a ring and `X = P^n_A`. Then `E = 𝒪_X ⊕ 𝒪_X(-1) ⊕ ⋯ ⊕ 𝒪_X(-n)` is a generator
of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` in the sense of [Stacks, Tag 09SJ]: every object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` receiving
only zero maps from the shifts of `E` is zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeakTriangulatedGenerator_twistSumDerivedQCoh :
    (ObjectProperty.singleton (twistSumDerivedQCoh A n)).IsWeakTriangulatedGenerator

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ExampleGenerator.isWeakTriangulatedGenerator_twistSumQCoh
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9V] on `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.** For `X = P^n_A` the object
`E = 𝒪_X ⊕ 𝒪_X(-1) ⊕ ⋯ ⊕ 𝒪_X(-n)` in degree zero is a weak generator of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.

An object `K` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` receiving only zero morphisms from the shifts of `E` receives
only zero morphisms from every object of `⟨E⟩` ([Stacks, Tag 09SK]), hence from every
`𝒪_X(-m)[-p]` with `m ≥ 0` — that is the generation step
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ExampleGenerator.twist_neg_mem_gen`. Those twists are enough to force
`K = 0` by `Stacks.AmpleNonvanishing.isZero_of_hom_single_eq_zero`, whose presentation
hypothesis is `exists_epi_coproduct_twist_nonpos`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeakTriangulatedGenerator_twistSumQCoh :
    (ObjectProperty.singleton (twistSumQCoh A n)).IsWeakTriangulatedGenerator
declarations.comment: the generator conclusion of Definition 09SJ(3) for D_QCoh(O_X), with no hypothesis beyond the tag's. The generation step on the whole of D(O_X) is Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ExampleGenerator.twist_neg_mem_gen

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.ProjectiveBundleDualizing.nonempty_dualizingObject_iso_twistedInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9W].** Let `S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, `ℰ` a finite
locally free `𝒪_S`-module of rank `n + 1` with determinant `𝓛 = ⋀ⁿ⁺¹ ℰ`, `π : 𝐏(ℰ) ⟶ S` the
projection and `a` the right adjoint of `R π_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_{𝐏(ℰ)}) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_S)` of
[Stacks, Tag 0A9E]. Then `π^*𝓛(-n-1)[n] ≅ a(𝒪_S)`, for every `n ≥ 0`; the isomorphism is the
transpose `dualizingComparison` of the trace `R π_*(π^*𝓛(-n-1)[n]) ≅ 𝒪_S`.

For `ℰ = 𝒪_S^{⊕ n+1}` and projective space in the model `projectiveSpaceOver`, the statement
`a(𝒪_S) ≅ 𝒪(-n-1)[n]` is
`Stacks.Duality.ProjectiveSpace.nonempty_twistedInverseImage_derivedStructureSheaf_iso_of_qcqs`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_dualizingObject_iso_twistedInverseImage :
    haveI := quasiCompact_proj E hqc hfree
    haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.isLeftAdjoint_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward (proj E hqc)
    Nonempty (dualizingObject E hqc D hfree ≅ (twistedInverseImage (proj E hqc)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (proj E hqc))).obj
        (DerivedPushforward.derivedStructureSheaf S))
declarations.comment: the projective bundle P(E) is the relative Proj of Sym(E) with twists O(d) of a twist datum D, and f^*L(-n-1) is written O(-n-1) ⊗ π^*(∧^(n+1) E); the special case E = O^(n+1) on projectiveSpaceOver is nonempty_twistedInverseImage_derivedStructureSheaf_iso_of_qcqs

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isDerivedSheafHomRightAdjoint_twistedInverseImage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A9X (Lemma 48.9.7), with the right adjoint produced.** Let
`i : Z ⟶ W` be a closed immersion into a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme. Then the
twisted inverse image `i^×` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9E] — the right adjoint of
`Ri_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_Z) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_W)` that Brown representability produces — agrees on
bounded-below complexes with derived sheaf Hom out of the structure sheaf of the closed
subscheme: `i^×(K) = R𝓗om_{𝒪_W}(𝒪_Z, K)` for `K` in `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_W)`.

This is `Stacks.Duality.isDerivedSheafHomRightAdjointAtModel_of_pseudoCoherent` fed with the
[Stacks, Tag 0A9E] adjunction
`AlgebraicGeometry.isLeftAdjoint_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward`, which is available only
at the locally small derived category of [Stacks, Tag 079Q] — the model in force here. The
hypotheses are the tag's own: quasi-compactness of `W` and pseudo-coherence of `i`. The
quasi-separatedness the source also asks of `W` is not needed, the morphism `i` being
quasi-compact and quasi-separated for free.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedSheafHomRightAdjoint_twistedInverseImage (hpc : PseudoCoherent i) :
    letI := AlgebraicGeometry.isLeftAdjoint_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward i
    IsDerivedSheafHomRightAdjointAtModel i
      (twistedInverseImage i (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs i))
declarations.comment: with the right adjoint a produced rather than assumed: a is the twisted inverse image of Tag 0A9E, which exists at the locally small derived category of Tag 079Q and at no other model, Brown representability needing the direct sums indexed by the morphism universe. The hypotheses are the tag's own, quasi-compactness of the target and pseudo-coherence of the immersion; the quasi-separatedness the source also asks of the target is not needed, being automatic for the closed immersion itself, which is what Tag 0A9E consumes. Nothing is carried

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isDerivedSheafHomRightAdjoint_twistedInverseImage_of_noetherian
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0A9X] for a closed immersion into a quasi-compact locally Noetherian
scheme**, the parenthetical case of the tag: pseudo-coherence is then automatic by
[Stacks, Tag 0684], so the hypothesis is the Noetherian one and nothing about the immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedSheafHomRightAdjoint_twistedInverseImage_of_noetherian
    [IsLocallyNoetherian W] :
    letI := AlgebraicGeometry.isLeftAdjoint_qcqsQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward i
    IsDerivedSheafHomRightAdjointAtModel i
      (twistedInverseImage i (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs i))
declarations.comment: with the right adjoint a produced rather than assumed, for a closed immersion into a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme: pseudo-coherence of i is then automatic by Tag 0684, which is the parenthetical case of the tag. Nothing is carried

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.LocallySmall.isDerivedSheafHomRightAdjoint_of_isClosedImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A9X (Lemma 48.9.7).** Let `i : Z ⟶ W` be a pseudo-coherent closed
immersion of schemes and let `a : D_QCoh(𝒪_W) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Z)` be the right adjoint of
`Ri_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_Z) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_W)`. Then there is a functorial isomorphism
`a(K) ≅ R𝓗om_{𝒪_W}(𝒪_Z, K)` for `K` in `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_W)`.

Here `Ri_*` is the canonical restriction
`Stacks.Duality.LocallySmall.affineHomQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward` of the total derived
direct image to `D_QCoh`: that `Ri_*` carries `D_QCoh(𝒪_Z)` into `D_QCoh(𝒪_W)` is proved
(part (1) of [Stacks, Tag 08D5] for the affine morphism `i`,
`Stacks.Duality.LocallySmall.isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_isAffineHom`), not
assumed. The right adjoint is quantified over together with its adjunction, which determines it
up to unique isomorphism. The derived categories are the locally small models
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.hasDerivedCategory`, at which the right adjoint exists
([Stacks, Tag 0A9E]).

The quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of `W` are dropped: the source uses them only to
produce `a`, and the proof is uniqueness of adjoints against `R𝓗om(𝒪_Z, -)`, the right adjoint of
`Ri_*` on all of `D(𝒪_W)` ([Stacks, Tag 0A76]) which maps `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_W)` into `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Z)`
([Stacks, Tag 0A78]).
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedSheafHomRightAdjoint_of_isClosedImmersion (hpc : PseudoCoherent i)
    (a : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory W ⥤ quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Z)
    (adj : affineHomQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward i ⊣ a) :
    IsDerivedSheafHomRightAdjoint i a
declarations.comment: at the locally small derived categories, the model at which the right adjoint a of Ri_* exists (Tag 0A9E); the quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of X are dropped, the source using them only to produce a

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isDerivedSheafHomRightAdjointAtModel_of_pseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A9X (Lemma 48.9.7).** Let `i : Z ⟶ W` be a pseudo-coherent closed
immersion of schemes and let `a` be a right adjoint of `Ri_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_Z) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_W)`. Then
on bounded-below complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology `a` is derived sheaf Hom out of the
structure sheaf of the closed subscheme: `a(K) = R𝓗om_{𝒪_W}(𝒪_Z, K)` for `K` in
`D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_W)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedSheafHomRightAdjointAtModel_of_pseudoCoherent
    (hpc : PseudoCoherent i)
    (hpush : ∀ (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Z) (n : ℤ),
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor W.Modules n).obj
        ((derivedPushforward i).obj K.obj)).IsQuasicoherent)
    (a : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory W ⥤ quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Z)
    (adj : quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward i hpush ⊣ a) :
    IsDerivedSheafHomRightAdjointAtModel i a
declarations.comment: the quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of the target are dropped, the source using them only to produce the right adjoint a, which here is an explicit parameter together with its adjunction

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.upperShriek
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0A9Y.** The upper shriek functor of a compactification. Let `S` be a
quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme (in the source, a Noetherian one), let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a
morphism of schemes separated and of finite type over `S` and let `j` be a compactification of
`X` over `Y`, with open immersion `j.immersion : X ⟶ X̄` and proper structure morphism
`f̄ = j.toBase : X̄ ⟶ Y`. Let `ā` be the right adjoint of `Rf̄_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X̄) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`
of [Stacks, Tag 0A9E]. Then `f^! K = ā(K)|_X`, that is `f^! = j^* ∘ ā`.
declarations.statement:
def upperShriek :
    quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left ⥤ quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X.left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_quasiCompact_compactification_over
declarations.doc:
A compactifiable `S`-scheme is also compactifiable over a separated finite-type `S`-scheme
through which its structure morphism factors.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_quasiCompact_compactification_over
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (hX : ∃ j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk (f ≫ g)),
      QuasiCompact j.immersion) :
    ∃ j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f),
      QuasiCompact j.immersion

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriekIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AA0]: the canonical comparison of the upper shriek functors of two
compactifications.**  It is `α_{g₁}⁻¹ ≫ α_{g₂}` for the two projections of the common refinement
with dense interior of [Stacks, Tag 0ATU], as an isomorphism of functors out of
`D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
def compactificationUpperShriekIso (j k : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f.left)) :
    compactificationUpperShriek f j ≅ compactificationUpperShriek f k
declarations.comment: the canonical isomorphism f^!_j = f^!_k between the upper shriek functors (Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriek, which is Stacks.Duality.upperShriek of Stacks 0A9Y, read on D^+_QCoh(O_Y) as in the source) of any two compactifications j, k of a morphism f : X -> Y of FTS S over a Noetherian S: the source's alpha_{g_1}^{-1} then alpha_{g_2} for the two projections of the common refinement with dense interior of Stacks 0ATU. Nothing is carried: alpha_g needs Stacks 0A9K for the square of g, which is Stacks.Duality.isIso_refinementXi, and Stacks 0A9P (2) for it (G proper, Xbar_2 Noetherian), which is Stacks.Duality.isIso_refinementBaseChangePlus, both instances. Its value on the diagonal is the identity (Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriekIso_refl), it is transitive (Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriekIso_trans) and it is the source's alpha_g for an interior-preserving g (Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriekIso_eq_iso); Stacks.Duality.exists_coherent_compactificationUpperShriekIso collects these. The compactifications are arguments; that one exists is Stacks 0F41

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.exists_coherent_compactificationUpperShriekIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AA0]: the upper shriek functor is independent of the compactification, by a
coherent family of isomorphisms.**  There is a family of isomorphisms `e j k : f^!_j ≅ f^!_k`
of functors out of `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`,
indexed by pairs of compactifications of `X` over `Y`, which is the identity on the diagonal,
composes transitively, and **agrees with the source's comparison `α_g` whenever `j` and `k` are
joined by an interior-preserving morphism `g`**.  So the isomorphism class of `f^!` does not
depend on the compactification, the identifications of three compactifications are compatible,
and the family is the source's.

The family is `Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriekIso` itself; reflexivity is
`Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriekIso_refl`, transitivity is
`Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriekIso_trans`, and the agreement with `α_g` is
`Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriekIso_eq_iso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_coherent_compactificationUpperShriekIso :
    ∃ e : ∀ j k : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f.left),
        compactificationUpperShriek f j ≅ compactificationUpperShriek f k,
      (∀ j, e j j = Iso.refl _) ∧ (∀ j k l, e j k ≪≫ e k l = e j l) ∧
        ∀ (j k : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f.left)) (g : j ⟶ k)
          (hg : CompactificationOf.PreservesInterior g), e j k = refinementIso f g hg
declarations.comment: the upper shriek functor of a compactification (Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriek, which is Stacks.Duality.upperShriek of Stacks 0A9Y) on D^+_QCoh(O_Y), the source's own domain for it, is independent of the compactification up to canonical isomorphism: a family of isomorphisms between the functors of any two compactifications that is the identity on the diagonal, transitive, and equal to the source's alpha_g (Stacks.Duality.refinementIso) whenever the two compactifications are joined by an interior-preserving morphism g. Nothing is carried; the family is Stacks.Duality.compactificationUpperShriekIso

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.nonempty_upperShriekPlus_affineLineProj_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AA1 (Lemma 48.17.3).** In Situation 48.16.1 let `Y` be an object of
`FTS S` and let `f : X = 𝔸¹_Y ⟶ Y` be the projection. Then there is a (noncanonical) isomorphism
`f^!(-) ≅ Lf^*(-)[1]` of functors on `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`, with `f^!` computed at any compactification
`j` of `f`.

The proof is through the isomorphisms `μ_{f,K} : Lf^*K ⊗ᴸ f^!𝒪_Y ≅ f^!K` of
[Stacks, Tag 0B6U] (e), `f` being smooth, together with `f^!𝒪_Y ≅ 𝒪_X[1]`: the source's
`𝒪_{ℙ¹_Y}(-2)|_X ≅ 𝒪_X` is replaced by the fundamental class of [Stacks, Tag 0E9Z] for
`X ⊆ ℙ¹_Y ⟶ Y` and the triviality of `Ω_{X/Y}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_upperShriekPlus_affineLineProj_iso :
    Nonempty (upperShriekPlus (affineLineProj Y) j ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι _ ≅
      ObjectProperty.ι _ ⋙ quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (affineLineProj Y).left ⋙
        shiftFunctor (quasiCoherentDerivedCategory (affineLineFTS Y).left) (1 : ℤ))

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.LocallySmall.upperShriek_closedImmersion_of_fts
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AA2 (Lemma 48.17.4).** In Situation 48.16.1 — `S` a Noetherian scheme
and `FTS S` the schemes separated and of finite type over `S` — let `i : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of
`FTS S` whose underlying morphism of schemes is a closed immersion. Then
`i^!(-) = R𝓗om(𝒪_X, -)`:

1. `Ri_* : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` has a right adjoint;
2. the upper shriek `i^! = j^* ∘ a` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9Y] at the compactification `X̄ = X` that a
   proper morphism is (`Stacks.Duality.properCompactification`), with its right adjoint `a`
   *produced* by (1) and its quasi-coherence inputs discharged, agrees with `R𝓗om(𝒪_X, -)` on
   `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`;
3. for every right adjoint `a` of `Ri_*` the canonical comparison `a(K) ⟶ R𝓗om(𝒪_X, K)` — the
   mate of the counit of `a` under [Stacks, Tag 0A76] — is an isomorphism for every `K` in
   `D⁺_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.

The existence (1) is
`Stacks.Duality.LocallySmall.isLeftAdjoint_affineHomQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward`, which builds
the right adjoint as `DQ_X ∘ R𝓗om(𝒪_X, -)` from the coherator of [Stacks, Tag 0CR0]; `X` is
quasi-compact and quasi-separated, being of finite type over a Noetherian scheme. The
identification (2), (3) is [Stacks, Tag 0A9X] at this model
(`Stacks.Duality.LocallySmall.isIso_rightAdjointToDerivedSheafHom_app`), whose hypotheses —
pseudo-coherence of `i` — hold in Situation 48.16.1.
declarations.statement:
theorem upperShriek_closedImmersion_of_fts {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] {X Y : FTS S}
    (i : X ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i.left] :
    (affineHomQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward i.left).IsLeftAdjoint ∧
      IsDerivedSheafHomRightAdjoint i.left
        (upperShriek i (properCompactification i)) ∧
      ∀ (a : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left ⥤ quasiCoherentDerivedCategory X.left)
        (adj : affineHomQuasiCoherentDerivedPushforward i.left ⊣ a)
        (K : (isBoundedBelowQuasiCoherent Y.left).FullSubcategory),
        IsIso ((rightAdjointToDerivedSheafHom i.left
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_isAffineHom i.left) a adj).app
            K.obj)
declarations.comment: at the locally small derived categories, the model at which the coherator and the right adjoint of Ri_* are built; i^! is constructed here

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isDualizingComplex_upperShriek_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AA3 (Lemma 48.17.7).** In Situation 48.16.1 let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a
morphism of `FTS S`. If `K` is a dualizing complex for `Y`, then `f^!K` is a dualizing complex for
`X`. Here `f^!` is computed at an arbitrary compactification `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDualizingComplex_upperShriek_obj
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y.left) (hK : IsDualizingComplex K.obj) :
    IsDualizingComplex ((upperShriek f j).obj K).obj
declarations.comment: f^! is the library's upper shriek functor of Tag 0A9Y at an arbitrary compactification j of f; the only hypothesis is that K is a dualizing complex on Y

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.normalTensorDerivedSheafHomMap
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AA4], the canonical map**

`Li^*K ⊗^L_{𝒪_D} 𝒩[-1] ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_D, K)` in `D(𝒪_D)`,

for `K` in `D(𝒪_X)`: the canonical map (48.14.1.1) of [Stacks, Tag 0B4C] precomposed with the
comparison morphism `𝒩[-1] ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_D, 𝒪_X)` of [Stacks, Tag 0B4B] tensored with `Li^*K`.
This is the composite the source forms; that it is an isomorphism is
`Stacks.Divisors.isIso_normalTensorDerivedSheafHomMap`, and that it is natural in `K` is
`Stacks.Divisors.normalTensorDerivedSheafHomMap_natural`.
declarations.statement:
def normalTensorDerivedSheafHomMap
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules) :
    (normalTensorDerivedPullback D).obj K ⟶
      (closedQuotient D).derivedSheafHomExactSupport.obj K
declarations.comment: the canonical map Li^*K ⊗ᴸ 𝒩[-1] ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_D, K) only, unconditionally; that the map is an isomorphism is not proved, since that needs the isomorphism assertion of Tag 0B4B, which this file states only as a map, and functoriality in K is not proved either

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.normalTensorDerivedSheafHomIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AA4].** Let `X` be a scheme and `D ⊆ X` an effective Cartier divisor, with
closed immersion `i : D ⟶ X` and normal sheaf `𝒩`. Then the map (48.14.1.1) of
[Stacks, Tag 0B4C] combined with the isomorphism `R ℰom(𝒪_D, 𝒪_X) ≅ 𝒩[-1]` of
[Stacks, Tag 0B4B] defines an isomorphism

`Li^*K ⊗^L_{𝒪_D} 𝒩[-1] ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_D, K)`

functorial in `K` in `D(𝒪_X)`.

The isomorphism of functors `D(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_D)` below has as component at `K` exactly the
composite `Stacks.Divisors.normalTensorDerivedSheafHomMap` the source forms
(`Stacks.Divisors.normalTensorDerivedSheafHomIso_hom_app`): the comparison morphism
`𝒩[-1] ⟶ R ℰom(𝒪_D, 𝒪_X)` of [Stacks, Tag 0B4B] tensored with `Li^*K`, followed by the map of
[Stacks, Tag 0B4C]. Here `𝒩` is the normal sheaf `Stacks.Divisors.normalSheaf` of the closed
immersion, `R ℰom(𝒪_D, -)` is the right adjoint of derived pushforward of [Stacks, Tag 0A76],
and `Li^*` and `⊗^L` are the derived pullback and derived tensor product of the library.
declarations.statement:
def normalTensorDerivedSheafHomIso :
    normalTensorDerivedPullback D ≅ (closedQuotient D).derivedSheafHomExactSupport

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap
declarations.doc:
**The base change map `L(g')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ Lg^*`** of [Stacks, Tag 0AA6], Equation 48.5.0.1,
for a cartesian square of schemes: the unit of `Lg^* ⊣ Rg_*`, then the inverse of
`L(g')^* ⋆ ξ ⋆ Lg^*`, then the counit of `L(g')^* ⊣ Rg'_*`.

Invertibility of `ξ` is an instance argument; for a Tor-independent square of quasi-compact
quasi-separated schemes it is [Stacks, Tag 0A9K], and the map at those hypotheses is
`Stacks.Duality.torIndependentTwistedInverseImageBaseChange`.
declarations.statement:
def twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsIso (twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange g' f' f g hpushg' hpushf hpushf' hpushg
      sq)] :
    twistedInverseImage f hpushf ⋙ quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g' ⟶
      quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g ⋙ twistedInverseImage f' hpushf'
declarations.comment: variant: the composite for any cartesian square at which ξ is invertible; the tag is Stacks.Duality.torIndependentTwistedInverseImageBaseChange

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.torIndependentTwistedInverseImageBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**The base change map `L(g')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ Lg^*` of [Stacks, Tag 0AA6]**, Equation 48.5.0.1,
for a cartesian square of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes with `f` and `g` Tor
independent: the unit of `Lg^* ⊣ Rg_*`, then the inverse of `L(g')^* ⋆ ξ ⋆ Lg^*`, which exists by
[Stacks, Tag 0A9K], then the counit of `L(g')^* ⊣ Rg'_*`.
declarations.statement:
def torIndependentTwistedInverseImageBaseChange (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (hTor : TorIndependent f g) :
    twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f) ⋙
        quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g' ⟶
      quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g ⋙
        twistedInverseImage f' (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.torIndependentTwistedInverseImageBaseChange_homEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The adjoint form of the base change map of [Stacks, Tag 0AA6].** Under
`L(g')^* ⊣ Rg'_*` the component at `K` of `L(g')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ Lg^*` corresponds to
`a(K) ⟶ a(Rg_* Lg^* K) ⟵ Rg'_* a'(Lg^* K)`, the image under `a` of the unit of `Lg^* ⊣ Rg_*`
followed by the inverse of `ξ : Rg'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rg_*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem torIndependentTwistedInverseImageBaseChange_homEquiv (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (hTor : TorIndependent f g) (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    haveI := isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent sq hTor
    (quasiCoherentDerivedAdjunction g' (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' g')
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')).homEquiv _ _
        ((torIndependentTwistedInverseImageBaseChange sq hTor).app K) =
      (twistedInverseImage f (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).map
          ((quasiCoherentDerivedAdjunction g (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPullback' g)
            (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)).unit.app K) ≫
        (inv (twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange g' f' f g
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g) sq)).app
            ((quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' g).obj K)
declarations.comment: the adjoint form a ⟶ a ∘ Rg_* ∘ Lg^* ⟵ Rg'_* ∘ a' ∘ Lg^*

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalHomBaseChange.isIso_globalHomBaseChangeMap_of_isPerfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AA7, case (1).**  Let `X' --g'--> X`, `f : X ⟶ Spec R`, `f' : X' ⟶ Spec R'` be a
cartesian square over `Spec φ : Spec R' ⟶ Spec R`, with `f` quasi-compact and quasi-separated and
`X`, `Spec R'` Tor independent over `Spec R`.  For `M` perfect and `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` the canonical
map `R Hom_X(M, K) ⊗^𝐋_R R' ⟶ R Hom_{X'}(L(g')^*M, L(g')^*K)` of `D(R')` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalHomBaseChangeMap_of_isPerfect (hsq : IsPullback g' f' f (Spec.map φ))
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (hTor : TorIndependent f (Spec.map φ))
    (M K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hM : Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := X.toRingedSpace) M)
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj K).IsQuasicoherent) :
    IsIso (globalHomBaseChangeMap φ f f' g' hsq.w M K)
declarations.comment: case (1): M perfect and K in D_QCoh(O_X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GlobalHomBaseChange.isIso_globalHomBaseChangeMap_of_isPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AA7, case (2).**  Let `X' --g'--> X`, `f : X ⟶ Spec R`, `f' : X' ⟶ Spec R'` be a
cartesian square over `Spec φ : Spec R' ⟶ Spec R`, with `f` quasi-compact and quasi-separated and
`X`, `Spec R'` Tor independent over `Spec R`.  If `M` is pseudo-coherent, `K ∈ D^+_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and
`R'` has finite Tor dimension over `R`, the canonical map
`R Hom_X(M, K) ⊗^𝐋_R R' ⟶ R Hom_{X'}(L(g')^*M, L(g')^*K)` of `D(R')` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_globalHomBaseChangeMap_of_isPseudoCoherent (hsq : IsPullback g' f' f (Spec.map φ))
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (hTor : TorIndependent f (Spec.map φ))
    (M K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hM : RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherent (X := X.toRingedSpace) M)
    (hK : DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryBPlus (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf) K)
    (hR' : StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.HasFiniteTorDimensionCanonical R (algebraComplex R R' φ)) :
    IsIso (globalHomBaseChangeMap φ f f' g' hsq.w M K)
declarations.comment: case (2): M pseudo-coherent, K in D^+_QCoh(O_X), R' of finite tor dimension over R

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap_app_of_finiteTorDimension
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AA8] part (3).** In a cartesian square of quasi-compact and quasi-separated
schemes, let `g : Y' ⟶ Y` be a morphism of affine schemes, `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, and `f`, `g` Tor
independent. If `g` has finite Tor dimension and `Y` is Noetherian, the base change map
`L(g')^* a(K) ⟶ a'(Lg^*K)` of [Stacks, Tag 0AA6] is an isomorphism for every
`K ∈ D^+_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.

For a morphism of affine schemes, having finite Tor dimension means that `Γ(Y', 𝒪)` has finite
Tor dimension as a `Γ(Y, 𝒪)`-module (`AlgebraicGeometry.HasFiniteTorDimensionRingHom` of the map
on global sections): the stalks `𝒪_{Y', y'}` then have Tor dimension bounded uniformly over
`𝒪_{Y, g(y')}`, which is the definition of a morphism of finite Tor dimension; finite Tor
dimension of each stalk separately, without a uniform bound, is weaker.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap_app_of_finiteTorDimension
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y'] [IsProper f] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (hTor : TorIndependent f g) (hg : HasFiniteTorDimensionRingHom g.appTop.hom)
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) (hK : DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow K.obj) :
    haveI := isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent sq hTor
    IsIso ((twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap g' f' f g
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)
      sq).app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap_app_of_flat
declarations.doc:
In a cartesian square of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes, let `g : Y' ⟶ Y` be a
morphism of affine schemes, `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, and `f`, `g` Tor independent. If `f` is flat and
of finite presentation, the base change map `L(g')^* a(K) ⟶ a'(Lg^*K)` of [Stacks, Tag 0AA6] is an
isomorphism for every `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap_app_of_flat (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Y'] [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (hTor : TorIndependent f g) (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    haveI := isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent sq hTor
    IsIso ((twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap g' f' f g
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)
      sq).app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_perfect
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AAA] (2), for a supplied cartesian square.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect
proper morphism of Noetherian schemes and `j : V ⟶ Y` an open immersion, with base change
`j' : U ⟶ X` and `f' : U ⟶ V`. The map `(j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*` of [Stacks, Tag 0A9L] is an
isomorphism at every `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. The invertibility of `ξ : Rj'_* ∘ a' ⟶ a ∘ Rj_*` that
the map contains is the open-immersion case of [Stacks, Tag 0A9K],
`Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_isOpenImmersion`. The tag, for
every open `V ⊆ Y`, is `Stacks.Duality.isIso_qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_perfect`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_perfect (sq : IsPullback j' f' f j)
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    haveI : IsOpenImmersion j' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq.flip inferInstance
    haveI : IsProper f' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq inferInstance
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion j
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_isProper f'
    haveI := isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_isOpenImmersion j' f' f j
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j) sq
    IsIso ((twistedInverseImageRestrictionMap j' f' f j
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs j)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j) (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedRestrict j')
      sq).app K)
declarations.comment:
(2) variant: for a supplied cartesian square with open immersion `j`; the tag is
`isIso_qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_perfect`

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_perfect
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AAA] (2).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect proper morphism of Noetherian
schemes and `V ⊆ Y` an open, with `U = f⁻¹(V)`. The map `(j')^* ∘ a ⟶ a' ∘ j^*` of
[Stacks, Tag 0A9L], `Stacks.Duality.OpenImmersion.qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap`, is an
isomorphism at every `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`. The schemes `X`, `Y` are quasi-compact and
quasi-separated and `V` is quasi-compact because they are Noetherian.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap_app_of_perfect (V : Y.Opens)
    (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion V.ι
    IsIso ((qcqsTwistedInverseImageRestrictionMap f V).app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isZero_derivedRestrict_twistedInverseImage_of_perfect
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AAA] (1).** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a perfect proper morphism of Noetherian
schemes, with `a` the right adjoint of `Rf_*` on `D_QCoh`. For every closed `T ⊆ Y`, if
`Q ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` is supported on `T` then `a(Q)` is supported on `f⁻¹(T)`. Here `T` is the
complement of the open `W`, and "supported on `T`" is "restricts to zero on `W`". The functor `a`
exists by [Stacks, Tag 0A9E],
`Stacks.Duality.DerivedPushforward.isLeftAdjoint_quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward_of_qcqs`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_derivedRestrict_twistedInverseImage_of_perfect (W : Y.Opens)
    (Q : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) (hQ : IsZero ((derivedRestrict W.ι).obj Q.obj)) :
    haveI := DerivedPushforward.isLeftAdjoint_quasiCoherentDerivedPushforward_of_qcqs f
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
    IsZero ((derivedRestrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj
      ((twistedInverseImage f
        (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)).obj Q).obj)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.isIso_twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap_app_of_isProper_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AAB].** Let `g : Y' ⟶ Y` be a morphism of quasi-compact and quasi-separated
schemes and `f : X ⟶ Y` proper, flat and of finite presentation, with base change
`f' : X' ⟶ Y'`. Then the base change map `L(g')^* a(K) ⟶ a'(Lg^*K)` of [Stacks, Tag 0AA6] is an
isomorphism for every `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap_app_of_isProper_of_flat {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y'] [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (K : quasiCoherentDerivedCategory Y) :
    haveI : CompactSpace X := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f
    haveI : QuasiCompact f' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq inferInstance
    haveI : QuasiSeparated f' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq inferInstance
    haveI : CompactSpace X' := QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f'
    haveI : QuasiSeparatedSpace X' := quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f'
    haveI := isIso_twistedInverseImagePushforwardBaseChange_of_torIndependent sq
      (torIndependent_of_flat_left f g)
    IsIso ((twistedInverseImageBaseChangeMap g' f' f g
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f)
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs f')
      (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs g)
      sq).app K)

declarations.name: Stacks.Duality.BlowupBaseChange.baseChange_example
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Example 0AAC]: the base change map (48.5.0.1) is not an isomorphism for a
perfect proper `f` and a perfect `g`.** Let `k` be a field, `f : X ⟶ Y = 𝐀²_k` the blowup of
the origin, `g : Y' = Spec k ⟶ Y` the origin and `X' = E = 𝐏¹_k` the exceptional divisor, with
`g' : X' ⟶ X` its inclusion and `f' : X' ⟶ Y'` its structure morphism; let `a`, `a'` be the right
adjoints of `Rf_*`, `Rf'_*` on `D_QCoh` ([Stacks, Tag 0A9E]). Then `f` is proper and perfect, `g`
is perfect, the square is cartesian, `f` and `g` are not Tor independent, and no morphism
`L(g')^* a(𝒪_Y) ⟶ a'(Lg^* 𝒪_Y)` — in particular no base change map — is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChange_example :
    IsProper (f k) ∧ Perfect (f k) ∧ Perfect (g k) ∧
      IsPullback (g' k) (projToSpecCoeff k 1) (f k) (g k) ∧ ¬ TorIndependent (f k) (g k) ∧
      ∀ φ : (twistedInverseImage (f k)
          (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (f k)) ⋙
            quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (g' k)).obj (structureSheaf k) ⟶
        (quasiCoherentDerivedPullback' (g k) ⋙
          twistedInverseImage (projToSpecCoeff k 1)
            (isQuasicoherent_homology_derivedPushforward_of_qcqs (projToSpecCoeff k 1))).obj
            (structureSheaf k), ¬ IsIso φ

declarations.name: isCohenMacaulay_iff_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 10.103.6 (tag 0AAD).**
Let `φ : R →+* S` be a surjective homomorphism of Noetherian local rings, and let `N`
be a finite `S`-module.  Then `N` is Cohen-Macaulay as an `S`-module if and only if `N`
is Cohen-Macaulay as an `R`-module, where the `R`-module structure on `N` is obtained by
restriction of scalars along `φ` (`Module.compHom N φ`).

Here Noetherianity of `R` is encoded by `IsNoetherianRing R` (and `S` is then automatically
Noetherian as a quotient, but we also assume it for convenience).
