declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.DescentData.IsEffective
declarations.doc:
A descent datum for a family is effective if it is isomorphic to the canonical descent
datum of an algebraic space over the target.
declarations.statement:
public abbrev DescentData.IsEffective {f : ∀ i, X i ⟶ T} {hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T}
    {hX : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (X i)} (D : DescentData f hT hX) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2), effectivity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.essSurj_fibreDescentFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADT, essential surjectivity.** Every descent datum relative to a family of
morphisms of algebraic spaces is the descent datum of a sheaf over the target whose fibre
products with the members of the family are algebraic spaces, namely of the quotient sheaf
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.descentQuotient` of the datum.
declarations.statement: public instance essSurj_fibreDescentFunctor : (fibreDescentFunctor f hT hX).EssSurj
declarations.comment: ESSENTIAL SURJECTIVITY of fibreDescentFunctor, i.e. the LEFT-TO-RIGHT FUNCTOR of the asserted equivalence on objects: every descent datum is the descent datum of a sheaf over T whose fibre products with the family are the components of the datum, namely of descentQuotient, the fppf sheafification of the presheaf of orbits of local lifts of the datum. That presheaf is the object the source builds as the coequalizer of the two maps from the pairwise overlaps V i x_T X j to the disjoint union of the components V i; the two maps are equalized by toDescentQuotient_move and the components are recovered by isPullback_toDescentQuotient. The coequalizer UNIVERSAL PROPERTY is not stated here. Proved WITHOUT Stacks 0ADV and without the fppf covering hypothesis -- only that the target and the members of the family are algebraic spaces. The equivalence of categories, which needs full faithfulness as well, is fibreDescentFunctorEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.fibreDescentFunctorEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADT, the equivalence of categories.** For an fppf covering `{X i ⟶ T}` of
algebraic spaces, sheaves over `T` whose fibre products with the covering are algebraic spaces
are equivalent to descent data relative to the covering, by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.fibreDescentFunctor`.
declarations.statement:
public def fibreDescentFunctorEquivalence (hcov : Space.IsFppfCovering B S hS X f) :
    SheavesWithSpaceFibres f ≌ DescentData f hT hX
declarations.comment: THE EQUIVALENCE OF CATEGORIES ASSERTED BY THE TAG, in full, for an fppf covering of algebraic spaces: sheaves over the target whose fibre products with the covering are algebraic spaces are equivalent to descent data relative to the covering. The functor is fibreDescentFunctor; full faithfulness is fibreDescentFunctorFullyFaithful and essential surjectivity is essSurj_fibreDescentFunctor, which sends a datum to descentQuotient. Stacks 0ADV is neither used nor needed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.isPullback_fibreDescentData_obj
declarations.doc:
The component of the descent datum at `i` sits in the fibre product square for
`X i ×_T F`: its structure map to `X i` and its projection to `F` are a fibre product of
`f i` and the structure map of `F`.
declarations.comment: part (1) only: the component of the descent datum at i is the fibre product X i ×_T F. Not the equivalence of categories, and not part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.fibreDescentFunctor
declarations.doc:
The functor from sheaves over `T` whose fibre products with the members of the family are
algebraic spaces to descent data relative to the family.
declarations.statement: public def fibreDescentFunctor : SheavesWithSpaceFibres f ⥤ DescentData f hT hX
declarations.comment: ONE FUNCTOR of the asserted equivalence, right to left: from sheaves over T whose fibre products with the family are algebraic spaces, to descent data. The cocycle condition is proved, not assumed. This declaration is that functor ALONE -- it asserts neither the equivalence nor part (2). Both are proved of this same functor elsewhere, in StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/Descent/SpacesOverSpaces/DescentDataSheavesEquivalence.lean and DescentDataQuotient.lean: full faithfulness is fibreDescentFunctorFullyFaithful, essential surjectivity -- the left-to-right coequalizer direction, realized by the quotient sheaf descentQuotient -- is the instance essSurj_fibreDescentFunctor, the equivalence of categories itself is fibreDescentFunctorEquivalence, and part (2) is isAlgebraicSpace_iff_isEffective_fibreDescentData. The source's two natural isomorphisms are not built by hand: the equivalence is assembled from the two halves above

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.fibreDescentFunctorFullyFaithful
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADT**, half of the asserted equivalence: for an fppf covering of algebraic
spaces, the functor from sheaves over the target whose fibre products with the covering are
algebraic spaces to descent data relative to the covering is fully faithful.
declarations.statement:
public def fibreDescentFunctorFullyFaithful (hcov : Space.IsFppfCovering B S hS X f) :
    (fibreDescentFunctor f hT hX).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: FULL FAITHFULNESS of the right-to-left functor of the asserted equivalence, for an fppf covering of algebraic spaces. The other half, essential surjectivity via the coequalizer, is NOT proved, so the equivalence is not claimed

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.isAlgebraicSpace_iff_isEffective_fibreDescentData
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADT, part (2).** For an fppf covering of algebraic spaces, a sheaf over the
target whose fibre products with the covering are algebraic spaces is itself an algebraic
space exactly when its descent datum is effective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAlgebraicSpace_iff_isEffective_fibreDescentData
    (hcov : Space.IsFppfCovering B S hS X f) (F : SheavesWithSpaceFibres f) :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F.obj.left ↔
      DescentData.IsEffective (fibreDescentData f hT hX F)
declarations.comment: PART (2) IN FULL: the sheaf F is an algebraic space if and only if the corresponding descent datum is effective, against this library's DescentData.IsEffective. Proved WITHOUT Stacks 0ADV -- effectivity hands over an algebraic space and full faithfulness transports the isomorphism back. The equivalence of categories itself is NOT here: essential surjectivity, i.e. the left-to-right coequalizer functor, is unproved

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.fppfDescentDataSheafEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADT.** For an fppf covering of algebraic spaces `{X i ⟶ T}`, the sheaves on the
big fppf site endowed with a map to `T` whose fibre products `X i ×_T F` are all algebraic
spaces are equivalent to the descent data relative to the covering. The functor takes a sheaf
to the descent datum formed by those fibre products.
declarations.comment: THE EQUIVALENCE OF CATEGORIES, for an fppf covering of algebraic spaces: descent data relative to the covering are the sheaves over the target whose fibre products with the covering are algebraic spaces. Full faithfulness is fibreDescentFunctorFullyFaithful, essential surjectivity is fibreDescentFunctor_essSurj, which glues the members of the datum as the source's coequalizer and sheafifies

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.descendedFibreComponentIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADT, part (1).** Under the equivalence, the fibre product of the sheaf a descent
datum corresponds to with the `i`-th member of the covering is the `i`-th member of the
descent datum, as a space over that member of the covering.
declarations.comment: PART (1): the algebraic space X i ×_X F on the sheaf side of the equivalence is the member V i on the descent-datum side, as an object over X i

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.isPullback_descentInclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADT, part (1)** in pullback form: the `i`-th member of a descent datum, with its
structure map to `X i` and its canonical map to the sheaf the datum descends to, is the fibre
product of that sheaf with `X i`.
declarations.comment: PART (1) in pullback form: V i, with its structure map to X i and its canonical map into the descended sheaf F, is the fibre product X i ×_X F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.isAlgebraicSpace_inverse_iff_isEffective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADT, part (2)** read on the descent-datum side: the sheaf a descent datum
descends to is an algebraic space exactly when the descent datum is effective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAlgebraicSpace_inverse_iff_isEffective :
    IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS
        ((fppfDescentDataSheafEquivalence f hcov).inverse.obj D).obj.left ↔
      DescentData.IsEffective D
declarations.comment: PART (2) on the descent-datum side: the sheaf F corresponding to a descent datum is an algebraic space if and only if that datum is effective

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etale_finite_clopen_part
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADU.** An étale neighbourhood of the image of `x` splits the pullback into two
open-and-closed parts, one of them finite over the neighbourhood and containing a point above
`x`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_etale_finite_clopen_part
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (x : points B S hS X.1)
    (hft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f.hom)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f.hom)
    (hqf : IsQuasiFiniteAt B S hS f.hom x) :
    ∃ (U : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (g : U ⟶ Y)
      (u : points B S hS U.1)
      (W V : Subfunctor (pullback g.hom f.hom)),
      IsEtale B S hS g.hom ∧
      pointsMap B S hS U.1 g.hom u = pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom x ∧
      IsOpenSubspace B S hS W ∧
      IsClosedSubspace B S hS W ∧
      IsOpenSubspace B S hS V ∧
      IsClosedSubspace B S hS V ∧
      (W ⊔ V).sheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) = ⊤ ∧
      W ⊓ V = (⊥ : Subfunctor (pullback g.hom f.hom)).sheafify
        (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ∧
      IsFinite B S hS (V.ι ≫ pullback.fst g.hom f.hom) ∧
      ∃ v : points B S hS V.toFunctor,
        pointsMap B S hS V.toFunctor (V.ι ≫ pullback.snd g.hom f.hom) v = x ∧
        pointsMap B S hS V.toFunctor (V.ι ≫ pullback.fst g.hom f.hom) v = u

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etale_decomposition_isFinite_point_of_isQuasiFiniteAt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ADU.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`,
let `x` be a point of `|X|` and let `y` be its image in `|Y|`. Assume that `f` is locally of
finite type, that `f` is separated and that `f` is quasi-finite at `x`. Then there are an object
`U` of the big fppf category over `S`, an **étale** morphism `g : h_U ⟶ Y` and a point `u` of
`|h_U|` over `y`, together with a decomposition of `U ×_Y X` into two open-and-closed subspaces
`W` and `V` — their join sheafifies to everything and their meet is the sheafification of
nothing — such that `V ⟶ U` is **finite** and some point of `|V|` lies over `x` in `|X|` and
over `u` in `|U|`.

This is the single-point case of Stacks 082H,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_etale_decomposition_isFinite_of_isQuasiFiniteAt`, applied over
an étale scheme chart of `Y` through `y`; see the module documentation for how the extra
hypothesis of that lemma and its standing `HasSheafify` assumption on the site are both
discharged. The hypotheses are those of the tag and nothing else.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etale_decomposition_isFinite_point_of_isQuasiFiniteAt
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X) (y : points B S hS Y)
    (hxy : pointsMap B S hS X f x = y)
    (hft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS f)
    (hqf : IsQuasiFiniteAt B S hS f x) :
    ∃ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Y)
      (u : points B S hS (yoneda.obj U)) (W V : Subfunctor (pullback g f)),
      IsEtale B S hS g ∧
      pointsMap B S hS (yoneda.obj U) g u = y ∧
      IsOpenSubspace B S hS W ∧ IsClosedSubspace B S hS W ∧
      IsOpenSubspace B S hS V ∧ IsClosedSubspace B S hS V ∧
      (W ⊔ V).sheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) = ⊤ ∧
      W ⊓ V = (⊥ : Subfunctor (pullback g f)).sheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B S hS) ∧
      IsFinite B S hS (V.ι ≫ pullback.fst g f) ∧
      ∃ v : points B S hS V.toFunctor,
        pointsMap B S hS V.toFunctor (V.ι ≫ pullback.snd g f) v = x ∧
        pointsMap B S hS V.toFunctor (V.ι ≫ pullback.fst g f) v = u

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.DescentData.isEffective_of_countable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADV, part (1).** Let `{f i : X i ⟶ T}` be an fppf covering of algebraic spaces
over `S` whose index type is countable. Then every descent datum for algebraic spaces relative
to it is effective.
declarations.statement: theorem isEffective_of_countable (hcov : IsFppfCovering B S hS X f) : D.IsEffective
declarations.comment: part (1): countable index set

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.Descent.DescentData.isEffective_of_isFiniteType
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ADV, part (2).** Let `{f i : X i ⟶ T}` be an fppf covering of algebraic spaces
over `S`, indexed by a type of any size. Then every descent datum `(Y i, φ i j)` relative to it
with each `Y i ⟶ X i` of finite type is effective.

The proof is the source's. The sheaf `F` of Stacks 0ADT the datum descends to has
`X i ×_T F = Y i`. Refine the covering by an fppf covering `{R k ⟶ T}` by affine objects of
the site, with the index type and the sizes of the members bounded by the size `μ` of an atlas
of `T`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_affine_refinement_of_isFppfCovering`, which uses Stacks 042T).
If `R k ⟶ T` factors through `X i`, then `R k ×_T F = R k ×_{X i} Y i` is of finite type over
the affine `R k`. So it has an atlas of size at most `size (R k) ≤ μ` by Stacks 04T7
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_atlas_size_le_of_isFiniteType`). This is the size bound the
source draws from Stacks 04U0. Stacks 02WQ then makes the coproducts `∐ R k` and
`∐ (R k ×_T F)` algebraic spaces, and Stacks 04S6 makes `F` an algebraic space.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffective_of_isFiniteType (hcov : IsFppfCovering B S hS X f)
    (hft : ∀ i, IsFiniteType B S hS (D.obj i).hom) : D.IsEffective
declarations.comment: part (2): finite type, index set of any size

declarations.name: KaehlerDifferential.pthRootDifferentialTrace_eq_comp_map
declarations.doc:
Differential traces for two presentations of a degree-`p` purely inseparable algebra
are intertwined by every `R`-algebra homomorphism between the presentations.
declarations.statement:
theorem pthRootDifferentialTrace_eq_comp_map (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [CharP R p] (a b : R)
    (φ : AdjoinRoot (X ^ p - C a) →ₐ[R] AdjoinRoot (X ^ p - C b))
    (trX : Ω[AdjoinRoot (X ^ p - C a)⁄R] →ₗ[R] Ω[R⁄ℤ])
    (trY : Ω[AdjoinRoot (X ^ p - C b)⁄R] →ₗ[R] Ω[R⁄ℤ])
    (hX : IsPthRootDifferentialTrace p a trX)
    (hY : IsPthRootDifferentialTrace p b trY) :
    letI : Algebra (AdjoinRoot (X ^ p - C a)) (AdjoinRoot (X ^ p - C b)) :=
      φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    trX = trY.comp ((KaehlerDifferential.map R R
      (AdjoinRoot (X ^ p - C a)) (AdjoinRoot (X ^ p - C b))).restrictScalars R)

declarations.name: Stacks.Nagata.PurelyInseparable.integralClosure_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AE0.** The integral closure of `R` in `L = K[x]/(x^p - a)` is
finite over `R`. Given the finitely generated `R`-module `N ⊇ integral closure`
from `exists_fg_le`, the integral closure is a submodule of the f.g. module `N`
over the Noetherian ring `R`, hence itself f.g. (`Submodule.FG.of_le`), hence
finite (`Module.Finite.of_fg`).
declarations.statement:
theorem integralClosure_finite
    (h : ∃ D : Derivation ℤ K K,
      (∀ r : R, ∃ s : R, D (algebraMap R K r) = algebraMap R K s) ∧ D a ≠ 0) :
    Module.Finite R (integralClosure R (Lext p a))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.puncturedSpectrumSubfunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AE2.** The punctured spectrum of a local ring `A`, as a subfunctor of the functor
of points of `Spec A` on a big fppf site: a point lies in it exactly when the corresponding
morphism of schemes factors through the open immersion of the punctured spectrum.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def puncturedSpectrumSubfunctor (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (Spec (.of A))) :
    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (baseTerminal B (Spec (.of A)) hS))
declarations.comment: the punctured spectrum as a subfunctor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsProperModification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AE2.** A *proper modification* of a represented algebraic space `T` outside a
subfunctor `U` of its functor of points: an algebraic space over `T` whose structure morphism is
proper and whose base change to `U` is an isomorphism.
declarations.comment: the three defining conditions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ProperModification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AE2.** The category of proper morphisms of algebraic spaces to `Spec A` which are
isomorphisms over the punctured spectrum of `A`.
declarations.statement:
abbrev ProperModification (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (Spec (.of A)))
declarations.comment: the category they form

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProperModification_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AE2.** The three conditions defining a proper modification, spelled out: the
source is an algebraic space, its structure morphism is proper, and the base change of that
morphism to the subfunctor is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProperModification_iff (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (T : BigFppfOver B S hS) (U : Subfunctor (yoneda.obj T)) (X : Over (yoneda.obj T)) :
    IsProperModification B S hS T U X ↔
      IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X.left ∧ IsProper B S hS X.hom ∧
        IsIso (pullback.snd X.hom U.ι)
declarations.comment: the conditions spelled out

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProperModification_of_isIntegralModification
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AE3.** Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a two-dimensional Noetherian local domain whose
punctured spectrum `U = Spec A ∖ {𝔪}` is a normal scheme. Then every modification
`f : X → Spec A` lies in the category of Stacks 0AE2: `f` is proper and its base change
`f⁻¹(U) → U` to the punctured spectrum is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProperModification_of_isIntegralModification [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2) [AlgebraicGeometry.IsNormal (Stacks.puncturedSpectrum A).toScheme]
    {X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of A)) hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of A)) hS X)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseTerminal B (Spec (.of A)) hS))
    (hf : IsIntegralModification B (Spec (.of A)) hS hX
      (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B (Spec (.of A)) hS _)
      (isIntegralSpace_yoneda_baseTerminal A B hS) f) :
    IsProperModification B (Spec (.of A)) hS (baseTerminal B (Spec (.of A)) hS)
      (puncturedSpectrumSubfunctor A B hS) (Over.mk f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isEquivalence_affineModificationBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AE5.** Let `φ : A →+* R` be a homomorphism of Noetherian rings inducing an
isomorphism from the `I`-adic completion of `A` to the `I R`-adic completion of `R`, for an
ideal `I ⊆ A`. Then base change along `Spec R ⟶ Spec A` is an equivalence from the category of
Stacks 0AS2 for `(A, I)` to the category of Stacks 0AS2 for `(R, I R)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_affineModificationBaseChange [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (h : Function.Bijective (adicCompletionMap φ I (I.map φ) le_rfl)) :
    (affineModificationBaseChange B S hS φ I hA hR s).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isAdmissibleBlowup_dominating_of_isLocalRing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AE6.** Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a Noetherian local ring, let `U = Spec(A) ∖ V(𝔪)` and let
`f : X ⟶ Spec(A)` be an object of the category of Stacks 0AS2 for `(A, 𝔪)` — an algebraic space,
locally of finite type over `Spec(A)`, with `f⁻¹(U) ⟶ U` an isomorphism — such that `f` is
proper. Then there exists a `U`-admissible blowup `S' ⟶ Spec(A)` which dominates `X`, that is,
the blowup morphism factors as `S' ⟶ X ⟶ Spec(A)`.

The algebraic spaces are those over an arbitrary base scheme `S` of the big fppf site, with
`Spec(A)` an object of the site over `S`; the source's category is that of algebraic spaces over
`Spec(A)`, which is the case `S = Spec(A)`. Being a `U`-admissible blowup is Stacks 086B,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAdmissibleBlowup`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAdmissibleBlowup_dominating_of_isLocalRing {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (hA : B.Contains (Spec (.of A))) (s : Spec (.of A) ⟶ S)
    (X : Over (yoneda.obj (FormalSpace.affineOver B S hS hA s)))
    (hX : IsFiniteTypeModification B S hS
      (openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS (yoneda.obj (FormalSpace.affineOver B S hS hA s))
        (FormalSpace.zeroLocusPoints B S hS hA s (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))ᶜ) X)
    (hf : IsProper B S hS X.hom) :
    ∃ (S' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (b : S' ⟶ schemeSpace (FormalSpace.affineOver B S hS hA s)),
      IsAdmissibleBlowup B S hS
        ⟨openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS (yoneda.obj (FormalSpace.affineOver B S hS hA s))
          (FormalSpace.zeroLocusPoints B S hS hA s (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))ᶜ,
          isOpenSubspace_compl_zeroLocusPoints hA s _⟩ b ∧
        ∃ g : S'.obj ⟶ X.left, g ≫ X.hom = b.hom

declarations.name: Stacks.Resolution.trinomial_irreducible
declarations.doc: The defining trinomial is irreducible for positive pairwise coprime exponents.

      MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 3) ^ s +
      MvPolynomial.X (2 : Fin 3) ^ t : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) k)
declarations.comment: irreducibility

    IsDomain (trinomialRing k r s t)

declarations.name: Stacks.Resolution.trinomialRing_z_isPrime
declarations.doc: The image of `z` generates a prime ideal in the hypersurface ring.

declarations.name: Stacks.Resolution.trinomialRing_localization_equiv
declarations.doc:
When `t = 1 + e r s`, localization at `z` is the localization of a polynomial
ring in `x'`, `y'` at `-((x') ^ r + (y') ^ s)`, with the stated coordinate formulas.
declarations.statement:
theorem trinomialRing_localization_equiv (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (r s e : ℕ) :
    ∃ φ : Localization.Away
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X (2 : Fin 3)) :
          trinomialRing k r s (1 + e * r * s)) ≃ₐ[k]
        Localization.Away (-(MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) ^ r +
          MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 2) ^ s) : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
      φ (algebraMap (trinomialRing k r s (1 + e * r * s)) _
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 3)))) =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) _
          (MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) *
            (-(MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) ^ r +
              MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 2) ^ s)) ^ (e * s)) ∧
      φ (algebraMap (trinomialRing k r s (1 + e * r * s)) _
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 3)))) =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) _
          (MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 2) *
            (-(MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) ^ r +
              MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 2) ^ s)) ^ (e * r)) ∧
      φ (algebraMap (trinomialRing k r s (1 + e * r * s)) _
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X (2 : Fin 3)))) =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) _
          (-(MvPolynomial.X (0 : Fin 2) ^ r +
            MvPolynomial.X (1 : Fin 2) ^ s))
declarations.comment: localized polynomial presentation

declarations.name: Stacks.Resolution.trinomialRing_localization_uniqueFactorizationMonoid

    UniqueFactorizationMonoid
      (Localization.Away
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X (2 : Fin 3)) :

declarations.comment: factorial localization

declarations.name: Stacks.MvPowerSeries.Brieskorn.not_uniqueFactorizationMonoid_brieskornHypersurface

Apart from the `E₈` triple `(2, 3, 5)`, a Brieskorn hypersurface with ordered,

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isPerfect_generator_of_supported
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEC.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space
over `S`, and `T ⊆ |X|` a closed subset such that `|X| ∖ T` is quasi-compact. Then
`D_{QCoh,T}(𝒪_X)` is generated by a single perfect object: there is a perfect object `P` of
`D(𝒪_X)` with quasi-coherent cohomology supported on `T` (an object of `D_{QCoh,T}(𝒪_X)`) such that
an object `E` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` supported on `T` is zero if and only if `Hom(P[n], E) = 0` for all
`n ∈ ℤ`.

`D_{QCoh,T}(𝒪_X)` is the full subcategory of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` of the objects whose cohomology
sheaves are supported on `T` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologySupportedOn`, Stacks 08GF);
`|X| ∖ T` carries the topology of `|X|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isPerfect_generator_of_supported (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal X.1)
    (T : Set (points B S hS X.1)) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ) :
    ∃ P : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2),
      (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).IsPerfect P ∧
      DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
        (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
          ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))) P ∧
      CohomologySupportedOn B S hS X.1 X.2 T P ∧
      ∀ E : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2,
        CohomologySupportedOn B S hS X.1 X.2 T E.obj →
          (IsZero E.obj ↔ ∀ (n : ℤ) (g : P⟦n⟧ ⟶ E.obj), g = 0)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isCompactObject_iff_isPerfect_of_supported
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AED.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space
over `S`, and `T ⊆ |X|` a closed subset such that `|X| ∖ T` is quasi-compact. An object of
`D_{QCoh,T}(𝒪_X)` is compact (in `D_{QCoh,T}(𝒪_X)`) if and only if it is perfect as an object of
`D(𝒪_X)`.

`D_{QCoh,T}(𝒪_X)` is the full subcategory of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` of the objects whose cohomology
sheaves are supported on `T` (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.quasicoherentDerivedSupportedOn`, with
support as in Stacks 08GF); compactness is `CategoryTheory.IsCompactObject` (Stacks 07LS) in that
category, for direct sums indexed by the universe `u` of the site.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCompactObject_iff_isPerfect_of_supported (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal X.1)
    (T : Set (points B S hS X.1)) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ)
    (E : (quasicoherentDerivedSupportedOn X T).FullSubcategory) :
    IsCompactObject.{u} E ↔ (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).IsPerfect E.obj.obj

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isPerfect_comp_tensor_eq_zero_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEE.** Let `S` be a scheme, `X` a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space
over `S`, and `T ⊆ |X|` a closed subset whose complement `U` is quasi-compact. Let `α : P ⟶ E` be a
morphism of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` with `E` supported on `T`, where either (1) `P` is perfect, or (2) `P`
is pseudo-coherent and `E` is bounded below. Then there are a perfect complex `I` of
`𝒪_X`-modules and a map `u : I ⟶ 𝒪_X[0]` such that `u|_U : I|_U ⟶ 𝒪_U[0]` is an isomorphism and
`I ⊗^L P ⟶ 𝒪_X[0] ⊗^L P ≅ P ⟶ E` is zero.

`U` is the open subspace of `X` with `|U| = |X| ∖ T`, and `(-)|_U` the restriction along its
inclusion; `E` supported on `T` means that every cohomology sheaf of `E` is supported on `T`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CohomologySupportedOn`, Stacks 08GF); `E` bounded below means that its
cohomology sheaves vanish in all sufficiently negative degrees.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isPerfect_comp_tensor_eq_zero_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal X.1)
    (T : Set (points B S hS X.1)) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ)
    {P E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)}
    (hPq : QcohDerived B S hS X P) (hEq : QcohDerived B S hS X E) (α : P ⟶ E)
    (hEs : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS X.1 X.2 T E)
    (h : (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).IsPerfect P ∨
      ((smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).IsPseudoCoherent P ∧
        DerivedCategoryB.IsBoundedBelow E)) :
    ∃ (I : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)) (u : I ⟶ unitDerived X),
      (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).IsPerfect I ∧
      IsIso ((etaleModulePullback.{u, u} B S hS
          (openSubspaceHom B S hS
            ((openSubspacesOrderIso B S hS X.1 X.2).symm ⟨Tᶜ, hT.isOpen_compl⟩).1
            ((openSubspacesOrderIso B S hS X.1 X.2).symm ⟨Tᶜ, hT.isOpen_compl⟩).2)
          (isEtale_openSubspaceHom B S hS _ _)).mapDerivedCategory.map u) ∧
      ((smallEtaleDerivedTensorProduct B S hS X).tensor.map u).app P ≫
        (smallEtaleDerivedTensorUnitLeftIso B S hS X P).hom ≫ α = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SupportedComplexes.isIso_derivedPushforwardAdjunction_counit_app_of_supported
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEF, part (2).** For `K` in `D(𝒪_X)` whose cohomology sheaves are supported on
the closed subset `Z`, the canonical map `i_* RH_Z(K) ⟶ K` — the counit of the adjunction
`i_*^D ⊣ RH_Z` of Stacks 0A3B (1) — is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedPushforwardAdjunction_counit_app_of_supported (X : RingedSpace.{u, u})
    (Z : Set X.carrier) (hZ : IsClosed Z)
    (K : DerivedCategory (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)))
    (hK : AlgebraicGeometry.CohomologySupportedOn (structureSheafRing X) Z K) :
    letI := pushforward_preservesFiniteLimits X Z
    letI := pushforward_preservesFiniteColimits X Z hZ
    IsIso ((derivedPushforwardAdjunction X Z hZ).counit.app K)
declarations.comment: part (2): the counit i_*RℋZ(K) ⟶ K is invertible at every K supported on Z, which is the essential-image content of the equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SupportedComplexes.derivedPushforwardSupportedSectionsIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEF, part (2), as an isomorphism.** For `K` in `D(𝒪_X)` with cohomology sheaves
supported on `Z`, the canonical map `i_* RH_Z(K) ⟶ K` is an isomorphism `i_* RH_Z(K) ≅ K`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardSupportedSectionsIso (X : RingedSpace.{u, u}) (Z : Set X.carrier)
    (hZ : IsClosed Z) (K : DerivedCategory (_root_.SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X)))
    (hK : AlgebraicGeometry.CohomologySupportedOn (structureSheafRing X) Z K) :
    letI := pushforward_preservesFiniteLimits X Z
    letI := pushforward_preservesFiniteColimits X Z hZ
    (modulePushforward (closedSubsetInclusion X Z)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        ((derivedSupportedSectionsOnClosed X Z hZ).obj K) ≅ K
declarations.comment: part (2): the same invertible counit, as the isomorphism i_*RℋZ(K) ≅ K

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SupportedComplexes.closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEF, part (2).** Derived pushforward along the inclusion of a closed subset `Z`
is an equivalence of `D(𝒪_X|_Z)` with the full subcategory `D_Z(𝒪_X)` of `D(𝒪_X)` of complexes
whose cohomology sheaves are supported on `Z`.
declarations.comment: part (2): i_* : D(𝒪_X|_Z) ⥤ D_Z(𝒪_X) is an equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SupportedComplexes.closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence_functor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEF, part (2).** The equivalence onto the supported complexes is induced by
`i_*`: composed with the inclusion of `D_Z(𝒪_X)` into `D(𝒪_X)` it is `i_*^D`.
declarations.statement:
def closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence_functor (X : RingedSpace.{u, u})
    (Z : Set X.carrier) (hZ : IsClosed Z) :
    (letI := pushforward_preservesFiniteLimits X Z
    letI := pushforward_preservesFiniteColimits X Z hZ
    (closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence X Z hZ).functor ⋙
        (supportedDerivedProperty X Z).ι ≅
      (modulePushforward (closedSubsetInclusion X Z)).mapDerivedCategory)
declarations.comment: part (2): the functor of the equivalence is i_*

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SupportedComplexes.closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence_inverse
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEF, part (2).** The quasi-inverse of the equivalence is the derived functor
`RH_Z` of sections supported on `Z`, restricted to `D_Z(𝒪_X)`.

This is the `RH_Z` half of the source's `i^{-1}|_{D_Z(𝒪_X)} = RH_Z|_{D_Z(𝒪_X)}`; the `i^{-1}`
half is `closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence_inverse_iso_derivedModulePullback` in
`ClosedSubsetDerivedPullback.lean`.
declarations.statement:
def closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence_inverse (X : RingedSpace.{u, u})
    (Z : Set X.carrier) (hZ : IsClosed Z) :
    (closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence X Z hZ).inverse ≅
      (supportedDerivedProperty X Z).ι ⋙ derivedSupportedSectionsOnClosed X Z hZ
declarations.comment: part (2): the quasi-inverse is RℋZ restricted to D_Z

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SupportedComplexes.derivedPushforwardSupportedSections_isRightAdjoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEF, part (3).** The functor `D(𝒪_X) ⥤ D_Z(𝒪_X)` given by `K ↦ i_* RH_Z(K)` —
`RH_Z` followed by derived pushforward, which lands in `D_Z(𝒪_X)` by part (1) — is right adjoint
to the inclusion `D_Z(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_X)`.

This is the formal consequence of part (2) and Stacks 0A3B (1) that [Stacks, Tag 0AEF] says it
is: by part (2) the inclusion is the quasi-inverse of `i_*^D : D(𝒪_X|_Z) ≌ D_Z(𝒪_X)` followed by
`i_*^D`, so composing that equivalence with the adjunction `i_*^D ⊣ RH_Z` of Stacks 0A3B (1)
exhibits the inclusion as a left adjoint; see `iotaAdjunctionOfCounitIso`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedPushforwardSupportedSections_isRightAdjoint (X : RingedSpace.{u, u})
    (Z : Set X.carrier) (hZ : IsClosed Z) :
    (supportedDerivedProperty X Z).ι ⊣
      derivedSupportedSectionsOnClosed X Z hZ ⋙ derivedPushforwardToSupported X Z hZ
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SupportedComplexes.derivedSupportedSectionsIsoDerivedModulePullback
declarations.doc:
On the full subcategory `D_Z(𝒪_X)` of complexes with cohomology sheaves supported on the closed
subset `Z`, the right derived functor `RH_Z` of sections supported on `Z` agrees with inverse image
`i^{-1}` along the inclusion.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSupportedSectionsIsoDerivedModulePullback (X : RingedSpace.{u, u})
    (Z : Set X.carrier) (hZ : IsClosed Z) :
    (letI := preservesFiniteLimits_modulePullback_closedSubsetInclusion X Z
    letI := preservesFiniteColimits_modulePullback (closedSubsetInclusion X Z)
    (supportedDerivedProperty X Z).ι ⋙ derivedSupportedSectionsOnClosed X Z hZ ≅
      (supportedDerivedProperty X Z).ι ⋙
        (modulePullback (closedSubsetInclusion X Z)).mapDerivedCategory)
declarations.comment: part (2): on D_Z the quasi-inverse RℋZ agrees with i⁻¹

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SupportedComplexes.closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence_inverse_iso_derivedModulePullback
declarations.doc:
The quasi-inverse of the equivalence `i_*^D : D(𝒪_X|_Z) ≌ D_Z(𝒪_X)` is inverse image `i^{-1}`
restricted to `D_Z(𝒪_X)`.
declarations.statement:
def closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence_inverse_iso_derivedModulePullback
    (X : RingedSpace.{u, u}) (Z : Set X.carrier) (hZ : IsClosed Z) :
    (letI := preservesFiniteLimits_modulePullback_closedSubsetInclusion X Z
    letI := preservesFiniteColimits_modulePullback (closedSubsetInclusion X Z)
    (closedSubsetDerivedPushforwardEquivalence X Z hZ).inverse ≅
      (supportedDerivedProperty X Z).ι ⋙
        (modulePullback (closedSubsetInclusion X Z)).mapDerivedCategory)
declarations.comment: part (2): the quasi-inverse is i⁻¹ restricted to D_Z

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.SupportedComplexes.pushforward_supported
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEF, part (1).** For `K` in the derived category of `𝒪_X|_Z`-modules, the
cohomology sheaves of `i_* K` are supported on `Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem pushforward_supported (X : RingedSpace.{u, u}) (Z : Set X.carrier) (hZ : IsClosed Z)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPushforwardComposition.ModuleSheaves
      (closedSubsetRingedSpace X Z))) :
    letI := pushforward_preservesFiniteLimits X Z
    letI := pushforward_preservesFiniteColimits X Z hZ
    AlgebraicGeometry.CohomologySupportedOn (structureSheafRing X) Z
      ((modulePushforward (closedSubsetInclusion X Z)).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.closedImmersionSupportedDerivedEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEG.** Let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion of schemes.  Direct image of abelian
sheaves along `i` is exact, so `Ri_{small,*} = i_{small,*} : D(Z_étale) ⟶ D(X_étale)`, and it
induces an equivalence of `D(Z_étale)` with the full subcategory `D_Z(X_étale)` of `D(X_étale)`
of complexes whose cohomology sheaves are supported on `Z`.  A quasi-inverse of that equivalence
is given on `D_Z(X_étale)` by the exact inverse image `i_{small}^{-1}`, and also by the right
derived functor `Rℋ_Z` of sections with support in `Z`.
declarations.statement:
public def closedImmersionSupportedDerivedEquivalence :
    ClosedImmersionSupportedDerivedEquivalence.{w₁, w₂} B i

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtalePushforward_exact_ab
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEG.** Direct image of abelian sheaves along a closed immersion is exact, so it
coincides with its own right derived functor: `Ri_{small,*} = i_{small,*}`.
declarations.comment: Ri_* = i_* : direct image is exact, hence equal to its right derived functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEG.** Direct image along a closed immersion induces an equivalence of
`D(Z_étale)` with the full subcategory `D_Z(X_étale)` of `D(X_étale)` of complexes whose
cohomology sheaves are supported on `Z`.
declarations.statement:
public def smallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence :
    DerivedCategory (SmallEtaleAbelianSheaf B Z) ≌ SupportedDerivedCategory.{w₂} B i
declarations.comment: i_* induces an equivalence D(Z_étale) → D_Z(X_étale)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence_functor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEG.** The equivalence is given by direct image: composed with the inclusion of
`D_Z(X_étale)` into `D(X_étale)` it is the functor induced by `i_*`.
declarations.comment: the equivalence is induced by i_*

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.smallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence_inverse
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEG.** The quasi-inverse of the equivalence is inverse image restricted to
`D_Z(X_étale)`: `i^{-1}|_{D_Z(X_étale)}`.
declarations.comment: the quasi-inverse is i^{-1} restricted to D_Z(X_étale)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportOfSheaf_subset_of_essImage_of_isIntegralHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, part (2), one inclusion of the essential image.** An abelian sheaf on the
small étale site of `X` isomorphic to a small étale direct image along an integral morphism
`f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over `S` is supported on the image of the point set of `Y`.

An isomorphism of abelian sheaves is locally surjective, so by part (5) of Stacks 04KB it does
not enlarge the support, and the support of the direct image is bounded by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportOfSheaf_smallEtaleAbelianPushforward_subset_of_isIntegralHom`.

Universal injectivity of `f`, which Stacks 0AEH also assumes, is not used: this inclusion holds
for every integral morphism. It is one inclusion of the clause and carries no tag; the clause
itself is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePushforwardAb_essImage_iff_of_integral_universallyInjective`.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportOfSheaf_subset_of_essImage_of_isIntegralHom (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) (F : abelianSheaves.{w} B S hS X)
    (hF : (smallEtaleAbelianPushforward B S hS f
      ((isIntegralHom_iff_representable B S hS f.hom Y.property X.property).mp hf).1).essImage
        F) :
    supportOfSheaf B S hS X.1 F ⊆ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Y.1 f.hom)
declarations.comment: part (2), the inclusion only: a sheaf in the essential image of f_{small,*} is supported on f(|Y|), for an integral morphism and with no universal injectivity needed. The converse inclusion, and with it the full iff of part (2), is AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePushforwardAb_essImage_iff_of_integral_universallyInjective; part (1) is ...smallEtalePushforward_essImage_iff_of_integral_universallyInjective. Both are proved at the source's own hypotheses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePushforwardAb_essImage_iff_of_integral_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, part (2), the essential image.** For an integral and universally injective
morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, an abelian sheaf on the small étale
site of `X` lies in the essential image of the direct image along `f` exactly when its support
is contained in the image of the point set of `Y`.

The forward inclusion is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.supportOfSheaf_subset_of_essImage_of_isIntegralHom`, resting on Étale
Cohomology 04FX for algebraic spaces, and the converse is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_unit_app_of_supportOfSheaf_subset_of_isIntegralHom` together with
the characterization of the essential image of a fully faithful right adjoint by invertibility
of the unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtalePushforwardAb_essImage_iff_of_integral_universallyInjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) (hui : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    (smallEtaleAbelianPushforward.{u + 1} B S hS f
        (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).essImage F ↔
      supportOfSheaf B S hS X.1 F ⊆ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Y.1 f.hom)
declarations.comment: part (2): the essential image, for an integral and universally injective morphism of algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePushforward_essImage_iff_of_integral_universallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, part (1), the essential image.** For an integral and universally injective
morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, a sheaf of sets on the small étale
site of `X` lies in the essential image of the direct image along `f` exactly when its
restriction to the open complement of the image of the point set of `Y` is the singleton sheaf.

One direction is Étale Cohomology 04FX for sheaves of sets,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isTerminal_inverseImage_pushforward_integralComplement`. For the other,
the direct image is fully faithful, so membership of the essential image is invertibility of the
unit `F ⟶ f_*f^{-1}F`; the unit becomes invertible under `f^{-1}` by the triangle identity and
under restriction to the complement because both sides are then the singleton sheaf, and a map
of sheaves of sets invertible on both is invertible, every geometric point of `X` lying either
on the image of `f` or on its complement.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtalePushforward_essImage_iff_of_integral_universallyInjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) (hui : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1) (Type (u + 1))) :
    (smallToposMorphism B S hS f).pushforward.essImage F ↔
      Nonempty (IsTerminal ((smallToposMorphism B S hS
        (integralComplementHom B S hS f hf)).inverseImage.obj F))
declarations.comment: part (1): the essential image, for an integral and universally injective morphism of algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithfulSmallEtaleSetPushforwardOfIntegralUniversallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, part (1), full faithfulness.** For an integral and universally injective
morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, the direct image of sheaves of sets
along `f` — restriction along the chart base-change morphism of small étale sites of
Stacks 03G2, part (4) — is fully faithful, at any coefficient universe.
declarations.statement:
def fullyFaithfulSmallEtaleSetPushforwardOfIntegralUniversallyInjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) (hui : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).toIsContinuous
    ((smallBaseChange B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        (Type w) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1)).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: part (1): full faithfulness of the direct image on sheaves of sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithfulSmallEtalePushforwardOfIntegralUniversallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, part (1), full faithfulness, through the morphism of small étale topoi.**
For an integral and universally injective morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S`, the direct image of sheaves of sets along the morphism of small étale topoi of
Stacks 03G2, part (3) is fully faithful.

By Stacks 03G8 that direct image is restriction along chart base change, so this is the
previous statement read through an identification and not a new proof.
declarations.comment: part (1): the direct image of the morphism of small étale topoi is fully faithful

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleAdjunctionCounitIsIsoOfIntegralUniversallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, the trailing clause, for sheaves of sets.** For an integral and universally
injective morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` the counit
`f^{-1}f_*\mathcal{G} ⟶ \mathcal{G}` of the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction on sheaves of
sets is an isomorphism: the inverse image is a left inverse of the direct image.

The counit of an adjunction is an isomorphism exactly when the right adjoint is fully
faithful.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleAdjunctionCounitIsIsoOfIntegralUniversallyInjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) (hui : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom)
    (G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (Type (max (u + 1) v))) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).toIsContinuous
    IsIso (((smallBaseChange B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).sheafAdjunctionContinuous
        (Type (max (u + 1) v)) (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1)).counit.app G)
declarations.comment: trailing clause for sheaves of sets: the inverse image is a left inverse

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePullbackPushforwardCounitIsoOfIntegralUniversallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, the trailing clause, for sheaves of sets, as a natural isomorphism.** For an
integral and universally injective morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`
the counit of the adjunction of the morphism of small étale topoi of Stacks 03G2, part (3) is a
natural isomorphism `f_* ⋙ f^{-1} ≅ 𝟭`.
declarations.statement:
def smallEtalePullbackPushforwardCounitIsoOfIntegralUniversallyInjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) (hui : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom) :
    (smallToposMorphismTypeU B S hS f).pushforward ⋙
        (smallToposMorphismTypeU B S hS f).inverseImage ≅
      𝟭 (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) (Type u))
declarations.comment: trailing clause for sheaves of sets, as a natural isomorphism f_* f^{-1} ≅ 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithfulSmallEtaleAbelianPushforwardOfIntegralUniversallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, part (2), full faithfulness.** For an integral and universally injective
morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, the direct image of sheaves of
*abelian groups* along `f` is fully faithful.

Full faithfulness of restriction along a cover-dense, locally full, continuous functor does not
depend on the category of coefficients, so this is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithfulSmallEtaleRestrictionOfIntegralUniversallyInjective` at
the category of abelian groups.
declarations.statement:
def fullyFaithfulSmallEtaleAbelianPushforwardOfIntegralUniversallyInjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) (hui : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).toIsContinuous
    ((smallBaseChange B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{w} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1)).FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: part (2): full faithfulness of the direct image on abelian sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePushforwardAbIsRightAdjointOfIntegralUniversallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, part (2), existence of the inverse image.** For an integral morphism
`f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, the direct image of abelian sheaves along
`f` is a right adjoint, so that the inverse image of part (2) exists.

Universal injectivity is not used: representability is all this needs.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtalePushforwardAbIsRightAdjointOfIntegralUniversallyInjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).toIsContinuous
    Nonempty (((smallBaseChange B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1)).IsRightAdjoint)
declarations.comment: part (2): the direct image of abelian sheaves has the inverse image as left adjoint

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleAdjunctionCounitIsIsoAbelianOfIntegralUniversallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, the trailing clause, for abelian sheaves.** For an integral and universally
injective morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` the counit of the
inverse-image/direct-image adjunction on abelian sheaves is an isomorphism: the inverse image is
a left inverse of the direct image.

The adjunction is the one whose existence is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtalePushforwardAbIsRightAdjointOfIntegralUniversallyInjective`,
as in the source, where part (2) presupposes it.
declarations.statement:
theorem smallEtaleAdjunctionCounitIsIsoAbelianOfIntegralUniversallyInjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) (hui : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom)
    (G : Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v}) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).toIsContinuous
    letI := Classical.choice (smallEtalePushforwardAb_isRightAdjoint.{v} B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf))
    IsIso (((smallBaseChange B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).sheafAdjunctionContinuous
        AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
        (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1)).counit.app G)
declarations.comment: trailing clause for abelian sheaves: the inverse image is a left inverse

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleAbelianPullbackPushforwardCounitIsoOfIntegralUniversallyInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEH, the trailing clause, for abelian sheaves, as a natural isomorphism.** For an
integral and universally injective morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`
the counit of the adjunction of `CategoryTheory.Functor.sheafAdjunctionContinuous` for chart
base change is a natural isomorphism `f_* ⋙ f^{-1} ≅ 𝟭`.
declarations.statement:
def smallEtaleAbelianPullbackPushforwardCounitIsoOfIntegralUniversallyInjective (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hf : IsIntegralHom B S hS f.hom) (hui : UniversallyInjective B S hS f.hom) :
    letI := (smallBaseChange_isMorphismOfSites B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).toIsContinuous
    letI := Classical.choice (smallEtalePushforwardAb_isRightAdjoint.{v} B S hS f
      (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf))
    (smallBaseChange B S hS f
        (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).sheafPushforwardContinuous
          AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) ⋙
      (smallBaseChange B S hS f
        (relativelyRepresentable_of_isIntegralHom B S hS f hf)).sheafPullback
          AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v} (SmallEtale.topology B S hS X.1)
          (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) ≅
      𝟭 (Sheaf (SmallEtale.topology B S hS Y.1) AddCommGrpCat.{max (u + 1) v})
declarations.comment: trailing clause for abelian sheaves, as a natural isomorphism f_* f^{-1} ≅ 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence_inverse_derivedSectionsWithSupport
declarations.doc:
**The quasi-inverse is the derived sections with support.** The quasi-inverse of the
equivalence `D(Z_étale) ≌ D_{|Z|}(X_étale)` induced by the direct image along a closed immersion
`i : Z ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over `S` is the derived functor `R𝓗_Z` of sections with support
in `|Z|`, restricted to `D_{|Z|}(X_étale)`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence_inverse_derivedSectionsWithSupport :
    (derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence B S hS i hi).inverse ≅
      (cohomologySupportedOn.{u + 1} B S hS X
          (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.1 i.hom))).ι ⋙
        derivedSectionsWithSupportOnClosedSubspace B S hS i hi
declarations.comment: the identification of the quasi-inverse with the derived sections with support R𝓗_Z, the second description in the displayed formula

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedSmallEtaleInverseImage_iso_derivedSectionsWithSupport_of_supported
declarations.doc:
**The inverse image agrees with the derived sections with support.** On the subcategory
`D_{|Z|}(X_étale)` of complexes of abelian sheaves whose cohomology sheaves are supported on the
point set of a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X`, the inverse image `i^{-1}` and the derived functor
`R𝓗_Z` of sections with support in `|Z|` agree:

`i^{-1}|_{D_Z(X_étale)} = R𝓗_Z|_{D_{|Z|}(X_étale)}`.

Both are the quasi-inverse of the equivalence
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSmallEtaleInverseImage_iso_derivedSectionsWithSupport_of_supported :
    letI := additive_smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B S hS i hi.rep
    letI := preservesFiniteLimits_smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B S hS i hi.rep
    letI := preservesFiniteColimits_smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B S hS i hi.rep
    (cohomologySupportedOn.{u + 1} B S hS X
          (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.1 i.hom))).ι ⋙
        (smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B S hS i hi.rep).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (cohomologySupportedOn.{u + 1} B S hS X
          (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.1 i.hom))).ι ⋙
        derivedSectionsWithSupportOnClosedSubspace B S hS i hi
declarations.comment: the displayed equality i^{-1}|_{D_Z} = R𝓗_Z|_{D_{|Z|}} of the two descriptions of the quasi-inverse

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRightDerivedFunctor_mapDerivedCategory_smallEtaleAbelianPushforward
declarations.doc:
**`Ri_* = i_*`.** For a closed immersion `i`, the degreewise action of the direct image
`i_*` on unbounded derived categories is the right derived functor `Ri_*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRightDerivedFunctor_mapDerivedCategory_smallEtaleAbelianPushforward :
    letI := preservesFiniteColimits_smallEtaleAbelianPushforward_of_isClosedImmersion B S hS i hi
    (smallEtaleAbelianPushforward.{u + 1} B S hS i hi.rep).mapDerivedCategory.IsRightDerivedFunctor
      (smallEtaleAbelianPushforward.{u + 1} B S hS i hi.rep).mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
declarations.comment: Ri_* = i_*, the pushforward along a closed immersion being its own right derived functor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fullyFaithfulDerivedSmallEtaleAbelianPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEI: the pushforward is fully faithful.** For a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` of
algebraic spaces over `S` the functor `D(Z_étale) ⥤ D(X_étale)` induced by the exact direct
image `i_*` of abelian sheaves is fully faithful.
declarations.statement:
def fullyFaithfulDerivedSmallEtaleAbelianPushforward :
    letI := additive_smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B S hS i hi.rep
    letI := preservesFiniteColimits_smallEtaleAbelianPushforward_of_isClosedImmersion B S hS i hi
    (smallEtaleAbelianPushforward.{u + 1} B S hS i hi.rep).mapDerivedCategory.FullyFaithful
declarations.comment: full faithfulness of the pushforward

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.essImage_mapDerivedCategory_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEI: essential surjectivity onto the supported subcategory.** A complex of abelian
sheaves on the small étale site of `X` all of whose cohomology sheaves are supported on the
point set of a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` is isomorphic in `D(X_étale)` to the direct image of
a complex on `Z_étale`.
declarations.statement:
theorem essImage_mapDerivedCategory_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (K : smallEtaleDerivedCategory.{u + 1} B S hS X)
    (hK : cohomologySupportedOn.{u + 1} B S hS X
      (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.1 i.hom)) K) :
    letI := preservesFiniteColimits_smallEtaleAbelianPushforward_of_isClosedImmersion B S hS i hi
    (smallEtaleAbelianPushforward.{u + 1} B S hS i hi.rep).mapDerivedCategory.essImage K
declarations.comment: essential surjectivity onto the supported subcategory

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEI: the equivalence.** Direct image along a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` of
algebraic spaces over `S` induces an equivalence of `D(Z_étale)` with the full subcategory
`D_{|Z|}(X_étale)` of `D(X_étale)` of complexes whose cohomology sheaves are all supported on
the point set of `Z`.
declarations.comment: the equivalence of D(Z_étale) with D_{|Z|}(X_étale)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence_functor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEI: the equivalence is induced by the pushforward.** Composed with the inclusion
of `D_{|Z|}(X_étale)` into `D(X_étale)`, the forward functor of the equivalence is the functor
induced by the exact direct image `i_*`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence_functor :
    letI := preservesFiniteColimits_smallEtaleAbelianPushforward_of_isClosedImmersion B S hS i hi
    (derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence B S hS i hi).functor ⋙
        (cohomologySupportedOn.{u + 1} B S hS X (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.1 i.hom))).ι ≅
      (smallEtaleAbelianPushforward.{u + 1} B S hS i hi.rep).mapDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: the equivalence is induced by the pushforward

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence_inverse
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEI: the quasi-inverse is the inverse image.** The quasi-inverse of the
equivalence is the functor induced by the exact inverse image `i^{-1}`, restricted to
`D_{|Z|}(X_étale)`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence_inverse :
    letI := additive_smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B S hS i hi.rep
    letI := preservesFiniteLimits_smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B S hS i hi.rep
    letI := preservesFiniteColimits_smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B S hS i hi.rep
    (derivedSmallEtalePushforwardSupportedEquivalence B S hS i hi).inverse ≅
      (cohomologySupportedOn.{u + 1} B S hS X
          (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.1 i.hom))).ι ⋙
        (smallEtaleAbelianInverseImage B S hS i hi.rep).mapDerivedCategory
declarations.comment: the identification of the quasi-inverse with the inverse image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isOpenSubspace_isClosedSubspace_isFinite_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEJ.** Let `h : X ⟶ Y`, `f : X ⟶ T` and `g : Y ⟶ T` be morphisms of algebraic
spaces over `S` with `h ≫ g = f`, with `f` proper and `g` separated and locally of finite type,
and let `b ∈ |T|` be represented by a field-valued point `p` with field of definition `k`. If
the image of `|X_k|` in `|Y_k|` is finite, or if `T` is decent and the image in `|Y|` of the
set-theoretic fibre of `f` over `b` is finite, then `b` has an open neighbourhood `U ⊆ T` and
`X ×_T U ⟶ Y ×_T U` factors through a closed subspace of `Y ×_T U` which is finite over `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isOpenSubspace_isClosedSubspace_isFinite_of_isProper
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T) (h : X ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ T) (g : Y ⟶ T)
    (comm : h ≫ g = f) (b : points B S hS T) (p : FieldValuedPoint B S hS T)
    (hp : p.class B S hS T = b) (hf : IsProper B S hS f)
    (hg_sep : IsSeparated B S hS g) (hg_lft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g)
    (hfinite :
      Set.Finite (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (pullback f (fieldMorphism B S hS T p))
        (pullback.map f (fieldMorphism B S hS T p) g (fieldMorphism B S hS T p) h
          (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp [comm]) (by simp)))) ∨
      (Set.Finite (pointsMap B S hS X h ''
          {x : points B S hS X | pointsMap B S hS X f x = b}) ∧
        IsDecentSpace B S hS T)) :
    ∃ U : Subfunctor T,
      IsOpenSubspace B S hS U ∧
      b ∈ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS U.toFunctor U.ι) ∧
      ∃ Z : Subfunctor (pullback g U.ι),
        IsClosedSubspace B S hS Z ∧
        (∃ m : pullback f U.ι ⟶ Z.toFunctor, m ≫ Z.ι =
          pullback.map f U.ι g U.ι h (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp [comm]) (by simp)) ∧
        IsFinite B S hS (Z.ι ≫ pullback.snd g U.ι)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_factorization_of_dense_open
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEL.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : X ⟶ Z` be morphisms of algebraic spaces over an
algebraic space `T` with `Y ⟶ T` separated and `g` surjective, flat and locally of finite
presentation. If there is a scheme-theoretically dense open subspace `V ⊆ Z` such that the
restriction of `f` to `g⁻¹(V)` factors through `V` over `T`, then `f` factors through `g`
over `T`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_factorization_of_dense_open
    {T X Y Z : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T) (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Z)
    (pX : X ⟶ T) (pY : Y ⟶ T) (pZ : Z ⟶ T) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z)
    (hf : f ≫ pY = pX) (hg : g ≫ pZ = pX)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS pY)
    (hsurj : IsSurjective B S hS g) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS g)
    (hlfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS g)
    (V : Subfunctor Z) (hV : IsOpenSubspace B S hS V)
    (hdense : IsSchemeTheoreticallyDense B S hS V)
    (hfactor : ∃ v : V.toFunctor ⟶ Y,
      (v ≫ pY = V.ι ≫ pZ) ∧
      (pullback.fst g V.ι ≫ f = pullback.snd g V.ι ≫ v)) :
    ∃ h : Z ⟶ Y, (g ≫ h = f) ∧ (h ≫ pY = pZ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_coordinateProjection_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEM.** Let `k` be a field, let `n` be a positive integer, let `Z` be an algebraic
space over `Spec k` separated and of finite type over `Spec k` and let `w : (ℙ¹_k)^n ⟶ Z`. Then
`w` factors as the projection onto the coordinates in some subset `I ⊆ Fin n` followed by a
finite morphism.

The contraction step is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_coordinateProjection_finite_fibres`, and a morphism out of a
finite power of the projective line all of whose fibres on points are finite is finite by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isFinite_of_finite_fibres`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_coordinateProjection_isFinite (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (Z : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hZ : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk Z)
    (z : Z ⟶ yoneda.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hk)) : BigFppfOver B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk))
    (hsep : IsSeparated B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk z)
    (hft : IsFiniteType B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk z)
    (w : projectiveLinePower k B hk (Fin n) ⟶ Z) :
    ∃ (I : Finset (Fin n)) (g : projectiveLinePower k B hk I ⟶ Z),
      w = coordinateProjection k B hk n I ≫ g ∧
        IsFinite B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.morphism_projectiveLine_constant
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEN.** Let `k` be a field and let `G` be a separated group algebraic space locally
of finite type over `k`. Every morphism from the projective line over `k` to `G` over `Spec k`
is constant: it factors through a section of the structure morphism of `G`.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.morphism_projectiveLine_eq_constant` with its hypothesis
`h0AEMfibres` — the contraction step of [Stacks, Tag 0AEM] — supplied by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_coordinateProjection_finite_fibres`.
declarations.statement:
theorem morphism_projectiveLine_constant
    (G : GroupAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk
      (yoneda.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hk))))
      (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk _))
    (hsep : IsSeparatedOver B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk G.obj.X.left)
    (hft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hk G.obj.X.hom)
    (f : projectiveLineOverBase k B hk ⟶ G.obj.X) :
    ∃ c : yoneda.obj (Over.mk (𝟙 (B.obj hk))) ⟶ G.obj.X.left,
      c ≫ G.obj.X.hom = 𝟙 _ ∧
        f.left = (projectiveLineOverBase k B hk).hom ≫ c

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.stalkDerivedPushforwardIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEQ.** Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, let
`i : Z ⟶ X` and `i' : W ⟶ Y` be closed immersions and let `f' : W ⟶ Z` be an integral
universally injective morphism making the square commute — in the source `W = f^{-1}Z` and `f'`
is the base change of `f`. Let `ȳ` be a geometric point of `Y` lying on `W` and let
`x̄ = f(ȳ)`. For an object `Q` of `D(Y_étale)` all of whose cohomology sheaves are supported on
`|W|`, the stalk at `x̄` of `Rf_*Q` is the stalk at `ȳ` of `Q`.
declarations.statement:
def stalkDerivedPushforwardIso
    [RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor unit
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (d : DerivedPushforwardSquareData B S hS i hi i' hi' f' hf' hf'int hf'inj RF)
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS Y.1) (w : GeometricPoint B S hS W.1)
    (hw : geometricPointMap i'.hom w = y) (Q : smallEtaleDerivedCategory.{u + 1} B S hS Y)
    (hQ : cohomologySupportedOn.{u + 1} B S hS Y
      (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS W.1 i'.hom)) Q) :
    (smallEtaleDerivedAbelianStalk B S hS (geometricPointMap f.hom y)).obj (RF.obj Q) ≅
      (smallEtaleDerivedAbelianStalk B S hS y).obj Q
declarations.comment: the comparison isomorphism, for a commutative (not necessarily cartesian) square and a geometric point of Y lifted to the closed subspace, on the two carried inputs 0AEH part (1) and 015N bundled as DerivedPushforwardSquareData

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.stalkDerivedPushforwardIso_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEQ: the comparison is natural.** The identification
`(Rf_*Q)_{x̄} ≅ Q_ȳ` is natural in the complex `Q` supported on `|W|`.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalkDerivedPushforwardIso_naturality
    [RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor unit
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (d : DerivedPushforwardSquareData B S hS i hi i' hi' f' hf' hf'int hf'inj RF)
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS Y.1) (w : GeometricPoint B S hS W.1)
    (hw : geometricPointMap i'.hom w = y)
    {Q Q' : smallEtaleDerivedCategory.{u + 1} B S hS Y}
    (hQ : cohomologySupportedOn.{u + 1} B S hS Y
      (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS W.1 i'.hom)) Q)
    (hQ' : cohomologySupportedOn.{u + 1} B S hS Y
      (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS W.1 i'.hom)) Q') (g : Q ⟶ Q') :
    (smallEtaleDerivedAbelianStalk B S hS (geometricPointMap f.hom y)).map (RF.map g) ≫
        (stalkDerivedPushforwardIso B S hS f hfr i hi i' hi' f' hf' hf'int hf'inj hsq RF unit d
          y w hw Q' hQ').hom =
      (stalkDerivedPushforwardIso B S hS f hfr i hi i' hi' f' hf' hf'int hf'inj hsq RF unit d
          y w hw Q hQ).hom ≫
        (smallEtaleDerivedAbelianStalk B S hS y).map g
declarations.comment: naturality of the comparison isomorphism in the supported complex

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.stalkRightDerivedDirectImageIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEQ.** Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, let
`i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion and let `f^{-1}Z` be its inverse image, a cartesian square
`sq` with `f' : f^{-1}Z ⟶ Z` and `i' : f^{-1}Z ⟶ Y`, such that `f'` is integral and universally
injective. Let `ȳ` be a geometric point of `Y` and `x̄ = f(ȳ)`. Then for every object `Q` of
`D(Y_étale)` supported on `|f^{-1}Z|` there is an isomorphism `(Rf_*Q)_{x̄} ≅ Q_ȳ` in `D(Ab)`,
where `Rf_*` is any total right derived functor of the direct image of abelian sheaves along `f`
and the derived categories are arbitrary models.
declarations.statement:
def stalkRightDerivedDirectImageIso (f : Y ⟶ X) (i : Z ⟶ X) (hi : IsClosedImmersion B S hS i.hom)
    (i' : W ⟶ Y) (f' : W ⟶ Z) (sq : IsPullback f' i' i f) (hf'int : IsIntegralHom B S hS f'.hom)
    (hf'inj : UniversallyInjective B S hS f'.hom)
    (RF : DerivedCategory (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS X))
    (α : (smallEtaleAbelianDirectImage B S hS f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF)
    [RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor α
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS Y.1)
    (Q : DerivedCategory (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y))
    (hQ : ∀ n : ℤ, supportOfSheaf B S hS Y.1
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) n).obj Q) ⊆
        Set.range (pointsMap B S hS W.1 i'.hom)) :
    (smallEtaleAbelianStalk B S hS (geometricPointMap f.hom y)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (RF.obj Q) ≅
      (smallEtaleAbelianStalk B S hS y).mapDerivedCategory.obj Q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.stalkRightDerivedDirectImageIso_naturality
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEQ: the comparison is natural** in the complex `Q` supported on `|f^{-1}Z|`,
being the value at `Q` of an isomorphism of functors.
declarations.statement:
theorem stalkRightDerivedDirectImageIso_naturality (f : Y ⟶ X) (i : Z ⟶ X)
    (hi : IsClosedImmersion B S hS i.hom)
    (i' : W ⟶ Y) (f' : W ⟶ Z) (sq : IsPullback f' i' i f) (hf'int : IsIntegralHom B S hS f'.hom)
    (hf'inj : UniversallyInjective B S hS f'.hom)
    (RF : DerivedCategory (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS X))
    (α : (smallEtaleAbelianDirectImage B S hS f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ RF)
    [RF.IsRightDerivedFunctor α
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS Y.1)
    {Q Q' : DerivedCategory (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y)}
    (hQ : ∀ n : ℤ, supportOfSheaf B S hS Y.1
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) n).obj Q) ⊆
        Set.range (pointsMap B S hS W.1 i'.hom))
    (hQ' : ∀ n : ℤ, supportOfSheaf B S hS Y.1
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) n).obj Q') ⊆
        Set.range (pointsMap B S hS W.1 i'.hom)) (g : Q ⟶ Q') :
    (smallEtaleAbelianStalk B S hS (geometricPointMap f.hom y)).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (RF.map g) ≫
        (stalkRightDerivedDirectImageIso B S hS f i hi i' f' sq hf'int hf'inj RF α y Q' hQ').hom =
      (stalkRightDerivedDirectImageIso B S hS f i hi i' f' sq hf'int hf'inj RF α y Q hQ).hom ≫
        (smallEtaleAbelianStalk B S hS y).mapDerivedCategory.map g
declarations.comment: naturality of the comparison in the supported complex

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_kernelMap_and_mono_cokernelMap_directImageStalkMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AER.** Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` and
let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subspace such that `f^{-1}Z ⟶ Z` is integral and universally
injective. Let `ȳ` be a geometric point of `Y`, let `x̄ = f(ȳ)` and let `G` be an abelian sheaf
on the small étale site of `Y`. Writing `V = Y ∖ f^{-1}Z` and `j' : V ⟶ Y` for the inclusion,
the map of two-term complexes
```
((f_*G)_x̄ ⟶ (f_*(j'_*(G|_V)))_x̄) ⟶ (G_ȳ ⟶ (j'_*(G|_V))_ȳ)
```
given by the canonical comparison of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.smallEtaleAbelianDirectImageStalkMap` induces an isomorphism on
kernels and an injection on cokernels.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_kernelMap_and_mono_cokernelMap_directImageStalkMap (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (Z : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X.1)
    (hint : IsIntegralHom B S hS (Z.1.fromPreimage f.hom))
    (hinj : UniversallyInjective B S hS (Z.1.fromPreimage f.hom))
    (y : GeometricPoint B S hS Y.1) (G : abelianSheaves.{u + 1} B S hS Y) :
    IsIso (kernel.map
        ((smallEtaleAbelianDirectImage B S hS f ⋙
            smallEtaleAbelianStalk B S hS (geometricPointMap f.hom y)).map
          (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionUnit B S hS f Z G))
        ((smallEtaleAbelianStalk B S hS y).map
          (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionUnit B S hS f Z G))
        ((smallEtaleAbelianDirectImageStalkMap B S hS f y).app G)
        ((smallEtaleAbelianDirectImageStalkMap B S hS f y).app
          (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionPushforward B S hS f Z G))
        ((smallEtaleAbelianDirectImageStalkMap B S hS f y).naturality
          (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionUnit B S hS f Z G))) ∧
      Mono (cokernel.map
        ((smallEtaleAbelianDirectImage B S hS f ⋙
            smallEtaleAbelianStalk B S hS (geometricPointMap f.hom y)).map
          (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionUnit B S hS f Z G))
        ((smallEtaleAbelianStalk B S hS y).map
          (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionUnit B S hS f Z G))
        ((smallEtaleAbelianDirectImageStalkMap B S hS f y).app G)
        ((smallEtaleAbelianDirectImageStalkMap B S hS f y).app
          (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionPushforward B S hS f Z G))
        ((smallEtaleAbelianDirectImageStalkMap B S hS f y).naturality
          (smallEtaleAbelianRestrictionUnit B S hS f Z G)))
declarations.comment:
isomorphism on kernels and injection on cokernels of the two-term stalk
  complexes, for an arbitrary morphism of algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_geometricModuleStalkGerm_modulePushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AES, the generation half of the colimit form.**  Every element of the geometric
stalk `(f_*G)_{x̄}` is the germ at `x̄` of a section of `p_V^*G` on `Y ×_X V`, for some small
étale neighbourhood `V` of `x̄`: that section is a compatible family of sections of `G` over the
étale scheme charts of `Y` above `Y ×_X V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_geometricModuleStalkGerm_modulePushforward (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (z : geometricModuleStalk B S hS X x ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj G)) :
    ∃ (N : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (a : (directImageChartDiagram B S hS f G N.chart).sections),
      geometricModuleStalkGerm B S hS X x ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj G) N
        ((directImageChartSectionsEquiv B S hS f G N.chart).symm a) = z
declarations.comment:
generation half, for the geometric point stalk expressed as the filtered colimit
over the etale neighbourhoods of x-bar, with the sections on Y times_X V read chartwise; the
canonical morphism Spec(O_{X, x-bar}) -> X is not constructed, since the etale local ring lives
one universe up and its spectrum is not an object of the site, so neither the source's formula
nor its quasi-compact, quasi-separated and quasi-coherent hypotheses appear

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.geometricModuleStalkGerm_modulePushforward_eq_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AES, the separation half of the colimit form.**  Two sections of the direct image
`f_*G` over the chart of a small étale neighbourhood `N` of `x̄` have the same germ in the
geometric stalk `(f_*G)_{x̄}` exactly when, for some smaller neighbourhood `V`, their chartwise
sections of `G` over the étale scheme charts of `Y` above `Y ×_X V` agree — that is, exactly
when they agree in `Γ(Y ×_X V, p_V^*G)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem geometricModuleStalkGerm_modulePushforward_eq_iff (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (N : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x)
    (s t : ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj G).val.obj (op N.chart)) :
    geometricModuleStalkGerm B S hS X x ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj G) N s =
        geometricModuleStalkGerm B S hS X x ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj G) N t ↔
      ∃ (M : SmallEtaleNeighborhood x) (g : M ⟶ N), ∀ j,
        directImageChartSection B S hS f G M.chart j
            (((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj G).val.map g.hom.op s) =
          directImageChartSection B S hS f G M.chart j
            (((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj G).val.map g.hom.op t)
declarations.comment:
separation half, for the geometric point stalk expressed as the filtered colimit
over the etale neighbourhoods of x-bar, with the sections on Y times_X V read chartwise; the
canonical morphism Spec(O_{X, x-bar}) -> X is not constructed, since the etale local ring lives
one universe up and its spectrum is not an object of the site, so neither the source's formula
nor its quasi-compact, quasi-separated and quasi-coherent hypotheses appear

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.directImageGeometricStalkAddEquiv
declarations.doc:
**The stalk of a direct image at a geometric point, over the strict henselization.**  Let `X`
be an algebraic space over `S`, `f : Y ⟶ X` a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism, `x̄` a
geometric point of `X` and `h : Spec(𝒪_{X, x̄}) ⟶ X` the canonical morphism
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.strictHenselizationSpaceHom`).  For a quasi-coherent `𝒪_Y`-module `𝒢`,

`(f_*𝒢)_{x̄} = Γ(Y ×_X Spec(𝒪_{X, x̄}), p^*𝒢)`,

where `p : Y ×_X Spec(𝒪_{X, x̄}) ⟶ Y` is the projection: the geometric stalk of the direct image
is identified, as an abelian group, with the global sections of the pullback of `𝒢` to the base
change of `Y` to the strict henselization.  (The source prints `p^*𝓕` for `p^*𝒢`.)

The identification is the composite of: the stalk of `f_*𝒢` at `x̄ = h ∘ t̄` with the stalk of
`h^*f_*𝒢` at the closed point `t̄` (Stacks 05VQ and the bijectivity of
`𝒪_{X, x̄} ⟶ 𝒪_{T, t̄}`), that stalk with the global sections of `h^*f_*𝒢` (the closed point has an
initial neighbourhood), the flat base change `h^*f_*𝒢 ≅ f'_*p^*𝒢` of Stacks 073K, and
`Γ(T, f'_* -) = Γ(Y ×_X T, -)`.
declarations.statement:
def directImageGeometricStalkAddEquiv :
