    geometricModuleStalk B S hS X x ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj G) ≃+
      ((modulePullback B S hS (pullback.fst f (strictHenselizationSpaceHom X x))).obj
        G).sections
declarations.comment:
(f_*G)_xbar = Γ(Y ×_X Spec(O_{X,xbar}), p^*G) for f quasi-compact and
  quasi-separated and G quasi-coherent, as an isomorphism of abelian groups; the source's p^*F is
  a misprint for p^*G

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closedSubspaceStalkIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AET.** The stalk `I_x̄ ⊆ 𝒪_{X, x̄}` at a geometric point of the ideal sheaf of a
closed subspace: the ideal of the étale local ring generated by the germs of the local sections
of the defining ideal.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def closedSubspaceStalkIdeal (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (Z : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X.1) (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1) :
    Ideal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 x)
declarations.comment: the stalk I_x̄ of the ideal sheaf of Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIPowerTorsion_geometricModuleStalk_homology_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AET.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S`, let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subspace
whose inclusion is of finite presentation and let `Q ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` have all its cohomology
sheaves supported on `|Z|`.  Then at every geometric point `x̄` the stalk of every cohomology
sheaf of `Q` is power torsion for the stalk `I_x̄` of the ideal sheaf of `Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIPowerTorsion_geometricModuleStalk_homology_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    [HasSheafify (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [(smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (Z : ClosedSubspaces B S hS X.1) (hZ : IsFinitePresentation B S hS Z.1.ι)
    (Q : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hQ : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS X.1 X.2
      (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS Z.1.toFunctor Z.1.ι)) Q.1)
    (x : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1) (n : ℤ) :
    IsIPowerTorsion (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 x)
      (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X x
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) n).obj Q.1))
      (closedSubspaceStalkIdeal B S hS X Z x)
declarations.comment: asserted for the stalk Hⁿ(Q)_x̄ of the cohomology sheaf rather than for the cohomology Hⁿ(Q_x̄) of the stalk of Q in D(Ab); the two agree by exactness of the stalk functor at a geometric point, which this development does not have. Stated at module universe m = u

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isIso_derivedAdjunction_counit_app_of_cohomologySupportedOn
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEU** (corrected). Let `f : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and
`Z ⊆ X` a closed subspace of finite presentation such that `f⁻¹Z ⟶ Z` is an isomorphism and `f` is
flat at every point of `f⁻¹Z`. Then for every `Q ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)` supported on `|f⁻¹Z|` the counit
`Lf^*Rf_*Q ⟶ Q` of the derived adjunction of the morphism of small étale ringed topoi is an
isomorphism.

The finite presentation of `Z ⟶ X` is missing from the printed statement (an erratum, recorded in
`errata.md`); the source's proof uses it (through Stacks 0AET and 05E9, which need the ideal of `Z`
finitely generated), and the printed statement is false without it. Let `A` be the valuation ring
of the field `ℚ((t^ℚ))` of Hahn series and `I` its maximal ideal, so `I = I²` is not finitely
generated; let `X = Spec A`, `Z = V(I)`, `Y = Spec B` for the square-zero extension `B = A ⊕ Iε`,
and `Q = M~` for `M = B / t¹B`. Then `B` is flat over `A`, `A / I ⟶ B / IB` is bijective (so
`f⁻¹Z ⟶ Z` is an isomorphism) and `M` is supported on `V(IB)`, but the counit, which is the
action map `M ⊗_A B ⟶ M`, is not injective: this is the machine-checked
`IPowerTorsion.exists_not_bijective_actionMap_of_support_subset`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_derivedAdjunction_counit_app_of_cohomologySupportedOn
    {Y X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : Y ⟶ X) (Z : Subfunctor X.1)
    (hZ : IsClosedSubspace B S hS Z) (hZfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS Z.ι)
    (hfZ : IsIso (Z.fromPreimage f.hom))
    (hflat : ∀ y : points B S hS (Z.preimage f.hom).toFunctor,
      IsFlatAt B S hS f.hom
        (pointsMap B S hS (Z.preimage f.hom).toFunctor (Z.preimage f.hom).ι y))
    (Q : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2)
    (hQ : CohomologySupportedOn B S hS Y.1 Y.2
      (Set.range (pointsMap B S hS (Z.preimage f.hom).toFunctor (Z.preimage f.hom).ι)) Q.1) :
    IsIso ((derivedAdjunction (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS f)).counit.app Q.1)
declarations.comment: corrected statement: the printed one omits that `Z ⟶ X` is of finite presentation, which the source's proof uses and without which it is false (see `errata.md`)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEV.** The standing situation for formal glueing of quasi-coherent modules: a
quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of algebraic spaces over `S`, a finitely
presented closed subspace `Z` of `X` over which `f` is an isomorphism, with `f` flat at every
point of the inverse image of `Z`.
declarations.statement:
structure FormalGlueingSituation
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
declarations.comment: standing data and hypotheses

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.V_eq_openComplement_preimage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEV.** The inverse image of the open complement of `Z` is the open complement
of the inverse image of `Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem V_eq_openComplement_preimage (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    D.V = openComplement B S hS (D.Z.preimage D.f)
declarations.comment: V = Y minus the inverse image of Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.isOpenSubspace_U
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0AEV.** The complement of `Z` is an open subspace of `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenSubspace_U (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    IsOpenSubspace B S hS D.U
declarations.comment: openness of U

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.isOpenSubspace_V
declarations.doc: **Stacks 0AEV.** The complement of the inverse image of `Z` is an open subspace of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenSubspace_V (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    IsOpenSubspace B S hS D.V
declarations.comment: openness of V

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.overlapPullbackComparison
declarations.doc:
The canonical identification `(f|_V)^* ∘ j^* ≅ (j')^* ∘ f^*` of the two ways of
transporting an `𝒪_X`-module to the overlap `V`: both are the inverse image along the common
composite `V ⟶ X` of the glueing square, by the inverse-image half of Stacks 03LU.
declarations.comment: the comparison over the overlap

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.moduleGlueingData
declarations.doc:
**The category `QCoh(Y → X, Z)` of formal glueing data for quasi-coherent modules**: the
triples `(H, G, φ)` of a quasi-coherent `𝒪_U`-module `H`, a quasi-coherent `𝒪_Y`-module `G` and
an isomorphism `φ : (f|_V)^*H ≅ G|_V`, with the pairs of module maps commuting with the overlap
isomorphisms as morphisms.

The category is introduced in the prose of the source immediately before equation (0AEX); it is
the target of the functor of Stacks 0AEW and the source of the functor of Stacks 0AEX.
declarations.statement: abbrev moduleGlueingData
declarations.comment: the category of glueing data

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.glueingModulesUnconditional
declarations.doc:
The functor `QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ QCoh(Y → X, Z)` of formal glueing: a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module
goes to its restriction to the open complement `U`, its pullback to `Y`, and the canonical
comparison of the two on the overlap `V`.
declarations.statement:
def glueingModulesUnconditional :
    QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS D.spaceX.1 D.spaceX.2 ⥤ D.moduleGlueingData

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.glueingModulesFunctor
declarations.doc:
The functor `QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ QCoh(Y → X, Z)` of formal glueing: a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module
`F` goes to `(F|_U, f^*F, can)`.
declarations.statement:
def glueingModulesFunctor :
    QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS D.spaceX.1 D.spaceX.2 ⥤ D.moduleGlueingData
declarations.comment: the functor, with no hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.glueingKernelMap
declarations.doc:
**The map `j_*H ⊕ f_*G ⟶ (f ∘ j')_*(G|_V)` of Stacks 0AEX**: the difference of the two
canonical maps to the direct image from the overlap, so that a pair of sections lies in its
kernel exactly when the two sections agree on the overlap.
declarations.statement:
def glueingKernelMap :
    D.restrictionDirectImage ⊞ D.ambientDirectImage ⟶ D.overlapDirectImage
declarations.comment: the map out of the direct sum

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.glueingKernelDiagram
declarations.doc:
**The `𝒪_X`-module `Ker(j_*H ⊕ f_*G ⟶ (f ∘ j')_*(G|_V))` of Stacks 0AEX**, as a functor of
the glueing triple.  It is the kernel in the category of functors to the `𝒪_X`-modules, so no
quasi-coherence is assumed and the functoriality is that of a kernel.
declarations.statement:
def glueingKernelDiagram :
    D.moduleGlueingComma ⥤ Modules.{u, u} B S hS D.spaceX.1 D.spaceX.2
declarations.comment: the kernel module, as a functor of the glueing triple

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.glueingKernelFunctor
declarations.doc:
The functor `QCoh(Y → X, Z) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_X)`,
`(H, G, φ) ↦ Ker(j_*H ⊕ f_*G ⟶ (f ∘ j')_*(G|_V))`.
declarations.statement:
def glueingKernelFunctor :
    D.moduleGlueingData ⥤ QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS D.spaceX.1 D.spaceX.2
declarations.comment: the functor, with no hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.glueingAdjunction
declarations.doc:
The functor `glueingModulesFunctor` is left adjoint to the functor
`glueingKernelFunctor`.
declarations.statement: def glueingAdjunction : D.glueingModulesFunctor ⊣ D.glueingKernelFunctor
declarations.comment: with no hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.FlatBaseChange.glueingModulesFunctorPullbackIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEZ, compatibility with the functor of Stacks 0AEW.**  For the base change of the
formal glueing situation along a flat morphism `g : X' ⟶ X`, the pullback
`QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_{X'})` of Stacks 03GA and the pullback
`QCoh(Y → X, Z) ⥤ QCoh(Y' → X', Z')` of glueing triples commute with the functors
`QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ QCoh(Y → X, Z)` and `QCoh(𝒪_{X'}) ⥤ QCoh(Y' → X', Z')` of Stacks 0AEW.
declarations.comment: compatibility with the functor of Tag 0AEW

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.FlatBaseChange.glueingKernelFunctorPullbackIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEZ, compatibility with the functor of Stacks 0AEX.**  For the base change of the
formal glueing situation along a flat morphism `g : X' ⟶ X`, the pullback
`QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_{X'})` of Stacks 03GA and the pullback
`QCoh(Y → X, Z) ⥤ QCoh(Y' → X', Z')` of glueing triples commute with the functors
`QCoh(Y → X, Z) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `QCoh(Y' → X', Z') ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_{X'})` of Stacks 0AEX.

The isomorphism is the one transported from
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.FlatBaseChange.glueingModulesFunctorPullbackIso`
along the two equivalences of Stacks 0AF0, whose quasi-inverses are the functors of
Stacks 0AEX.
declarations.comment: compatibility with the functor of Tag 0AEX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.glueingModulesFunctorBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEZ, compatibility with the functor of Stacks 0AEW**, for the base change of the
situation along a flat morphism `k : X' ⟶ X`, with `Z' = X' ×_X Z` and `Y' = X' ×_X Y`.
declarations.comment: compatibility with the functor of Tag 0AEW, for the constructed base change along a flat morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.glueingKernelFunctorBaseChangeIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AEZ, compatibility with the functor of Stacks 0AEX**, for the base change of the
situation along a flat morphism `k : X' ⟶ X`, with `Z' = X' ×_X Z` and `Y' = X' ×_X Y`.
declarations.comment: compatibility with the functor of Tag 0AEX, for the constructed base change along a flat morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.isIso_glueingAdjunction_unit_counit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AF0.**  In Situation 0AEV the functor `QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ QCoh(Y → X, Z)` of Stacks 0AEW is
an equivalence with quasi-inverse the functor of Stacks 0AEX: the unit and the counit of the
adjunction of Stacks 0AEY between them are isomorphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_glueingAdjunction_unit_counit :
    IsIso D.glueingAdjunction.unit ∧ IsIso D.glueingAdjunction.counit

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_fpqcCovering_refining_openComplement_and_source
declarations.doc:
The open complement and the formal-glueing morphism admit an fpqc
covering refinement.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_fpqcCovering_refining_openComplement_and_source
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    ∃ (I : Type u)
      (Xi : I → (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
      (g : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ D.X),
      (∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (Xi i)) ∧
      IsFpqcCovering B S hS g ∧
      (∀ i, (∃ a : Xi i ⟶ D.U.toFunctor, a ≫ D.U.ι = g i) ∨
        (∃ b : Xi i ⟶ D.Y, b ≫ D.f = g i))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.formalGlueingFunctor
declarations.doc:
Restriction from algebraic spaces over `X` to their cartesian
formal-glueing diagrams. The comparison identifies it naturally with
pullback on each component and the canonical associativity identification
on the overlap.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def formalGlueingFunctor (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    Σ F : spacesOverX D ⥤ glueingData D,
      F ⋙ (show ObjectProperty
          (Comma (Over.pullback (D.U.fromPreimage D.f))
            (Over.pullback D.V.ι)) from
          fun T ↦ IsIso T.hom ∧
            IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T.left.left ∧
            IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T.right.left).ι ≅
        (show ObjectProperty (Over D.X) from
          fun T ↦ IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T.left).ι ⋙
          restrictionDiagram D

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.affineGlueingFunctor_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AF4, part (1).**  The functor of Stacks 0AF3 is an equivalence from algebraic
spaces affine over `X` onto glueing triples whose maps `U' ⟶ U`, `V' ⟶ V` and `Y' ⟶ Y` are
affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem affineGlueingFunctor_isEquivalence (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    (affineGlueingFunctor D).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.closedGlueingFunctor_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AF4, part (2).**  The functor of Stacks 0AF3 is an equivalence from closed
immersions into `X` onto glueing triples whose three maps are closed immersions.
declarations.statement:
theorem closedGlueingFunctor_isEquivalence (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    (closedGlueingFunctor D).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.finiteGlueingFunctor_isEquivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AF4, part (3).**  The functor of Stacks 0AF3 is an equivalence from algebraic
spaces finite over `X` onto glueing triples whose three maps are finite.
declarations.statement:
theorem finiteGlueingFunctor_isEquivalence (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    (finiteGlueingFunctor D).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: part (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.reflectsIsomorphisms_formalGlueingFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AF5.** The restriction functor from algebraic spaces over `X` to cartesian
formal-glueing triples reflects isomorphisms: a morphism over `X` whose restrictions to `U` and
to `Y` are invertible is itself invertible.
declarations.statement:
instance reflectsIsomorphisms_formalGlueingFunctor
    (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    (formalGlueingFunctor D).1.ReflectsIsomorphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.bijective_formalGlueingFunctor_map_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
In a formal glueing situation, the functor of Stacks 0AF3 is bijective on
morphisms `X'₁ ⟶ X'₂` of algebraic spaces over `X` whenever `X'₂ ⟶ X` is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_formalGlueingFunctor_map_of_isSeparated (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS)
    {X₁ X₂ : spacesOverX D} (hsep : IsSeparated B S hS X₂.obj.hom) :
    Function.Bijective fun a : X₁ ⟶ X₂ ↦ (formalGlueingFunctor D).1.map a

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isEquivalence_finiteTypeBaseChange_of_flat_localHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AF7.** Let `A → R` be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings which is
flat, with `𝔪_R = 𝔪_A R` and `κ(𝔪_A) = κ(𝔪_R)`. Then the base-change functor along
`Spec R ⟶ Spec A`, from the category (0AS2) for `(A, 𝔪_A)` to the category (0AS2) for
`(R, 𝔪_R)`, is an equivalence. Here `Spec A` lies over a base scheme `S` through `s`, and the
categories are the finite-type modifications of the represented spaces outside the complements
of `V(𝔪_A)` and `V(𝔪_R)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_finiteTypeBaseChange_of_flat_localHom {A R : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    [Algebra A R] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A R)] [Module.Flat A R]
    (hmax : (maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A R) = maximalIdeal R)
    (hres : Function.Bijective (ResidueField.map (algebraMap A R)))
    (hA : B.Contains (Spec (.of A))) (hR : B.Contains (Spec (.of R)))
    (s : Spec (.of A) ⟶ S) :
    (Space.finiteTypeBaseChangeFunctorOfEq
      (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS
        (affineOver B S hS hR (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A R)) ≫ s)))
      (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS (affineOver B S hS hA s))
      (yoneda.map (affineOverMap (algebraMap A R) hA hR s))
      (Space.openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS _ (zeroLocusPoints B S hS hA s (maximalIdeal A))ᶜ)
      (Space.openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS _
        (zeroLocusPoints B S hS hR _ (maximalIdeal R))ᶜ)
      (by rw [Space.preimage_openSubspaceOfPoints_compl, preimage_zeroLocusPoints, hmax])
      ).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fppfH1_restriction_genericPoint_injective_of_dim_two
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AF9.** Let `W` be a two dimensional regular integral Noetherian scheme with
function field `K` and let `G → W` be an abelian scheme. Then the restriction map
`H¹_fppf(W, G) → H¹_fppf(Spec K, G)` along the generic point is injective.

A class in the kernel is the class of a torsor with a section over `Spec K`, which is trivial by
`AlgebraicGeometry.isTrivial_of_nonempty_sections_genericPoint`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fppfH1_restriction_genericPoint_injective_of_dim_two
    [IsIntegral W] [AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian W] (hreg : IsRegular W)
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (W : Type u) = (2 : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hK : B.Contains (Spec W.functionField))
    (G : Over W) [GrpObj G] [IsAbelianScheme G] (hG : B.Contains G.left)
    [HasSheafify (BigFppfOver.topology B W hW) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (BigFppfOver.topology B W hW) AddCommGrpCat.{u})] :
    Function.Injective (((pointsSheaf B W hW G hG).cohomologyPresheaf 1).map
      (genericPointToBase B W hW hK).op)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.fppfH1_isAddTorsion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFA.** The first fppf cohomology group of a smooth commutative group algebraic
space over a field is torsion.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Space.fppfH1_isAddTorsion
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u})
    (hk : B.Contains (Spec (.of k)))
    [HasSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B (Spec (.of k)) hk) AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    [HasExt.{w} (Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B (Spec (.of k)) hk)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    (G : Sheaf (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver.topology B (Spec (.of k)) hk)
      AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (hG : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of k)) hk
      (G.obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat))
    (hSmooth : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSmooth B (Spec (.of k)) hk
      (terminal.from (G.obj ⋙ forget AddCommGrpCat))) :
    IsAddTorsion (Sheaf.H G 1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.NonAlgebraicHomStack.Situation.exists_not_restriction_homStackClassifyingStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFB.** In the situation of Section 0AF8, let `𝒳 = Mor_S(X, [S/A])`, with `[S/A]` the
quotient stack of the trivial action of `A` on `S`. The functor `𝒳(S) ⟶ lim 𝒳(Sₙ)` is not
essentially surjective: there is a formal object `ξ` of `𝒳` over the complete local ring `k⟦t⟧`,
with `ξₙ` lying over `Sₙ = Spec (k⟦t⟧/(tⁿ⁺¹))`, such that no object `x` of `𝒳` admits morphisms
`ξₙ ⟶ x` lying over the closed immersions `Sₙ ⟶ S`; in a category fibred in groupoids such
morphisms are exactly the identifications of `ξₙ` with the restrictions `x|_{Sₙ}`.

The fibre categories of `𝒳` are classified by `H¹(X ×_S -, A)`: the class in `H¹` of the torsor
attached to an object of `[S/A]` (Stacks 04WM, 03AJ) is transported from the small model of
`[S/A]` along its equivalence over the site with `[S/A]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_not_restriction_homStackClassifyingStack :
    ∃ ξ : FormalObject B (base k) hS (sit.homStackClassifyingStack B hS).p,
      ξ.base = powerSeriesFormalBase k ∧
      (∀ n, (sit.homStackClassifyingStack B hS).p.obj (ξ.level n) = truncationObj B hS n) ∧
      ∀ (x : (sit.homStackClassifyingStack B hS).obj) (r : ∀ n, ξ.level n ⟶ x),
        ¬ ∀ n, (sit.homStackClassifyingStack B hS).p.IsHomLift
          (restrictionToBase B (base k) hS (powerSeriesFormalBase k) hS
            (powerSeriesFormalBase_contains B hS) n) (r n)
declarations.comment: for the Hom-stack Mor_S(X, [S/A]) of the situation of Section 0AF8: k algebraically closed and not the algebraic closure of a finite field, S = Spec k⟦t⟧, X ⟶ S projective and flat with geometrically connected curves as fibres, X regular, the special fibre a nodal curve with smooth components whose dual graph has a loop of rational curves, A = A₀ ×_k S for a non-zero abelian variety A₀, and [S/A] the quotient stack of the trivial action of A on S. The torsion of H¹(X, A), part (a) and part (b) are proved from these data. Not essentially surjective is stated as: some formal object over k⟦t⟧ admits no morphisms, over the closed immersions Sₙ ⟶ S, to an object over S. The index of the thickenings is shifted by one against the source: level n lies over Spec k⟦t⟧/(t^(n+1))

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.NonAlgebraicHomStack.Situation.not_isAlgebraicStack_homStackClassifyingStack
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFC.** In the situation of Section 0AF8, the Hom-stack `𝒳 = Mor_S(X, [S/A])`, with
`[S/A]` the quotient stack of the trivial action of `A` on `S`, is not an algebraic stack. It is
equivalent over the site to the Hom-stack into the small model of `[S/A]`
(`CategoryTheory.BasedCategory.basePullbackEquivalenceOver`), which is not algebraic by
`Stacks.Examples.NonAlgebraicHomStack.Situation.not_isAlgebraicStack_homStack`, and algebraicity
is invariant under equivalence over the site (Stacks 03YQ).
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isAlgebraicStack_homStackClassifyingStack :
    ¬ Stack.IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B (base k) hS (sit.homStackClassifyingStack B hS)
declarations.comment: for the Hom-stack Mor_S(X, [S/A]) of the situation of Section 0AF8: k algebraically closed and not the algebraic closure of a finite field, S = Spec k⟦t⟧, X ⟶ S projective and flat with geometrically connected curves as fibres, X regular, the special fibre a nodal curve with smooth components whose dual graph has a loop of rational curves, A = A₀ ×_k S for a non-zero abelian variety A₀, and [S/A] the quotient stack of the trivial action of A on S. Derived from the proof of 0AFB and from Stacks 07X8 as proved in this library (Deformation.Artin.isEquivalence_approximationFunctor_algebraicStacks)

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.NonAlgebraicHomStack.not_forall_isAlgebraicStack_of_isAbsolutelySeparated_of_not_isEffective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFD**, the mathematical assertion of the remark: the criterion that a Hom-stack is
algebraic whenever its target is separated is false.

Let `S = Spec k⟦t⟧`, let `A` be a group algebraic space over `S` which is proper, flat and locally
of finite presentation, and let `𝒵` be an algebraic stack equivalent over the site to the quotient
stack `[S/A]` of the trivial action of `A`. Let `Mor` assign a category over the site to a pair of
algebraic stacks, let `𝒴` be an algebraic stack and suppose `Mor 𝒴 𝒵` has a formal object that is
not effective. Then it is not the case that `Mor 𝒴' 𝒵'` is an algebraic stack for every `𝒴'` and
every separated `𝒵'`.

* `[S/A]` is separated by Stacks 0DTY part (6) at the trivial-action groupoid
  (`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAbsolutelySeparated_quotientStack_trivialAction`), the algebraic
  stack of the affine scheme `S` being separated by
  `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isAbsolutelySeparated_schemeStack_of_isAffine`.
* An algebraic `Mor 𝒴 𝒵` would have every formal object effective by Stacks 07X8,
  `Deformation.Artin.FormalObject.isEffective_of_isAlgebraicStack_of_isFiberedInGroupoids`.

**The group `A`.** The source's `A = A₀ × S` is an abelian scheme over `S`, and properness, flatness
and local finite presentation of `A ⟶ S` are among the defining conditions of an abelian scheme
(`AlgebraicGeometry.IsAbelianScheme` extends `IsProper`, `Flat` and
`LocallyOfFinitePresentation`). They are the only part of that assumption the remark uses, so they
are stated, on the algebraic-space side, as `hproper`, `hflat` and `hlfp`; the statement therefore
covers every such group algebraic space, the source's abelian scheme among them.

**The universes of `Mor`.** The fibre of the source's Hom-stack `Mor_S(𝒴, 𝒵)` over an `S`-scheme
`T` consists of 1-morphisms `(Sch/T)_{fppf} ×_S 𝒴 ⟶ 𝒵` between categories whose objects lie in the
universe `u + 1` of the site's schemes; so its total category has objects in `u + 1`, and its
morphisms (natural transformations) in `u + 1` as well. `Mor` is accordingly a based category with
objects in `u + 1` and morphisms in an arbitrary universe `v`, which contains the source's case.

**The input `hξ`.** This library defines no Hom-stack of two algebraic stacks, so `Mor` is an
arbitrary assignment and the non-effectivity of a formal object of `Mor 𝒴 [S/A]` — the source's
Lemma 0AFB, read through its identification of the fibres of `Mor_S(X, [S/A])` with groupoids of
`A₀`-torsors — is the input `hξ`. Lemma 0AFB and Proposition 0AFC belong to item C6003 of
lane rb-201 (`StacksFrontier.Examples.Stacks.NonAlgebraicHomStack`).
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_forall_isAlgebraicStack_of_isAbsolutelySeparated_of_not_isEffective
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (base k))
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u}))
    (A : Over (Space.terminalSpace B (base k) hS).obj) [GrpObj A]
    (hA : IsAlgebraicSpace B (base k) hS A.left)
    (Agpd : Space.ActionGroupoidConstruction (Space.terminalSpace B (base k) hS) A
      (𝟙_ (Over (Space.terminalSpace B (base k) hS).obj)) hA
      (Space.terminalSpace B (base k) hS).property)
    (𝒵 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B (base k) hS)
    (hequiv : Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
      (Stack.quotientStack Agpd.groupoid).p 𝒵.val.val.p))
    (hproper : Space.IsProper B (base k) hS A.hom)
    (hflat : Space.IsFlat B (base k) hS A.hom)
    (hlfp : Space.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B (base k) hS A.hom)
    (Mor : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B (base k) hS →
      Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B (base k) hS →
      BasedCategory.{v, u + 1} (BigFppfOver B (base k) hS))
    (𝒴 : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B (base k) hS)
    (hp : (Mor 𝒴 𝒵).p.IsFiberedInGroupoids)
    (hξ : ∃ ξ : Deformation.Artin.FormalObject B (base k) hS (Mor 𝒴 𝒵).p,
      ¬ Deformation.Artin.FormalObject.IsEffective B (base k) hS (Mor 𝒴 𝒵).p hp ξ) :
    ¬ ∀ 𝒴' 𝒵' : Stack.AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B (base k) hS,
        Stack.AlgebraicStacks.IsAbsolutelySeparated.{u, w} B (base k) hS hZ 𝒵' →
          Stack.IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B (base k) hS (Mor 𝒴' 𝒵')
declarations.comment: the mathematical assertion of the remark and not its bibliography: the criterion the Erratum asserts -- that a Hom-stack is algebraic as soon as its target is separated -- is false, because the target [S/A] of a Hom-stack with a non-effective formal object is separated. Separatedness of [S/A] is derived from Stacks 0DTY part (6) read at the groupoid of the trivial action and from separatedness of the stack of the affine base Spec k[[t]]; A is any group algebraic space over S that is proper, flat and locally of finite presentation, the clauses of the source's abelian scheme that the remark uses. Non-algebraicity is derived from Stacks 07X8 of this library. The Hom-stack Mor_S(X, [S/A]) is not defined in this library, so Mor is an arbitrary assignment and the source's Lemma 0AFB for it -- a formal object of Mor Y Z that is not effective -- is the input hξ (0AFB and 0AFC: item C6003). The bibliographic claims about AokiHomStacks and its Erratum are cited in the docstring only

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_add_of_relativeDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AFE.** A flat morphism locally of finite type of relative dimension
`d` between locally Noetherian schemes raises the local dimension by `d`:
`dim_x(X) = dim_{f x}(Y) + d`.

This is also the input to the dimension formula for a Cohen-Macaulay morphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_add_of_relativeDimension {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    {d : ℕ} (hf : RelativeDimension f d) (x : X) :
    topologicalKrullDimAt X x = topologicalKrullDimAt Y (f x) + (d : WithBot ℕ∞)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_add_topologicalKrullDimAt_fiber_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AFF.** For a smooth morphism of locally Noetherian schemes the
dimension of the source at a point is the dimension of the target at its image plus the
dimension of the fibre at that point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_add_topologicalKrullDimAt_fiber_of_smooth
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Smooth f]
    (x : X) :
    topologicalKrullDimAt X x =
      topologicalKrullDimAt Y (f x) +
        topologicalKrullDimAt (f.fiber (f x)) (f.asFiber x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_add_topologicalKrullDimAt_fiber_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AFF.** For a smooth morphism of locally Noetherian schemes the
dimension of the source at a point is the dimension of the target at its image plus the dimension
of the fibre at that point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_add_topologicalKrullDimAt_fiber_of_smooth
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [Smooth f]
    (x : X) :
    topologicalKrullDimAt X x =
      topologicalKrullDimAt Y (f x) +
        topologicalKrullDimAt (f.fiber (f x)) (f.asFiber x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_add_topologicalKrullDimAt_fiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AFG.** For a Cohen-Macaulay morphism locally of finite type between
locally Noetherian schemes, the dimension of the source at a point is the dimension of the target
at its image plus the dimension of the fibre at that point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem topologicalKrullDimAt_eq_add_topologicalKrullDimAt_fiber {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hfib : ∀ y : Y, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber y))
    (hcm : Scheme.Hom.IsCohenMacaulay f hfib) (x : X) :
    topologicalKrullDimAt X x =
      topologicalKrullDimAt Y (f x) +
        topologicalKrullDimAt (f.fiber (f x)) (f.asFiber x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dimensionAtPoint_eq_add_of_hasRelativeDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFH.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of locally Noetherian algebraic spaces over
`S` which is flat, locally of finite type and of relative dimension `d`. Then for every point
`x` of `X` with image `y` in `Y` we have `dim_x(X) = dim_y(Y) + d`.

Local Noetherianity of an algebraic space is the étale-local property of Tag 03E6 for
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian`, as in
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/NoetherianSpaces.lean`. The source is assumed locally
Noetherian, as in the statement of the tag, but the hypothesis is not used: by Tag 04ZK it
follows from local Noetherianity of the target and local finite type of `f`, which is how the
chart of the source is seen to be locally Noetherian below.

The proof reduces everything to one commuting square of surjective étale charts `α : U ⟶ V`
over `f`, obtained by Tag 02X1 from the locally Noetherian atlas of the target. The induced
morphism of schemes is flat and locally of finite type, being the chart morphism of a flat
morphism locally of finite type, and its source is locally Noetherian because its target is.
It has relative dimension `d` in the scheme sense of part (3) of Tag 02NJ: the pointed chart
built from the canonical field-valued representative of a point `w` of `U` reads the relative
dimension of `f` above `w` as the local dimension of the fibre of the chart morphism through
`w`, so that local dimension is `d` at every point of `U`, and constant local fibre dimension
over a field gives equidimensional fibres of dimension `d`. The dimension formula for the
chart morphism is then Tag 0AFE, and its two sides are the dimensions of the two algebraic
spaces at the corresponding points, by the chart independence of Tag 04N5.
declarations.statement:
theorem dimensionAtPoint_eq_add_of_hasRelativeDimension
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (_hNX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun Z : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian Z))
    (hNY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun Z : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian Z))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f) (hft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    {d : ℕ} (hdim : HasRelativeDimension d B S hS f) (x : points B S hS X) :
    dimensionAtPoint B S hS X hX x =
      dimensionAtPoint B S hS Y hY (pointsMap B S hS X f x) + (d : WithBot ℕ∞)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.dimensionAtPoint_eq_add_of_isSmooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFI.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a smooth morphism of locally Noetherian algebraic
spaces over `S`. For every point `x` of `X` with image `y` in `Y` we have
`dim_x(X) = dim_y(Y) + dim_x(X_y)`, where `dim_x(X_y)` is the relative dimension `d` of `f`
at `x` in the sense of Tag 04NM.
declarations.statement:
public theorem dimensionAtPoint_eq_add_of_isSmooth
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (_hNX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X (fun Z : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian Z))
    (hNY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun Z : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian Z))
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsSmooth B S hS f) {d : ℕ∞} (x : points B S hS X)
    (hd : HasRelativeDimensionAt d B S hS f x) :
    dimensionAtPoint B S hS X hX x =
      dimensionAtPoint B S hS Y hY (pointsMap B S hS X f x) + (d : WithBot ℕ∞)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation.exists_supportedQuasicoherentDerived_equivalence
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFJ.** In Situation 0AEV (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.FormalGlueingSituation`), the
derived direct image `Rf_*` of the morphism of small étale ringed topoi of `f` induces an
equivalence `D_{QCoh,|f⁻¹Z|}(𝒪_Y) ≌ D_{QCoh,|Z|}(𝒪_X)` with quasi-inverse given by the derived
pullback `Lf^*`: there is an equivalence whose functor is the restriction of `Rf_*` and whose
inverse is the restriction of `Lf^*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem FormalGlueingSituation.exists_supportedQuasicoherentDerived_equivalence
    (D : FormalGlueingSituation B S hS) :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (Modules.{u, u} B S hS D.spaceX.1 D.spaceX.2)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (Modules.{u, u} B S hS D.spaceY.1 D.spaceY.2)
    ∃ e : (supportedQuasicoherentDerived B S hS D.spaceY
        (subspacePointSet B S hS D.Y (D.Z.preimage D.f))).FullSubcategory ≌
      (supportedQuasicoherentDerived B S hS D.spaceX
        (subspacePointSet B S hS D.X D.Z)).FullSubcategory,
      e.functor ⋙ (supportedQuasicoherentDerived B S hS D.spaceX
          (subspacePointSet B S hS D.X D.Z)).ι =
        (supportedQuasicoherentDerived B S hS D.spaceY
          (subspacePointSet B S hS D.Y (D.Z.preimage D.f))).ι ⋙
          derivedPushforward (X := smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS D.spaceY)
            (Y := smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS D.spaceX)
            (smallEtaleRingedToposHom B S hS D.ambientMorphism) ∧
      e.inverse ⋙ (supportedQuasicoherentDerived B S hS D.spaceY
          (subspacePointSet B S hS D.Y (D.Z.preimage D.f))).ι =
        (supportedQuasicoherentDerived B S hS D.spaceX
          (subspacePointSet B S hS D.X D.Z)).ι ⋙
          smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS D.ambientMorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.exists_isAdmissibleBlowup_isPullback_completion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AFK.** An admissible blowup of the spectrum of the maximal-ideal
completion of a Noetherian local ring `A`, relative to the punctured spectrum, is the base change
of an admissible blowup of `Spec A` relative to its punctured spectrum.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAdmissibleBlowup_isPullback_completion
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)))
    (hg : IsAdmissibleBlowup
      (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) g) :
    ∃ (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)),
      IsAdmissibleBlowup (Stacks.Divisors.puncturedSpectrum A) f ∧
        ∃ h : Y ⟶ X,
          IsPullback h g f
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
              (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.dimensionSubNat_eq_dimensionSubNat_of_isSmooth
declarations.doc:
Let `𝒳` be a locally Noetherian algebraic stack over `S`, and let `f : T ⟶ 𝒳` and
`f' : T' ⟶ 𝒳` be two smooth, locally-of-finite-type 1-morphisms from algebraic spaces, with
points `t ∈ |T|` and `t' ∈ |T'|` with the same image in `|𝒳|`. If the relative dimensions of
Stacks 0DRG of `f` at `t` and of `f'` at `t'` are the natural numbers `d` and `d'`, then
`dim_t(T) - d = dim_{t'}(T') - d'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dimensionSubNat_eq_dimensionSubNat_of_isSmooth
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (h𝒳 : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳)
    {T T' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T) (hT' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T')
    (f : algebraicSpaceStack.{u, w} B S hS T hT ⟶ 𝒳)
    (f' : algebraicSpaceStack.{u, w} B S hS T' hT' ⟶ 𝒳)
    (hsm : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS f) (hsm' : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS f')
    (hf : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hf' : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f')
    (t : Space.points B S hS T) (t' : Space.points B S hS T')
    (hx : pointsMap B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS T).val
        (fibredCategory B S hS T).property 𝒳.val.property f.hom.hom
        (stackPointOfSpacePoint B S hS T t) =
      pointsMap B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS T').val
        (fibredCategory B S hS T').property 𝒳.val.property f'.hom.hom
        (stackPointOfSpacePoint B S hS T' t'))
    (d d' : ℕ)
    (hd : relativeDimensionAt.{u, w} B S hS T hT 𝒳 f hf t = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hd' : relativeDimensionAt.{u, w} B S hS T' hT' 𝒳 f' hf' t' = (d' : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    dimensionSubNat (Space.dimensionAtPoint B S hS T hT t) d =
      dimensionSubNat (Space.dimensionAtPoint B S hS T' hT' t') d'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_dimensionSubNat_eq_dimensionSubNat_of_isSmooth
declarations.doc:
Let `𝒳` be a locally Noetherian algebraic stack over `S`, let `f : T ⟶ 𝒳` and
`f' : T' ⟶ 𝒳` be smooth, locally-of-finite-type 1-morphisms from algebraic spaces, and let
`t ∈ |T|` and `t' ∈ |T'|` have the same image `x ∈ |𝒳|`. Then the relative dimensions of
Stacks 0DRG of `f` at `t` and of `f'` at `t'` are natural numbers `d` and `d'`, and the two values
of the formula of Stacks 0AFN agree: `dim_t(T) - d = dim_{t'}(T') - d'` in `ℤ ∪ {±∞}`.

So the quantity `dim_u(U) - dim_{e(u)}(R_u)` of the source is defined — its subtrahend is
finite — and does not depend on the presentation or on the point above `x` used to read it.
A presentation `[U/R] → 𝒳` enters through the smooth, locally of finite type 1-morphism
`U ⟶ 𝒳` it induces: the fibre `R_u` of the source map `s : R = U ×_𝒳 U ⟶ U` at the identity
arrow `e(u)` is the fibre of that 1-morphism over a field-valued point representing `x`, so its
local dimension there is the relative dimension of Stacks 0DRG subtracted here.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_dimensionSubNat_eq_dimensionSubNat_of_isSmooth
    (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (h𝒳 : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳)
    {T T' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T) (hT' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T')
    (f : algebraicSpaceStack.{u, w} B S hS T hT ⟶ 𝒳)
    (f' : algebraicSpaceStack.{u, w} B S hS T' hT' ⟶ 𝒳)
    (hsm : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS f) (hsm' : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS f')
    (hf : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hf' : AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f')
    (t : Space.points B S hS T) (t' : Space.points B S hS T')
    (hx : pointsMap B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS T).val
        (fibredCategory B S hS T).property 𝒳.val.property f.hom.hom
        (stackPointOfSpacePoint B S hS T t) =
      pointsMap B S hS (fibredCategory B S hS T').val
        (fibredCategory B S hS T').property 𝒳.val.property f'.hom.hom
        (stackPointOfSpacePoint B S hS T' t')) :
    ∃ d d' : ℕ, relativeDimensionAt.{u, w} B S hS T hT 𝒳 f hf t = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      relativeDimensionAt.{u, w} B S hS T' hT' 𝒳 f' hf' t' = (d' : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
        dimensionSubNat (Space.dimensionAtPoint B S hS T hT t) d =
          dimensionSubNat (Space.dimensionAtPoint B S hS T' hT' t') d'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.dimensionAtPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFN.** The dimension of a locally Noetherian algebraic stack `𝒳` at a point `x`:
the infimum of `dim_t(T) - dim_t(T_x)` over the 1-morphisms `T ⟶ 𝒳` from an algebraic space
that are smooth and locally of finite type and the points `t ∈ |T|` above `x`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def dimensionAtPoint (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (_h𝒳 : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳)
    (x : points B S hS 𝒳.val.val 𝒳.val.property) : EInt

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.dimensionAtPoint_eq_dimensionSubNat_zero_of_representing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFN, agreement with the dimension of an algebraic space.** Let `𝒵` be a locally
Noetherian algebraic stack over `S` represented by an algebraic space `W`, and let `x ∈ |W|`
have image `z ∈ |𝒵|`. Then the dimension of `𝒵` at `z` is the dimension of `W` at `x`.

The chart of the representing equivalence is smooth, locally of finite type and of relative
dimension `0`, so the formula of Stacks 0DRJ computes the left-hand side as
`dim_x(W) - 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dimensionAtPoint_eq_dimensionSubNat_zero_of_representing
    (𝒵 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (h𝒵 : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒵)
    (W : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (hW : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS W)
    (eW : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver 𝒵.val.val.p
      (presheafOfCategories (W ⋙ typeToCat)).p)
    (x : Space.points B S hS W) (z : points B S hS 𝒵.val.val 𝒵.val.property)
    (hz : spacePointMap B S hS W 𝒵.val
      (representingEquivalence B S hS W 𝒵.val eW).functor x = z) :
    dimensionAtPoint B S hS 𝒵 h𝒵 z =
      dimensionSubNat (Space.dimensionAtPoint B S hS W hW x) 0
declarations.comment: agreement with the dimension of an algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.dimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFP.** The dimension of a locally Noetherian algebraic stack: the supremum, over
the points of the stack, of its dimension at that point, as an extended integer.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev dimension (𝒳 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS)
    (h𝒳 : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} B S hS 𝒳) : EInt

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_dimension_classifyingStack_additiveGroup_eq_neg_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFR: the classifying stack of `𝐆ₐ` has dimension `-1`.** Over every field `k`, the
classifying stack `B𝐆ₐ = [Spec k/𝐆ₐ]` has a model in the 2-category of algebraic stacks, and every
model is locally Noetherian of dimension `-1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_dimension_classifyingStack_additiveGroup_eq_neg_one :
    (∃ 𝒬 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk,
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (classifyingStack C hk (Space.additiveGroupOverField C hk)).val.p 𝒬.val.val.p)) ∧
      ∀ (𝒬 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk)
        (_ : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (classifyingStack C hk (Space.additiveGroupOverField C hk)).val.p 𝒬.val.val.p),
        ∃ hN : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬,
          dimension C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬 hN = ((-1 : ℤ) : EInt)
declarations.comment: the dimension of an algebraic stack can be a negative integer: over every field the classifying stack of the additive group is constructed and has dimension `-1`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_algebraicStack_dimension_lt_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFR: the dimension of an algebraic stack can be a negative integer.** Over every
field `k` there is a locally Noetherian algebraic stack of dimension `-1`, namely a model of the
classifying stack of the additive group.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_algebraicStack_dimension_lt_zero :
    ∃ (𝒬 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk)
      (hN : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬),
      dimension C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬 hN = ((-1 : ℤ) : EInt) ∧
        dimension C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬 hN < 0
declarations.comment: the dimension of an algebraic stack can be a negative integer: a locally Noetherian algebraic stack of dimension `-1` exists over every field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.dimension_quotientStack_le
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be an algebraic space locally of finite type over a field `k`, and let `G` be a group
algebraic space locally of finite type over `k`, not necessarily smooth, acting on `X`. Then the
dimension of `G` is a natural number `m`, and every model of the quotient stack `[X/G]` in the
2-category of algebraic stacks is locally Noetherian of dimension at most `dim(X) - m`.
declarations.statement:
theorem dimension_quotientStack_le
    (hGft : Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType C (Spec (.of k)) hk G.obj.X.hom)
    (X : Over (Space.terminalSpace C (Spec (.of k)) hk).obj) [ModObj G.obj.X X]
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace C (Spec (.of k)) hk X.left)
    (hXft : Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType C (Spec (.of k)) hk X.hom) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, Space.dimension C (Spec (.of k)) hk G.obj.X.left G.property = (m : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      ∀ (𝒬 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk)
        (_ : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver
          (quotientStack (Space.groupoidOfAction (Space.terminalSpace C (Spec (.of k)) hk)
            G.obj.X X G.property hX).groupoid).p 𝒬.val.val.p),
        ∃ hN : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬,
          dimension C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬 hN ≤
            dimensionSubNat (Space.dimension C (Spec (.of k)) hk X.left hX) m
declarations.comment: upper bound `dim [X/G] ≤ dim X - dim G` for every group algebraic space locally of finite type over the field, smooth or not, acting on an algebraic space locally of finite type; the equality is `dimension_quotientStack_eq_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.dimension_classifyingStack_le
declarations.doc:

smooth, the dimension of `G` is a natural number `m`, and every model of the classifying stack

      ∀ (𝒬 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk)

          𝒬.val.val.p),
        ∃ hN : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬,
          dimension C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬 hN ≤ ((-(m : ℤ) : ℤ) : EInt)
declarations.comment: upper bound `dim BG ≤ -dim G` for every group algebraic space locally of finite type over the field, smooth or not; the equality is `dimension_classifyingStack_eq_neg_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.dimension_classifyingStack_lt_zero

theorem dimension_classifyingStack_lt_zero_of_isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_pos
    (hGft : Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType C (Spec (.of k)) hk G.obj.X.hom)
    (hpos : 0 < Space.dimension C (Spec (.of k)) hk G.obj.X.left G.property) :
    (∃ 𝒬 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk,
        Nonempty (StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver (classifyingStack C hk G).val.p
          𝒬.val.val.p)) ∧
      ∀ (𝒬 : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk)
        (_ : StacksRepresentableCFG.EquivalenceOver (classifyingStack C hk G).val.p
          𝒬.val.val.p),
        ∃ hN : IsLocallyNoetherianStack.{u, w} C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬,
          dimension C (Spec (.of k)) hk 𝒬 hN < 0
declarations.comment: the dimension of an algebraic stack can be a negative integer: `dim BG < 0` for every group algebraic space of positive dimension locally of finite type over the field, smooth or not

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.isRegularRing_tfae
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsLocalRing.isRegularRing_tfae {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] :
    List.TFAE
      [IsRegularLocalRing R,
       (⨆ M : ModuleCat.{u} R, projectiveDimension M) ≠ ⊤,
       IsRegularRing R]
declarations.comment:
Both sentences of the source as one `List.TFAE`: (1) ↔ (2) is the equivalence of
regularity with finiteness of the global dimension, and (1) → (3) is "`R_𝔭` is a regular local
ring for all primes `𝔭`", spelled with Mathlib's `IsRegularRing` (Definition 00OD). Global
dimension is the supremum of the projective dimensions of all `R`-modules, Mathlib having no name
for it, and "finite" is `≠ ⊤`. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: localized_irreducible
declarations.doc:
**(Localized irreducibility.)** If `x` is irreducible in `A`, then its image
in the localization `S⁻¹A` is irreducible or a unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem localized_irreducible (S : Submonoid A) (hS : GenByPrimes S)
    (x : A) (hx : Irreducible x) :
    Irreducible (algebraMap A (Localization S) x) ∨
      IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization S) x)

declarations.name: prime_iff_localized_prime_or_unit
declarations.doc:
**(Primality criterion.)** If `x` is irreducible in `A`, then `x` is prime
in `A` if and only if its image in `S⁻¹A` is prime or a unit.

PROOF (assembled; sub-lemmas above carry the content):
`(→)` Given `Prime x`. Decide `IsUnit (φ x)`: if so, right disjunct; else by
sub-lemma (2b) `Prime (φ x)`, left disjunct.
`(←)` Given `Prime (φ x) ∨ IsUnit (φ x)`: the prime case is sub-lemma (2c), the
unit case is sub-lemma (2a).
declarations.statement:
theorem prime_iff_localized_prime_or_unit (S : Submonoid A) (hS : GenByPrimes S)
    (x : A) (hx : Irreducible x) :
    Prime x ↔
      (Prime (algebraMap A (Localization S) x) ∨
        IsUnit (algebraMap A (Localization S) x))

declarations.name: nagata_criterion
declarations.doc:
**(Nagata's criterion for factoriality.)** `A` is a UFD if and only if every
nonzero nonunit of `A` factors into irreducibles and `S⁻¹A` is a UFD.

PROOF (assembled; the content is in the sub-lemmas above and theorems (1),(2)):
`(→)` `UFD A` ⇒ irreducible factorizations exist (3b) and `S⁻¹A` is a UFD (3c).
`(←)` Given irreducible factorizations and `UFD (S⁻¹A)`: build `UFD A` via
`UniqueFactorizationMonoid.of_exists_prime_factors` (Stacks 034T).  For `a ≠ 0`:
units factor as the empty product; for a nonunit, take its irreducible
factorization and observe each irreducible factor is prime by (3a) (which itself
uses theorems (1),(2) and `UFD (S⁻¹A)`); the product equals `a` exactly, hence is
`Associated` to `a`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nagata_criterion (S : Submonoid A) (hS : GenByPrimes S) :
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid A ↔
      (HasIrreducibleFactorizations A ∧
        UniqueFactorizationMonoid (Localization S))
declarations.comment: Moreover

registrations.name: UniqueFactorizationMonoid.instIsIntegrallyClosed
registrations.comment: a UFD is integrally closed

declarations.name: K0.exists_determinant_hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFX.** The determinant gives a homomorphism from `K₀(R)` to the Picard group.
For a finite locally free module of constant rank `n`, it sends its class to the class of its
`n`th exterior power.
declarations.statement:
public theorem K0.exists_determinant_hom (R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
    ∃ det : K0 R →+ Additive (CommRing.Pic R),
      ∀ (M : FGProj R) (n : ℕ),
        Module.rankAtStalk M.carrier = Function.const (PrimeSpectrum R) n →
          ∃ h : Module.Invertible R (⋀[R]^n M.carrier),
            det (K0.mk M) =
              Additive.ofMul (@CommRing.Pic.mk R (⋀[R]^n M.carrier) inferInstance
                inferInstance inferInstance h)

declarations.name: K0.exists_eulerChar_perfect
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AFY.** Perfect complexes over `R` have an Euler characteristic in `K₀(R)` which
changes by `(-1)ⁿ` under a shift by `n`, is additive in distinguished triangles, and is the
alternating sum of the classes of the terms of every bounded finite-projective representative.
declarations.statement:
public theorem K0.exists_eulerChar_perfect (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)] :
    ∃ c : {K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) // StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect K} → K0 R,
      (∀ (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (hK : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect K) (n : ℤ),
        ∃ hKn : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect (K⟦n⟧),
          c ⟨K⟦n⟧, hKn⟩ = (n.negOnePow : ℤ) • c ⟨K, hK⟩) ∧
      (∀ (T : Triangle (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))),
        T ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) →
        ∀ (h₁ : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect T.obj₁) (h₂ : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect T.obj₂)
          (h₃ : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect T.obj₃),
          c ⟨T.obj₂, h₂⟩ = c ⟨T.obj₁, h₁⟩ + c ⟨T.obj₃, h₃⟩) ∧
      (∀ (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (hK : StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect K)
        (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (a b : ℤ),
        P.IsStrictlyGE a → P.IsStrictlyLE b →
        (hfinite : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite R (P.X i)) →
        (hprojective : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective R (P.X i)) →
        Nonempty (K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) →
        c ⟨K, hK⟩ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc a b,
          (i.negOnePow : ℤ) • K0.mk
            ({ carrier := P.X i, finite := hfinite i, projective := hprojective i } : FGProj R))

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjShiftedSections.degreeNToGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
The canonical map from the degree-`n` homogeneous elements of `M` to the global sections of
`M(n)~`, as an additive homomorphism: it is the degree-zero global-sections map of the shift.
This is the map `Mₙ → Γ(Proj(S), M(n)~)` of Tag 0AG2, obtained from the degree-zero map of Tag
0AG1 for the grading of `M(n)` and the identification `M(n)₀ = Mₙ` of
`Stacks.GradedModule.shiftedGrading_zero`.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def degreeNToGlobalSections (n : ℤ) :
    𝒨 n →+ shiftedSectionsComponent 𝒮 𝒨 n
declarations.comment: map_degree_n_global_sections

declarations.name: Stacks.GradedModule.shiftedGrading_zero
declarations.doc:
The degree-zero piece of the twist `M(n)` is the degree-`n` piece of `M`: `M(n)₀ = Mₙ`.
The two indices are `0 + n` and `n`, which are equal by `zero_add` and not by reduction.
declarations.statement:
public theorem shiftedGrading_zero {M : Type v} {τ : Type t} [SetLike τ M] (𝒩 : ℤ → τ) (n : ℤ) :
    shiftedGrading 𝒩 n 0 = 𝒩 n
declarations.comment: twist_degree_zero

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistDegreeOneCover.degreeNToTwistedGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
**Equation 0AG3: the canonical map `M_n ⟶ Γ(X, M̃(n))`.** A homogeneous element of degree
`n` gives a global section of `M(n)~`, which the isomorphism `M(n)~ ≅ M̃(n)` of Tag 01MT turns
into a global section of the twist `M̃(n)`.
declarations.statement:
public def degreeNToTwistedGlobalSections (hcover : DegreeOneCover 𝒮) (n : ℤ) :
    𝒨 n →+ twistedModuleGlobalSections 𝒮 𝒨 n

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistComparisonCompact.isIso_integerComparison
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AG5].** Let `S` be a graded ring such that `X = Proj S` is quasi-compact and
let `ℱ` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Set `M = ⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} Γ(X, ℱ(n))`, the graded
`S`-module of Section 01MM with its canonical graded module structure
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistedSections.twistedGlobalSectionsModule` of Tag 03GK.  Then
the comparison map `M̃ ⟶ ℱ` of Tag 0B5I is an isomorphism.

This is `isIso_integerComparison_of_compactSpace` at the canonical graded module structure, so
nothing is quantified over beyond the graded ring and the sheaf: the hypotheses are exactly the
source's, quasi-compactness of `Proj S` and quasi-coherence of `ℱ`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_integerComparison
    [CompactSpace (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮)]
    (hqc : SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent
      (R := (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮).ringCatSheaf) F) :
    IsIso (ProjTwistIntegerComparison.integerComparison 𝒮 F
      (ProjTwistedSections.twistedGlobalSectionsModule 𝒮 F))
declarations.comment:
the comparison `M̃ ⟶ ℱ` of Tag 0B5I is an isomorphism, for `Proj S`
quasi-compact and `ℱ` quasi-coherent

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistComparisonCompact.twistSheafMap_integerComparison_degreeNToTwistedGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0AG5], second assertion**, for the canonical graded module structure of
Tag 03GK: if `Proj S` is covered by the standard opens of the degree-one elements then the
induced maps `M_n → Γ(X, ℱ(n))` are the identity maps.

This is `twistSheafMap_integerComparison_degreeNToTwistedGlobalSections_of_module` at the
canonical graded module structure
`Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistedSections.twistedGlobalSectionsModule`, so nothing is
quantified over beyond the graded ring, the sheaf and the source's own hypotheses.
declarations.statement:
public theorem twistSheafMap_integerComparison_degreeNToTwistedGlobalSections
    [CompactSpace (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮)]
    (hqc : SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent
      (R := (_root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒮).ringCatSheaf) F)
    (hcover : DegreeOneCover 𝒮) (n : ℤ) (s : twistedSectionsComponent 𝒮 F n) :
    letI := (ProjTwistedSections.twistedGlobalSectionsModule 𝒮 F).moduleInst
    letI := (ProjTwistedSections.twistedGlobalSectionsModule 𝒮 F).gradedSMul
    (twistSheafMap 𝒮
          (integerComparison 𝒮 F (ProjTwistedSections.twistedGlobalSectionsModule 𝒮 F))
          n).val.app (op ⊤)
        (degreeNToTwistedGlobalSections 𝒮 (twistedGlobalSectionsGrading 𝒮 F) hcover n
          (ofTwistedSection 𝒮 F n s)) = s
declarations.comment:
part (2): if `Proj S` is covered by the standard opens `D₊(f)` with `deg f = 1`
then the induced maps `M_n → Γ(X, ℱ(n))` are the identity maps

declarations.name: Stacks.ProjCoherentDegreeOne.proj_isNoetherian_and_forall_isCoherent
declarations.statement:
theorem proj_isNoetherian_and_forall_isCoherent :
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒜) ∧
      ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (projRingSheaf 𝒜), _root_.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent F →
        (∃ (r : ℕ) (d : Fin r → ℤ),
            ∃ φ : (∐ fun j : Fin r => twistingSheaf 𝒜 (d j)) ⟶ F, Epi φ) ∧
          (∀ p : ℕ, Module.Finite (𝒜 0)
            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of (𝒜 0))).inv ≫
                (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜).appTop).hom).obj
              (((moduleGlobalSections (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj 𝒜)).rightDerived p).obj F))) ∧
          (∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → ∃ d₀ : ℤ, ∀ d : ℤ, d₀ ≤ d →
            IsZero (Hgroup (projRingSheaf 𝒜) ⊤ p (twistSheafOfModules 𝒜 F d))) ∧
          (∀ k : ℤ,
            letI := (twistedGlobalSectionsModule 𝒜 F).moduleInst
            Module.Finite A (TwistedGlobalSectionsModule.truncation 𝒜 F
              (twistedGlobalSectionsModule 𝒜 F) k))
