registrations.comment: proj_noetherian

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjLargeDegreeSections.exists_bijective_degreeNToGlobalSections
declarations.doc:
The comparison maps are bijective in all large degrees, with the finiteness input of the
source replaced by homogeneous generating data for the kernel and the cokernel of the comparison.

In every degree `n` the canonical map `𝒨 n ⟶ Γ(Proj 𝒮, M(n)~)` of Equation 01MR is
`degreeNToGlobalSections`. Assume `S` is generated in degree one over `𝒮 0` and:

* the kernel is generated degreewise by `x : Fin ck → M` placed in degrees `dx`, and a power of
  the irrelevant ideal annihilates every `x j`;
* the cokernel is generated degreewise by sections `y k` of `M(dy k)~`, and a power of the
  irrelevant ideal carries every `y k` into the image of the comparison.

Then the comparison is bijective in every sufficiently large degree. The statement does not
assume that `𝒨` is a decomposition of `M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_bijective_degreeNToGlobalSections
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin (𝒮 0) (𝒮 1 : Set S) = ⊤)
    {ck : ℕ} (x : Fin ck → M) (dx : Fin ck → ℤ) (Nx : Fin ck → ℕ)
    (hxtors : ∀ j, ∀ a ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒮).toIdeal ^ Nx j, a • x j = 0)
    (hxgen : ∀ n : ℤ, (∀ j, dx j ≤ n) → ∀ m : 𝒨 n,
      degreeNToGlobalSections 𝒮 𝒨 n m = 0 →
        ∃ a : (j : Fin ck) → 𝒮 (n - dx j).toNat, (m : M) = ∑ j, (a j : S) • x j)
    {cq : ℕ} (dy : Fin cq → ℤ) (Ny : Fin cq → ℕ)
    (y : (k : Fin cq) → shiftedSectionsComponent 𝒮 𝒨 (dy k))
    (hytors : ∀ (k : Fin cq) (i : ℕ) (a : 𝒮 i),
      (a : S) ∈ (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒮).toIdeal ^ Ny k →
        ∃ m : 𝒨 ((i : ℤ) + dy k),
          homogeneousScalarGlobalSections 𝒮 𝒨 i (dy k) a (y k)
            = degreeNToGlobalSections 𝒮 𝒨 ((i : ℤ) + dy k) m)
    (hygen : ∀ (n : ℤ) (hn : ∀ k, dy k ≤ n) (s : shiftedSectionsComponent 𝒮 𝒨 n),
      ∃ (m : 𝒨 n) (a : (k : Fin cq) → 𝒮 (n - dy k).toNat),
        s = degreeNToGlobalSections 𝒮 𝒨 n m +
          ∑ k, ofDegreeEq 𝒮 𝒨 (show (((n - dy k).toNat : ℤ) + dy k) = n by
              have := hn k; omega)
            (homogeneousScalarGlobalSections 𝒮 𝒨 ((n - dy k).toNat) (dy k) (a k) (y k))) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n₀ ≤ n → Function.Bijective (degreeNToGlobalSections 𝒮 𝒨 n)
declarations.comment: bijectivity in all large degrees, from homogeneous generators of the kernel and of the cokernel annihilated, respectively carried into the image, by a power of the irrelevant ideal

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjLargeDegreeSections.exists_bijective_degreeNToGlobalSections_of_finite
declarations.doc:
Let `S = ⨁_{d ≥ 0} 𝒮 d` be a graded ring whose degree-zero part is Noetherian and which is
generated over that part by finitely many elements `fam 0, …` of `𝒮 1`, let `M = ⨁_{n ∈ ℤ} 𝒨 n`
be a finite graded `S`-module and `X = Proj 𝒮`. The canonical maps

`𝒨 n ⟶ Γ(X, M(n)~)`

of Equation 01MR are isomorphisms for all sufficiently large `n`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_bijective_degreeNToGlobalSections_of_finite [IsNoetherianRing ↥(𝒮 0)]
    [Module.Finite S M] {r : ℕ} (fam : Fin r → S) (hfam : ∀ i, fam i ∈ 𝒮 1)
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin ↥(𝒮 0) (Set.range fam) = ⊤) :
    ∃ n₀ : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n₀ ≤ n → Function.Bijective (degreeNToGlobalSections 𝒮 𝒨 n)
declarations.comment: the maps M_n to Gamma(Proj A, M(n)~) of Equation 01MR are isomorphisms in all sufficiently large degrees, for A_0 Noetherian, A generated over A_0 by finitely many elements of A_1, and M a finite graded A-module

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.isLocallyPrincipal_of_stalk_isPrincipal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AG8.** A closed subscheme of a locally Noetherian scheme is locally
principal if its ideal is principal in the local ring at each point of the subscheme.

Outside the support the ideal of the local ring is the unit ideal, so the hypothesis is only
about points of the subscheme; at each point principality then spreads to an affine
neighbourhood by `Stacks.Divisors.exists_affineOpens_isPrincipal_of_stalk_isPrincipal`.

The companion
`Stacks.Divisors.isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_stalk_isPrincipal_nonZeroDivisor` upgrades the
conclusion to an effective Cartier divisor when the stalk generators are nonzerodivisors.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyPrincipal_of_stalk_isPrincipal {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hI : ∀ x : X, x ∈ I.support → (IdealSheafData.stalk I x).IsPrincipal) :
    IsLocallyPrincipal I

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_stalk_isPrincipal_nonZeroDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AG8.** A closed subscheme of a locally Noetherian scheme is an
effective Cartier divisor if its ideal is generated by a single nonzerodivisor in the local ring
at each point of the subscheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_stalk_isPrincipal_nonZeroDivisor {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hI : ∀ x : X, x ∈ I.support → ∃ g ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x),
      IdealSheafData.stalk I x = Ideal.span {g}) :
    IsEffectiveCartierDivisor I

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.isLocallyPrincipal_of_forall_stalk
declarations.doc:
If the stalk of the ideal sheaf at every point of the closed subscheme can be generated by one
element, the subscheme is locally principal.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyPrincipal_of_forall_stalk [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hst : ∀ x ∈ I.supportSet, ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (hxU : x ∈ (U : Set X)),
      (Ideal.map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU).hom (I.ideal U)).IsPrincipal) :
    IsLocallyPrincipal I

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_forall_stalk
declarations.doc:
If the stalk of the ideal sheaf at every point of the closed subscheme can be generated by a
single nonzerodivisor, the subscheme is an effective Cartier divisor.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_forall_stalk [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hst : ∀ x ∈ I.supportSet, ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (hxU : x ∈ (U : Set X)),
      ∃ ξ ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x),
        Ideal.map (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU).hom (I.ideal U) = Ideal.span {ξ}) :
    IsEffectiveCartierDivisor I

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk_genericPoint
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme and `D ⊆ X` an integral closed subscheme which is an
effective Cartier divisor. The local ring of `X` at the generic point of `D` is a discrete
valuation ring; in particular it is a domain.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk_genericPoint {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) [IsIntegral I.subscheme] (hI : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor I) :
    ∃ _ : IsDomain (X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι (_root_.genericPoint I.subscheme))),
      IsDiscreteValuationRing
        (X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι (_root_.genericPoint I.subscheme)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_codimension_one_of_uniqueFactorizationMonoid
declarations.doc:
A codimension-one integral closed subscheme is an effective Cartier
divisor when the ambient local rings along it are UFDs.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveCartierDivisor_of_codimension_one_of_uniqueFactorizationMonoid
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) [IsIntegral I.subscheme]
    (hcodim : codimension (IrreducibleCloseds.closureSingleton
      (I.subschemeι (_root_.genericPoint I.subscheme))) = 1)
    (hUFD : ∀ x : X, x ∈ I.support →
      UniqueFactorizationMonoid (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    IsEffectiveCartierDivisor I

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_effectiveCartierDivisor_agree_off_codimension_two
declarations.doc:
The Cartier part of a closed subscheme supported, up to codimension two,
on integral effective Cartier divisors.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_effectiveCartierDivisor_agree_off_codimension_two
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (Z : X.IdealSheafData)
    {ι : Type v} (D : ι → X.IdealSheafData) (Z' : Closeds X)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsIntegral (D i).subscheme ∧
      IsEffectiveCartierDivisor (D i))
    (hZ' : ∀ x : X, x ∈ (Z' : Set X) →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ codimension (IrreducibleCloseds.closureSingleton x))
    (hcover : (Z.support : Set X) ⊆
      (Z' : Set X) ∪ ⋃ i, ((D i).support : Set X)) :
    ∃ a : ι →₀ ℕ,
      let E : X.IdealSheafData := a.prod fun i n => (D i) ^ n
      IsEffectiveCartierDivisor E ∧
        Z ≤ E ∧
        ∃ U : X.Opens,
          E.comap U.ι = Z.comap U.ι ∧
          ∀ x : X, x ∈ (Z.support : Set X) → x ∉ (U : Set X) →
            (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ codimension (IrreducibleCloseds.closureSingleton x)
declarations.comment: cartier_part

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_integral_effectiveCartierDivisors_cover
declarations.doc:
A nowhere dense closed subscheme of a Noetherian scheme with factorial local rings
along it, or of a regular scheme, is covered by integral effective Cartier divisors
up to a closed subset of codimension at least two.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_integral_effectiveCartierDivisors_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (Z : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hZ : IsNowhereDense (Z.support : Set X))
    (h : (∀ x : X, x ∈ Z.support →
        UniqueFactorizationMonoid (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ∨ IsRegular X) :
    ∃ (D : Set X.IdealSheafData) (Z' : Closeds X),
      (∀ I ∈ D, IsIntegral I.subscheme ∧
        IsEffectiveCartierDivisor I) ∧
      (∀ x : X, x ∈ (Z' : Set X) →
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ codimension (IrreducibleCloseds.closureSingleton x)) ∧
      (Z.support : Set X) ⊆ (Z' : Set X) ∪ ⋃ I ∈ D, (I.support : Set X)
declarations.comment: supply_divisors

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0462.** If a composite of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally of
finite type, then so is its first factor.

This is also the locally-of-finite-type clause of part (1) of **Stacks 0AGC**, whose other
clauses are in
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/Morphisms/Immersions.lean`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_comp
    {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hfg : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS (f ≫ g)) :
    IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (1): locally of finite type

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativelyRepresentable_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGC, part (1): representability.** If a composite of morphisms of presheaves on
the big fppf site of `S` is representable and the intermediate presheaf has representable
diagonal — in particular, if it is an algebraic space over `S` — then the first factor is
representable.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativelyRepresentable_of_comp (hY : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable (diag Y))
    (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X) (hgf : yoneda.relativelyRepresentable (g ≫ f)) :
    yoneda.relativelyRepresentable g
declarations.comment: part (1): representable

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGC, part (1): separatedness.** If a composite of morphisms of algebraic spaces
over `S` is separated, so is its first factor.

This is also the separated part of **Stacks 03KR**, whose locally separated and
quasi-separated parts are `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallySeparated_of_comp` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiSeparated_of_comp`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_of_comp (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hgf : IsSeparated B S hS (g ≫ f)) :
    IsSeparated B S hS g
declarations.comment: part (1): separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mono_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGC, part (1): monomorphisms.** If a composite of morphisms of algebraic spaces
over `S` is a monomorphism, so is its first factor.

Monomorphy of a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` is monomorphy of the underlying morphism
of presheaves on the big fppf site of `S`, by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mono_hom_iff_mono` of
`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/Morphisms/Monomorphisms.lean`, so this clause is the
cancellation of monomorphisms `CategoryTheory.mono_of_mono` read in that presheaf category.
Nothing is required of `Y`.
declarations.statement: theorem mono_of_comp (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X) (hgf : Mono (g ≫ f)) : Mono g
declarations.comment: part (1): monomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isImmersion_of_comp_of_isLocallySeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGC, part (2).** If a composite of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is an
immersion and its second factor is locally separated, then its first factor is an
immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isImmersion_of_comp_of_isLocallySeparated (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hgf : IsImmersion B S hS (g ≫ f)) (hf : IsLocallySeparated B S hS f) :
    IsImmersion B S hS g
declarations.comment: part (2): immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedImmersion_of_comp_of_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGC, part (3).** If a composite of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is a
closed immersion and its second factor is separated, then its first factor is a closed
immersion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_of_comp_of_isSeparated (g : Z ⟶ Y) (f : Y ⟶ X)
    (hgf : IsClosedImmersion B S hS (g ≫ f)) (hf : IsSeparated B S hS f) :
    IsClosedImmersion B S hS g
declarations.comment: part (3): closed immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 03XN.** If a composite of morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally
quasi-finite, then so is its first factor.

Local quasi-finiteness of morphisms of schemes is étale local on the source and target
(Stacks 04R3) and is inherited by the first factor of a composite that has it, local finite
type by Stacks 01T8 and the fibre condition by `AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyQuasiFinite.of_comp`,
so this is an instance of the cancellation form of Stacks 03MJ.

This is also the locally-quasi-finite clause of part (1) of **Stacks 0AGC**, whose other
clauses are in `StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/Morphisms/Immersions.lean`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_of_comp {F G H : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS F) (hG : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS G)
    (hH : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS H)
    (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ H)
    (hfg : IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS (f ≫ g)) :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f
declarations.comment: part (1): locally quasi-finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSurjective_toSchemeTheoreticImage_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGD, second assertion.** Let `h : X ⟶ Y`, `f : X ⟶ T` and `g : Y ⟶ T` be
morphisms of algebraic spaces over `S` with `h ≫ g = f`. If `f` is proper and `g` is separated,
then the morphism from `X` to the scheme-theoretic image of `h` is surjective.

The image of `|X|` in `|Z|` is dense, by part (4) of Stacks 082Z, `h` being quasi-compact by
Stacks 03KS; and it is closed, being the preimage along the continuous injection `|Z| → |Y|` of
the image of `|X|` in `|Y|`, which is closed by part (1) of Stacks 04NX.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSurjective_toSchemeTheoreticImage_of_isProper
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T) (h : X ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ T) (g : Y ⟶ T)
    (hcomm : h ≫ g = f) (hf : IsProper B S hS f) (hg : IsSeparated B S hS g) :
    IsSurjective B S hS (toSchemeTheoreticImage B S hS h)
declarations.comment: second assertion: surjectivity onto the scheme-theoretic image

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_schemeTheoreticImageSubfunctor_inclusion_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGD, first assertion.** Let `h : X ⟶ Y`, `f : X ⟶ T` and `g : Y ⟶ T` be morphisms
of algebraic spaces over `S` with `h ≫ g = f`. If `f` is proper and `g` is separated and
locally of finite type, then the scheme-theoretic image of `h` is proper over `T`.

The scheme-theoretic image is a closed subspace of `Y` (Stacks 082X), so its structure morphism
over `T` is separated by Stacks 04CH and Stacks 03KQ, and locally of finite type by Stacks 03XG;
it is quasi-compact by part (2) of Stacks 040W, `X ⟶ T` being quasi-compact and `X` surjecting
onto the image by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSurjective_toSchemeTheoreticImage_of_isProper`. Properness is then
the second assertion of Stacks 08AJ, `f` being universally closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_schemeTheoreticImageSubfunctor_inclusion_comp
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hT : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS T) (h : X ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ T) (g : Y ⟶ T)
    (hcomm : h ≫ g = f) (hf : IsProper B S hS f) (hg : IsSeparated B S hS g)
    (hgft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS g) :
    IsProper B S hS ((schemeTheoreticImageSubfunctor B S hS h).ι ≫ g)
declarations.comment: first assertion: the scheme-theoretic image is proper over the base

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.universallyInjective_of_injective_pointsMap_pullback_of_isEtale_yoneda
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is
locally of finite type, and assume that for every étale morphism `V ⟶ Y` from a scheme `V` the
map `|X ×_Y V| → |V|` is injective. Then `f` is universally injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem universallyInjective_of_injective_pointsMap_pullback_of_isEtale_yoneda
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hinj : ∀ (V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y), IsEtale B S hS g →
      Function.Injective (pointsMap B S hS (pullback g f) (pullback.fst g f))) :
    UniversallyInjective B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properKernelPairCoequalizers_of_core
declarations.doc:
Let `g : Y ⟶ X` be a proper morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `X` locally
Noetherian and let `R = Y ×_X Y` with its two projections `s, t : R ⟶ Y`. Then `s` and `t` have a
coequalizer `X'` in the category of algebraic spaces over `S`, and: (1) the morphism `X' ⟶ X` is
finite; (2) the morphism `Y ⟶ X'` is proper; (3) the morphism `Y ⟶ X'` is surjective; (4) the
morphism `X' ⟶ X` is universally injective; (5) if `g` is surjective, the morphism `X' ⟶ X` is a
universal homeomorphism. Existence of the coequalizer and clauses (1) to (4) are the hypothesis
`hcore`.
declarations.statement:
theorem properKernelPairCoequalizers_of_core
    (hcore : ProperKernelPairCoequalizerCore B S hS) :
    ProperKernelPairCoequalizers B S hS
declarations.comment: all six clauses; clause (5) is proved from the others, while existence of the coequalizer and clauses (1) to (4) are carried in the hypothesis

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properKernelPairCoequalizers_holds
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGG.** Let `S` be a scheme and let `g : Y ⟶ X` be a morphism of algebraic spaces
over `S` with `X` locally Noetherian and `g` proper. Let `R = Y ×_X Y` with projections
`s, t : R ⟶ Y`. There exists a coequalizer `X'` of `s, t : R ⟶ Y` in the category of algebraic
spaces over `S`. Moreover
1. the morphism `X' ⟶ X` is finite;
2. the morphism `Y ⟶ X'` is proper;
3. the morphism `Y ⟶ X'` is surjective;
4. the morphism `X' ⟶ X` is universally injective;
5. if `g` is surjective, the morphism `X' ⟶ X` is a universal homeomorphism.

The statement `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.ProperKernelPairCoequalizers` consists of exactly these
six clauses: existence of the coequalizer as an
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.KernelPairCoequalizer` (a colimit cofork of the kernel pair in the
category of algebraic spaces over `S`), and clauses (1) to (5) for every such coequalizer.
Everything is proved here, unconditionally: nothing is carried as a hypothesis. The two inputs
of the proof, the proper case of Stacks 0GFW and the translation step of Stacks 0GG0, are the
theorems `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.descentEffectiveAlongProperSurjective` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.etaleSpaceDescentEffectiveOfSheafDescent`.
declarations.statement: theorem properKernelPairCoequalizers_holds : ProperKernelPairCoequalizers B S hS

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoequalizerGlueSituation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGH.** The standing situation for the coequalizer construction: a locally
Noetherian algebraic space `X` over `S`, a closed immersion `i : Z ⟶ X` with complementary open
subspace `U`, and a proper morphism `f : X' ⟶ X` which is an isomorphism over `U`.
declarations.statement: structure CoequalizerGlueSituation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoequalizerGlueSituation.exists_glueCoequalizer
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGI.** In Situation 0AGH (`X` locally Noetherian over `S`, `Z ⟶ X` a closed
immersion with complementary open `U`, `f : X' ⟶ X` proper and an isomorphism over `U`), let
`Y = X' ⨿ Z` and `R = Y ×_X Y` with projections `s, t : R ⟶ Y`. There exists a coequalizer `X₁`
of `s, t` in the category of algebraic spaces over `S`; the morphism `X₁ ⟶ X` is finite and a
universal homeomorphism, it is an isomorphism over `U` (its base change along `U ⟶ X` is an
isomorphism), and `Z ⟶ X` lifts to `X₁`. Everything is proved: Stacks 0AGG is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properKernelPairCoequalizers_holds`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_glueCoequalizer :
    ∃ D : KernelPairCoequalizer T.B T.S T.hS T.glueMap,
      IsFinite T.B T.S T.hS D.toTarget.hom ∧
      UniversalHomeomorphism T.B T.S T.hS D.toTarget.hom ∧
      IsIso (pullback.snd D.toTarget.hom T.U.ι) ∧
      ∃ l : T.closedSpace ⟶ D.space, l ≫ D.toTarget = ObjectProperty.homMk T.i
declarations.comment: the coequalizer X₁ exists, X₁ ⟶ X is finite, a universal homeomorphism and an isomorphism over U, and Z ⟶ X lifts to X₁

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoequalizerGlueSituation.ClosedSubspaceSystem.towerMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGJ.** The morphism `X_n ⟶ X_{n+1}` of the tower
`X_1 ⟶ X_2 ⟶ X_3 ⟶ … ⟶ X`, induced by the morphisms `Y_n ⟶ Y_{n+1}` and `R_n ⟶ R_{n+1}`.
declarations.statement: def towerMap (n : ℕ) : (D n).space ⟶ (D (n + 1)).space
declarations.comment: the morphism of the tower

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoequalizerGlueSituation.ClosedSubspaceSystem.towerMap_comp_toTarget
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGJ.** Each morphism of the tower `X_1 ⟶ X_2 ⟶ X_3 ⟶ … ⟶ X` is a morphism over
`X`: the triangle formed with the two morphisms to `X` commutes.
declarations.statement:
theorem towerMap_comp_toTarget (n : ℕ) :
    N.towerMap D n ≫ (D (n + 1)).toTarget = (D n).toTarget
declarations.comment: the tower is a tower over X

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoequalizerGlueSituation.exists_factorsThroughSection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGK.** In Situation 0AGH assume `X` quasi-compact. Let `Z_n` be the infinitesimal
neighbourhoods of `Z` in `X` and `X_n` the coequalizers of the kernel pairs of
`X' ⨿ Z_n ⟶ X`, forming the tower `X_1 ⟶ X_2 ⟶ X_3 ⟶ … ⟶ X` of Stacks 0AGJ (for any choice
`D` of these coequalizers, which exist by Stacks 0AGI). Then for all `n` large enough there is
an `m` such that `X_n ⟶ X_{n+m}` factors through a closed immersion `X ⟶ X_{n+m}`; the closed
immersion is moreover a section of `X_{n+m} ⟶ X`. Everything is proved: Stacks 0AGG is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properKernelPairCoequalizers_holds`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_factorsThroughSection (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace T.B T.S T.hS T.X)
    (D : ∀ n, KernelPairCoequalizer T.B T.S T.hS (T.neighbourhoodSystem.glueMapAt n)) :
    ∃ n₀, ∀ n, n₀ ≤ n → ∃ m, T.neighbourhoodSystem.FactorsThroughSection D n m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.CoequalizerGlueSituation.exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGL.** In Situation 0AGH with `X` quasi-compact, the system
`X_1 ⟶ X_2 ⟶ X_3 ⟶ …` of Stacks 0AGJ (for any choice `D` of the coequalizers) is essentially
constant with value `X` in the sense of Stacks 05PU, with respect to the cocone of the morphisms
`X_n ⟶ X`. Everything is proved: Stacks 0AGG is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.properKernelPairCoequalizers_holds`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isEssentiallyConstantWith (hqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace T.B T.S T.hS T.X)
    (D : ∀ n, KernelPairCoequalizer T.B T.S T.hS (T.neighbourhoodSystem.glueMapAt n)) :
    ∃ (i : ℕ) (r : T.targetSpace ⟶ (D i).space),
      CategoryTheory.EssentiallyConstantInd.IsEssentiallyConstantWith
        (T.neighbourhoodSystem.towerDiagram D)
        (T.neighbourhoodSystem.towerCocone D) i r

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedImmersion_of_isClosedImmersion_specialFibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AGM.** Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a Noetherian local ring and let `g : X ⟶ Y` be a
morphism of proper modifications of `Spec A` outside its punctured spectrum. If the induced
morphism `X_κ ⟶ Y_κ` of special fibres — the base change of `g` along the closed point
`Spec κ → Spec A` — is a closed immersion, then `g` is a closed immersion.

This is the case `Z = Spec A` of Stacks 05XA: the open subspace of `Spec A` that lemma produces
contains the closed point, hence is the whole of `Spec A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_of_isClosedImmersion_specialFibre
    {X Y : ProperModification A B hS} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (hg : IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of A)) hS
      (baseChangeOverBase B (Spec (.of A)) hS g.hom.left X.1.hom Y.1.hom g.hom.w
        (yoneda.map (residueSpecToBase A B hS)))) :
    IsClosedImmersion B (Spec (.of A)) hS g.hom.left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_iso_isProjective_of_isIntegralModification
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a complete Noetherian local domain of dimension `2`. Every modification
`f : X ⟶ Spec A` (Stacks 0AD8) is projective over `A`: `X` is a scheme `Y`, in the sense that
there are a projective morphism of schemes `fY : Y ⟶ Spec A` and an isomorphism of `X` with the
algebraic space `Y` over `Spec A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_isProjective_of_isIntegralModification
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsDomain A]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal A) A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2)
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (hS : B.Contains (Spec (.of A)))
    {X : (BigFppfOver B (Spec (.of A)) hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B (Spec (.of A)) hS X)
    (f : X ⟶ yoneda.obj (baseObject A B hS))
    (hf : IsIntegralModification B (Spec (.of A)) hS hX
      (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B (Spec (.of A)) hS _)
      (isIntegralSpace_yoneda_baseTerminal A B hS) f) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : B.Contains Y) (fY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)),
      IsProjective fY ∧ IsProjectiveMorphism fY ∧
      ∃ e : X ≅ yoneda.obj (siteObject B (Spec (.of A)) hS hY fY),
        e.hom ≫ yoneda.map (siteObjectToBase A B hS hY fY) = f

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.exists_isClosedImmersion_isPullback_projectiveLine_blowUpSpec_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)` be a regular local ring of dimension two and let `X ⟶ Spec A` be the blowup of
`Spec A` in `𝔪`. There is a closed immersion `r : X ⟶ 𝐏¹_{Spec A}` over `Spec A` whose restriction
to the exceptional divisor is an isomorphism `E ≅ 𝐏¹_κ`.

The exceptional divisor is the fibre `E = X ×_{Spec A} Spec κ`, so the last clause is stated as:
there is a morphism `s : 𝐏¹_κ ⟶ X` over `Spec κ ⟶ Spec A` making `𝐏¹_κ` that fibre — the cartesian
square — whose composite with `r` is the standard closed immersion `𝐏¹_κ ⟶ 𝐏¹_{Spec A}` given by
reduction of coefficients. The cartesian square says that `s` induces an isomorphism `𝐏¹_κ ≅ E`,
and the identity says that this isomorphism is the one induced by `r`, that is `(r|_E)⁻¹`.

Here `𝐏¹_κ` is `Proj κ[T₀,T₁]`, and `r` is the closed immersion of
`Stacks.Blowup.exists_isClosedImmersion_blowUpSpec_maximalIdeal`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClosedImmersion_isPullback_projectiveLine_blowUpSpec_maximalIdeal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2) :
    ∃ r : blowUpSpec (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ⟶
        AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) A),
      IsClosedImmersion r ∧
        r ≫ projSpaceToSpec A 2 = toSpec (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ∧
        ∃ s : AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2)
              (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) ⟶
            blowUpSpec (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A),
          IsPullback s (projSpaceToSpec (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) 2)
              (toSpec (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue A))) ∧
            s ≫ r = Proj.map
                (Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.polyGradedMap (Fin 2) (IsLocalRing.residue A))
                (Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.irrelevant_le_map_polyGradedMap (Fin 2)
                  (IsLocalRing.residue A))
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.exists_isClosedImmersion_blowUpSpec_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AGQ.** Let `A` be a regular local ring of dimension two and let
`X ⟶ Spec A` be the blowup of `Spec A` in its maximal ideal. There is a closed immersion
`r : X ⟶ 𝐏¹_{Spec A}` over `Spec A`.

The projective line over `Spec A` is `Proj A[T₀, T₁]`, the presentation the source uses.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClosedImmersion_blowUpSpec_maximalIdeal (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsRegularLocalRing A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2) :
    ∃ r : blowUpSpec (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) ⟶
        Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) A),
      IsClosedImmersion r ∧
        r ≫ projSpaceToSpec A 2 = toSpec (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
declarations.comment: the closed immersion of the blowup into the projective line over the base

declarations.name: Stacks.Blowup.exists_isClosedImmersion_blowUpSpec_maximalIdeal_exceptional_projectiveLine
declarations.doc:
**The blowup of a regular local surface in its closed point embeds in `𝐏¹`.** Let `(A, 𝔪, κ)`
be a regular local ring of dimension `2`, let `f : X = Proj (⨁ₙ 𝔪ⁿ) ⟶ S = Spec A` be the blowing up
of `A` in `𝔪` and let `E ⊆ X` be its exceptional divisor. There is a closed immersion
`r : X ⟶ 𝐏¹_S = Proj A[T₀, T₁]` over `S` such that

1. `r|_E : E ⟶ 𝐏¹_κ = Proj κ[T₀, T₁]` is an isomorphism: there is an isomorphism `ρ : E ≅ 𝐏¹_κ`
   whose composite with the inclusion of the special fibre `𝐏¹_κ ⟶ 𝐏¹_S` is the restriction
   `E ⟶ X ⟶ 𝐏¹_S` of `r`;
2. `𝒪_X(E) ≅ 𝒪_X(-1)` and `r^*𝒪_{𝐏¹_S}(-1) ≅ 𝒪_X(-1)`;
3. `𝒞_{E/X} ≅ ρ^*𝒪_{𝐏¹_κ}(1)` and `𝒩_{E/X} ≅ ρ^*𝒪_{𝐏¹_κ}(-1)`, with `ρ = r|_E` of (1).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClosedImmersion_blowUpSpec_maximalIdeal_exceptional_projectiveLine
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2) :
    ∃ r : blowUpSpec (maximalIdeal A) ⟶ Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) A),
      IsClosedImmersion r ∧
      r ≫ projSpaceToSpec A 2 = toSpec (maximalIdeal A) ∧
      ∃ ρ : (exceptionalIdealData (maximalIdeal A)).subscheme ≅
          Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) (A ⧸ maximalIdeal A)),
        (exceptionalIdealData (maximalIdeal A)).subschemeι ≫ r =
          ρ.hom ≫ Proj.map
            (Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.polyGradedMap (Fin 2)
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal A)))
            (Stacks.ProjectiveCohomology.irrelevant_le_map_polyGradedMap (Fin 2)
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk (maximalIdeal A))) ∧
        Nonempty (Stacks.Divisors.invertibleSheaf' (exceptionalIdealData (maximalIdeal A)) ≅
          twistingSheaf (reesGrading (maximalIdeal A)) (-1)) ∧
        Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback r).obj
            (twistingSheaf (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) A) (-1)) ≅
          twistingSheaf (reesGrading (maximalIdeal A)) (-1)) ∧
        Nonempty (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheaf
            (exceptionalIdealData (maximalIdeal A)).subschemeι ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback ρ.hom).obj
            (twistingSheaf
              (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) (A ⧸ maximalIdeal A)) 1)) ∧
        Nonempty (Stacks.Divisors.normalSheaf
            (exceptionalIdealData (maximalIdeal A)).subschemeι ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback ρ.hom).obj
            (twistingSheaf
              (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) (A ⧸ maximalIdeal A)) (-1)))
declarations.comment: for the blowup X of Spec A in the maximal ideal of a regular local ring (A, m, kappa) of dimension 2, with exceptional divisor E: there is a closed immersion r : X -> P^1_S = Proj A[T_0, T_1] over S = Spec A, and an isomorphism rho : E -> P^1_kappa = Proj kappa[T_0, T_1] whose composite with the inclusion of the special fibre P^1_kappa -> P^1_S is r restricted to E, such that O_X(E) = O_X(-1) = r^* O_{P^1_S}(-1), C_{E/X} = rho^* O_{P^1_kappa}(1) and N_{E/X} = rho^* O_{P^1_kappa}(-1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleSpace_blowUp_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AGR.** The blowup of a two-dimensional regular local ring at its
closed point is irreducible.
declarations.statement:
public theorem irreducibleSpace_blowUp_maximalIdeal (A : Type u) [CommRing A]

**Stacks Project, Tag 0AGR.** The blowup of a two-dimensional regular local ring at its
closed point is a regular scheme.
