of finite type and étale over `U`. Then `f` factors as `X' ⟶ X'' ⟶ X` where `X'' ⟶ X` is locally
of finite type and an isomorphism over `U`, and `X' ⟶ X''` induces an isomorphism
`X'_{/T} ⟶ X''_{/T}` of completions.

Here `U` is the open subspace with point set `Tᶜ`, and "over `U`" is the base change along its
inclusion.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_factorization_isIso_completionSheafMap
    {X X' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hX' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X')
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T)
    (f : X' ⟶ X) (hf : Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (hfU : Space.IsEtale B S hS (pullback.snd f
      ((Space.openSubspacesOrderIso B S hS X hX).symm ⟨Tᶜ, hT.isOpen_compl⟩).1.ι)) :
    ∃ (X'' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (_ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X'')
      (g : X' ⟶ X'') (p : X'' ⟶ X),
      g ≫ p = f ∧ Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS p ∧
        IsIso (pullback.snd p
          ((Space.openSubspacesOrderIso B S hS X hX).symm ⟨Tᶜ, hT.isOpen_compl⟩).1.ι) ∧
        IsIso (Space.completionSheafMap B S hS g (Space.pointsMap B S hS X'' p ⁻¹' T))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.exists_factorization_of_isEtale_openComplementRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0AR9.** Let `S` be a scheme contained in a big fppf site `B`, let `X` be an algebraic
space over `S` and let `T ⊆ |X|` be closed. Let `f : X' ⟶ X` be a morphism of algebraic spaces
which is locally of finite type and étale outside of `T`, i.e. whose restriction
`U' = f⁻¹U ⟶ U` to the open subspace `U` with `|U| = |X| ∖ T` is étale. Then `f` factors as
`X' ⟶ X'' ⟶ X` where

* `X''` is an algebraic space and `X'' ⟶ X` is locally of finite type,
* `X'' ⟶ X` is an isomorphism over `U`: its base change to `U` is an isomorphism, and
* `X'_{/T} ⟶ X''_{/T}` is an isomorphism, the completion of `X' ⟶ X''` along the inverse image
  of `T` in the sense of Section 0GDB, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.completionSheafMap`.

The source assumes moreover that `X` is locally Noetherian; its proof does not use that
hypothesis, so it is dropped here.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_factorization_of_isEtale_openComplementRestriction
    {X X' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hX' : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X') (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T)
    (f : X' ⟶ X) (hft : Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (het : Space.IsEtale B S hS (Space.openComplementRestriction B S hS f T)) :
    ∃ (X'' : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (_ : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X'')
      (g : X' ⟶ X'') (h : X'' ⟶ X), g ≫ h = f ∧ Space.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS h ∧
        IsIso (pullback.snd h (Space.openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS X Tᶜ).ι) ∧
        IsIso (Space.completionSheafMap B S hS g (Space.pointsMap B S hS X'' h ⁻¹' T))
declarations.comment: stated without the hypothesis that X be locally Noetherian, which the source's proof does not use; X'' ⟶ X is an isomorphism over U in the form that its base change to the open subspace with point set |X| ∖ T is an isomorphism, and the completions are the completionSheafMap of Section 0GDB

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isEquivalence_completionModificationFunctor_affineOver
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARA.** Let `S` be a scheme, let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over
`S` which is affine, so `X = Spec R` with `R` Noetherian, let `T ⊆ |X|` be closed and let
`U ⊂ X` be the open subspace with `|U| = |X| ∖ T`. Then the completion functor of Stacks 0AR5,
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.completionModificationFunctor`, from the morphisms `f : X' ⟶ X`
of algebraic spaces which are locally of finite type and an isomorphism over `U` to the
morphisms `g : W ⟶ X_{/T}` of formal algebraic spaces with `W` locally Noetherian and `g`
rig-étale, is an equivalence.

Full faithfulness is Stacks 0GDR
(`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.completionModificationFunctorFullyFaithful`). Essential
surjectivity is `exists_finiteTypeModification_completion_iso_of_isRigEtale`, assembled as in the
source from Step 1 (Stacks 0AR4 and 0AR9), Step 2 (a separated `W`: Stacks 0AR8 and 04S6 applied
to the algebraizations of an affine étale covering) and Step 3 (a general `W`, whose
`Wᵢ ×_W Wⱼ` are separated).
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_completionModificationFunctor_affineOver
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (hR : B.Contains (Spec (.of R)))
    (s : Spec (.of R) ⟶ S)
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS (yoneda.obj (affineOver B S hS hR s)))) (hT : IsClosed T) :
    (completionModificationFunctor T hT (isAlgebraicSpace_yoneda B S hS (affineOver B S hS hR s))
      (Space.isLocallyNoetherian_yoneda_affineOver hR s)).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isEquivalence_completionModificationFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARB.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S`, let `T ⊆ |X|` be
closed and let `U ⊂ X` be the open subspace with `|U| = |X| ∖ T`. The completion functor of
Stacks 0AR5 sends `f : X' ⟶ X` to `f_{/T} : X'_{/T'} ⟶ X_{/T}`. Its source is the morphisms of
algebraic spaces which are locally of finite type and an isomorphism over `U`. Its target is the
morphisms `g : W ⟶ X_{/T}` of formal algebraic spaces with `W` locally Noetherian and `g`
rig-étale. This functor is an equivalence.

Full faithfulness is Stacks 0GDR (`completionModificationFunctorFullyFaithful`). For essential
surjectivity, the base change of `W` to each affine étale chart `Spec R ⟶ X`, `R` Noetherian, is
an object of the right-hand category for `Spec R` (`rigEtaleOverCompletionBaseChange`, through
Stacks 0GD1). By Stacks 0ARA
(`exists_finiteTypeModification_completion_iso_of_isRigEtale`) it is the completion of a
finite-type modification of `Spec R`. These glue
(`mem_essImage_completionModificationFunctor_of_affine_charts`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_completionModificationFunctor {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T) (hXsp : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hX : Space.IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X) :
    (completionModificationFunctor T hT hXsp hX).IsEquivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Examples.derivedCompleteModules_abelian_exact_colimits_not_grothendieck
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARD.** Let `A` be a ring and `I ⊂ A` an ideal. The category `C` of derived complete
`A`-modules is abelian, and the inclusion `F : C ⥤ ModuleCat A` is exact and preserves all limits.
If `I` is finitely generated, then `C` has all direct sums and all colimits.

These are not preserved by `F` in general, and filtered colimits in `C` are not exact in general,
so that `C` is not a Grothendieck abelian category: all of this fails for `A = ℤ_[2]` and
`I = (2)`, where `F` does not preserve countable direct sums or colimits, sequential colimits in
`C` are not exact, `C` does not satisfy AB5, and no abelian structure on `C` is Grothendieck.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedCompleteModules_abelian_exact_colimits_not_grothendieck :
    (∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A),
      letI : HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
        Stacks.DerivedProducts.hasProductsOfShape_derivedCategory
      let P : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat.{u} A) := fun M => IsDerivedCompleteModule I M
      let C := P.FullSubcategory
      let F : C ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} A := P.ι
      Nonempty (Abelian C) ∧ PreservesFiniteLimits F ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits F ∧
        HasLimits C ∧ PreservesLimits F ∧
        (I.FG → HasCoproducts.{u} C ∧ HasColimits C)) ∧
    (letI : HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat (ℤ_[2]))) :=
        Stacks.DerivedProducts.hasProductsOfShape_derivedCategory
      let I : Ideal ℤ_[2] := Ideal.span {2}
      let P : ObjectProperty (ModuleCat (ℤ_[2])) := fun M => IsDerivedCompleteModule I M
      let C := P.FullSubcategory
      let F : C ⥤ ModuleCat (ℤ_[2]) := P.ι
      I.FG ∧ ¬ PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) F ∧ ¬ PreservesColimits F ∧
        (∃ _ : HasColimitsOfShape ℕ C, ¬ HasExactColimitsOfShape ℕ C) ∧
        (∃ _ : HasFilteredColimits C, ¬ AB5 C) ∧
        ∀ [Abelian C], ¬ IsGrothendieckAbelian C)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.counterexamples_algebraization_of_not_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARF.** Counterexamples to algebraization of coherent sheaves without separatedness:

1. Grothendieck's existence theorem (Stacks 088E) fails without separatedness: it is not true
   that for every Noetherian ring `A` complete with respect to an ideal `I` and every morphism
   `f : X ⟶ Spec A` locally of finite type and quasi-compact, the completion functor from coherent
   `𝒪_X`-modules with support proper over `A` to coherent `I`-adic systems with support proper
   over `A` is an equivalence;
2. there is a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, of finite presentation
   and flat but not separated, whose stack of coherent sheaves `Coh_{X/Y}` is not an algebraic
   stack (so Stacks 09DS and 08WC fail without separatedness);
3. there is a Quot situation `f : X ⟶ B` over a scheme `S`, of finite presentation and flat but not
   separated, with `F` of finite presentation, such that the functor `Quot_{F/X/B}` has a model in
   the universe of the site but no model is an algebraic space (so Stacks 09TU fails without
   separatedness).
declarations.statement:
theorem counterexamples_algebraization_of_not_isSeparated :
    (¬ ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
        {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f],
        (Stacks.Algebraization.completionFunctorProperOver A I f).IsEquivalence) ∧
    (∃ (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
        (D : Space.CoherentSituation B S hS),
      Space.IsFlat B S hS D.f.hom ∧ ¬ Space.IsSeparated B S hS D.f.hom ∧
        ¬ Stack.IsAlgebraicStack.{u, w} B S hS D.coherentCFG.val) ∧
    (∃ (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
        (D : Space.QuotSituation B S hS),
      Space.IsFlat B S hS D.f.hom ∧ ¬ Space.IsSeparated B S hS D.f.hom ∧
        D.F.IsFinitePresentationOnSite ∧ Nonempty (Space.QuotSitePresheafModel D) ∧
        ∀ N : Space.QuotSitePresheafModel D, ¬ IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS N.presheaf)
declarations.comment: all three counterexamples: (1) 088E fails without separatedness, (2) Coh_{X/Y} of 09DS and 08WC is not algebraic for a flat morphism of finite presentation which is not separated, (3) Quot_{F/X/B} of 09TU (F = O_X of finite presentation) is not an algebraic space for such a morphism; witness: Spec k[[t]] with its closed point doubled

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_lift_of_dominatingExtension
declarations.doc:
**A lift of a dominating extension of a valuative square for a separated morphism of
algebraic spaces descends to a lift of the square itself.** The extension `K'/K` of fraction
fields is arbitrary: no finiteness or separability condition is imposed on it.

The descent step needs the sheaf condition for the single faithfully flat covering
`Spec A' ⟶ Spec A`; it is supplied by the fpqc sheaf condition
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace.isSheaf_fpqc` for `X`, which is Stacks 0APL.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_lift_of_dominatingExtension
    (hX : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y)
    (hf : AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsSeparated B S hS f)
    (q : ValuativeSquare f) (e : q.DominatingExtension)
    (he : Nonempty e.square.Lift) :
    Nonempty q.Lift

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_discreteValuativeUniqueness
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARJ.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y` locally
Noetherian. If `f` is locally of finite type and quasi-separated, and every valuative square for
`f` whose valuation ring is a discrete valuation ring admits at most one dotted arrow, then `f`
is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_discreteValuativeUniqueness
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hNoeth : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (hft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) (hqs : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f)
    (hu : ∀ q : ValuativeSquare f, IsDiscreteValuationRing q.R → Subsingleton q.Lift) :
    IsSeparated B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_discreteValuativeCriterion

**Stacks 0ARK.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y`

    (hlift : ∀ q : ValuativeSquare f, IsDiscreteValuationRing q.R →

    IsProper B S hS f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isSeparated_iff_discreteValuativeUniqueness_of_isCofinal
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y` locally Noetherian, and
assume `f` is locally of finite type and quasi-separated. Let `P` be a class of discrete valuation
rings such that every discrete valuation ring has an extension in the class. If every valuative
square for `f` whose valuation ring is a discrete valuation ring in the class admits at most one
dotted arrow, then `f` is separated; and conversely.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_iff_discreteValuativeUniqueness_of_isCofinal
    {P : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A], Prop}
    (cofinal : IsCofinalDiscreteValuationRingClass B P)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (algX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (algY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (noethY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (finf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) (qsepf : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f) :
    IsSeparated B S hS f ↔
      ∀ q : ValuativeSquare f, ∀ _ : IsDiscreteValuationRing q.R, P q.R → Subsingleton q.Lift
declarations.comment:
Lemma 69.19.1 (0ARJ) for any class of discrete valuation rings in which every
discrete valuation ring has an extension

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_iff_discreteValuativeCriterion_of_isCofinal
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y` locally Noetherian, and
assume `f` is of finite type and quasi-separated. Let `P` be a class of discrete valuation rings
such that every discrete valuation ring has an extension in the class. If for every valuative
square for `f` whose valuation ring `A` is a discrete valuation ring in the class there is an
extension `A ⊂ A'` of discrete valuation rings in the class, inducing an extension of fraction
fields, over which the square has exactly one dotted arrow `Spec A' ⟶ X`, then `f` is proper; and
conversely.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_iff_discreteValuativeCriterion_of_isCofinal
    {P : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A], Prop}
    (cofinal : IsCofinalDiscreteValuationRingClass B P)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (algX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (algY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (noethY : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS Y (fun T : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (finf : IsFiniteType B S hS f) (qsepf : IsQuasiSeparated B S hS f) :
    IsProper B S hS f ↔ ∀ q : ValuativeSquare f, ∀ _ : IsDiscreteValuationRing q.R, P q.R →
      ∃ e : q.DominatingExtension, ∃ _ : IsDiscreteValuationRing e.square.R, P e.square.R ∧
        Nonempty e.square.Lift ∧ Subsingleton e.square.Lift
declarations.comment:
Lemma 69.19.2 (0ARK) for any class of discrete valuation rings in which every
discrete valuation ring has an extension

Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y` locally Noetherian, and

theorem isSeparated_iff_completeDiscreteValuativeUniqueness

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isProper_iff_completeDiscreteValuativeCriterion
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` with `Y` locally Noetherian, and
assume `f` is of finite type and quasi-separated. If for every valuative square for `f` whose
valuation ring `A` is a complete discrete valuation ring, with fraction field `K`, there is an
extension `A ⊂ A'` of complete discrete valuation rings inducing an extension `K ⊂ K'` of fraction
fields over which the square has exactly one dotted arrow `Spec A' ⟶ X`, then `f` is proper; and
conversely.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_iff_completeDiscreteValuativeCriterion
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (algX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (algY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y)

    IsProper B S hS f ↔ ∀ q : ValuativeSquare f, IsDiscreteValuationRing q.R →
      IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal q.R) q.R →
      ∃ e : q.DominatingExtension, IsDiscreteValuationRing e.square.R ∧
        IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal e.square.R) e.square.R ∧
        Nonempty e.square.Lift ∧ Subsingleton e.square.Lift
declarations.comment: Lemma 69.19.2 (0ARK) with complete discrete valuation rings

theorem isProper_iff_completeAlgClosedDiscreteValuativeCriterion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.HasQuasiCompactDiagonal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARN, part (2).** A morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` is
*quasi-separated* when its relative diagonal `X ⟶ X ×_Y X` is a quasi-compact morphism of
formal algebraic spaces, quasi-compactness being `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsQuasiCompact`,
the condition of Stacks 0AJC. The condition makes sense, and is stated, for an arbitrary
morphism of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S`.
declarations.statement: abbrev HasQuasiCompactDiagonal {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (2): quasi-separated, the relative diagonal quasi-compact in the sense of Stacks 0AJC

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsSeparatedMorphism
declarations.doc:
A morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` is *separated* when its relative diagonal
is a closed immersion, stated for an arbitrary morphism of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site
of `S`.
declarations.statement: abbrev IsSeparatedMorphism {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) : Prop
declarations.comment: part (1): separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.HasQuasiCompactDiagonal.of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARP** for the quasi-separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN: a base change of a
quasi-separated morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` is quasi-separated. In a
cartesian square of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose right-hand column `f` is
quasi-separated, the left-hand column `snd` is quasi-separated, since the relative diagonal of
`snd` is a base change of the relative diagonal of `f` and quasi-compact morphisms are stable
under base change. As with the definition itself, no hypothesis that the four sheaves are
formal algebraic spaces is needed.
declarations.comment: quasi-separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
A base change of a separated morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` is separated: in a
cartesian square of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose right-hand column `f` is
separated, the left-hand column `snd` is separated.
declarations.comment: separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isQuasiCompact_mapDesc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARQ, part (3).** For morphisms `f : X ⟶ Z`, `g : Y ⟶ Z` and `h : Z ⟶ T` of
formal algebraic spaces over `S` with `h` quasi-separated, the comparison
`X ×_Z Y ⟶ X ×_T Y` of the two fibre products is a quasi-compact morphism of formal algebraic
spaces.

The whole content is one cartesian square, the *magic diagram* of Mathlib's
`CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback_map_diagonal_isPullback`: the comparison is a base change of
the relative diagonal of `h`, along the morphism `X ×_T Y ⟶ Z ×_T Z` induced by `f` and `g`.
Quasi-separatedness of `h` says that relative diagonal is quasi-compact, and quasi-compactness
is stable under base change by
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsQuasiCompact.of_isPullback`. No hypothesis on `f`, `g` or the
four sheaves is needed, so the statement is made for arbitrary fppf sheaves, as both conditions
occurring in it are.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_mapDesc {X Y Z T : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (h : Z ⟶ T) (hh : HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS h) :
    IsQuasiCompact B S hS (pullback.mapDesc f g h)
declarations.comment: part (3), for Z ⟶ T quasi-separated. Both notions are the source's own: the hypothesis is quasi-separatedness as Stacks 0ARN, part (2) declares it, the relative diagonal quasi-compact in the sense of Stacks 0AJC (HasQuasiCompactDiagonal of this file), and the conclusion is quasi-compactness of a morphism of formal algebraic spaces in that same sense of Stacks 0AJC (IsQuasiCompact of QuasiCompactMorphism.lean). Nothing is carried and nothing is assumed beyond the tag's own hypothesis on Z ⟶ T; in particular this is independent of Stacks 0AN2 and of Stacks 0AIP, which parts (1) and (2) of the tag need. Parts (1) and (2) are registered in SeparatedMorphism.lean

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_mapDesc
declarations.doc:
The comparison `X ×_Z Y ⟶ X ×_T Y` of two fibre products of fppf sheaves on the big fppf
site of `S` is separated in the sense of Stacks 0ARN.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_mapDesc (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : Z ⟶ T) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.mapDesc f g h)
declarations.comment: part (1): separated, separatedness read in the sense of Stacks 0ARN

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.relativelyRepresentable_mapDesc_of_isAffineFormal

declarations.doc:
When `Z` is a formal algebraic space, every represented base change of the comparison
`X ×_Z Y ⟶ X ×_T Y` is a locally of finite type morphism of schemes.
declarations.statement:
theorem relative_locallyOfFiniteType_mapDesc_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
