declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isQuasiSeparatedMorphism_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARR for the quasi-separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN.** A composite of two
morphisms of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` with quasi-compact relative diagonal
again has quasi-compact relative diagonal: the relative diagonal of `f ≫ g` factors as the
relative diagonal of `f`, quasi-compact since `f` is quasi-separated, followed by the
comparison `X ×_Y X ⟶ X ×_Z X`, quasi-compact since `g` is quasi-separated by Stacks 0ARQ,
part (3); and the quasi-compactness condition is stable under composition with no hypothesis
that the objects are algebraic spaces.

Quasi-compactness is read throughout as `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactULift`, the
condition `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsQuasiSeparatedMorphism` is built from. As with the
definition, no hypothesis that the three sheaves are formal algebraic spaces is needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiSeparatedMorphism_comp {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsQuasiSeparatedMorphism B S hS f) (hg : IsQuasiSeparatedMorphism B S hS g) :
    IsQuasiSeparatedMorphism B S hS (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: part (2): quasi-separated, with quasi-compactness of the relative diagonal read as the condition AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsQuasiCompactULift that this library's AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsQuasiSeparatedMorphism is built from; the comparison of the two relative self-products is quasi-compact by Stacks 0ARQ, part (3), and that condition is stable under composition over formal algebraic spaces by AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isQuasiCompactULift_comp_of_presheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARR for the separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN.** A composite of two separated
morphisms of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` is separated: the relative diagonal of
`f ≫ g` factors as the relative diagonal of `f`, a closed immersion since `f` is separated,
followed by the comparison `X ×_Y X ⟶ X ×_Z X`, a closed immersion since `g` is separated by
Stacks 0ARQ, part (2); and closed immersions of formal algebraic spaces compose by
Stacks 0GHW.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_comp {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f) (hg : IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS g) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: part (1): separated, separatedness read in the sense of Stacks 0ARN; the comparison of the two relative self-products is a closed immersion by Stacks 0ARQ, part (2), and closed immersions compose by Stacks 0GHW

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasRelativeDiagonal_quasiCompact_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARR for the quasi-separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN**, with quasi-compactness of
the relative diagonal read as the relative diagonal condition for quasi-compact morphisms of
schemes: if the relative diagonals of `f` and of `g` are quasi-compact in that sense, then so
is the relative diagonal of `f ≫ g`. Quasi-compact morphisms of schemes are stable under
composition, so this is the case `P = AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasRelativeDiagonal_comp`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeDiagonal_quasiCompact_comp {X Y Z : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (hf : HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) f)
    (hg : HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) g) :
    HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) (f ≫ g)
declarations.comment: part (2): quasi-separated, with quasi-compactness of the relative diagonal read as the relative diagonal condition for quasi-compact morphisms of schemes, which is the second of the two cases of Stacks 0ARN in the uniform shape of Stacks 0ARS; stability under composition of quasi-compact morphisms of schemes is taken from Mathlib

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, clauses (1) and (2) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN.** A
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose relative diagonal is
representable by objects of the site is quasi-separated exactly when its base change to every
scheme over the target is quasi-separated.

The hypothesis `hf` is carried: unlike the separatedness axiom, whose spelling in this library
contains representability of the relative diagonal, the quasi-separatedness axiom does not, and
the comparison with the relative diagonal condition of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.HasRelativeDiagonal` needs it. It is discharged for a source
which is a formal algebraic space — the hypothesis of Stacks 0ARS itself — in
`…hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`
below.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_baseChange {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f)) :
    HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
        HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (2) for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces with relatively representable relative diagonal is quasi-separated if and only if its base change to every scheme over the target is quasi-separated; the representability hypothesis is discharged for a source which is a formal algebraic space in `…hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, clauses (1) and (2) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN**, in
the source's own form: a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose
source is a formal algebraic space is quasi-separated exactly when its base change to every
scheme over the target is quasi-separated. The representability hypothesis of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_baseChange` is discharged
here: the relative diagonal of `f` is a base change of the absolute diagonal of `X`, which is
representable by objects of the site by **Stacks 0AIP**.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
        HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (2) for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN, in the source's form with no extra hypothesis: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces is quasi-separated if and only if its base change to every scheme over the target is quasi-separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, clauses (1) and (3) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN.** A
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose relative diagonal is
representable by objects of the site is quasi-separated exactly when its base change to every
*affine* scheme over the target is quasi-separated. Quasi-compactness of morphisms of schemes
is Zariski local on the target, which is what lets the test objects be restricted to the affine
ones.

As in clauses (1) and (2), the hypothesis `hf` is carried, and is discharged for a source which
is a formal algebraic space in
`…hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`
below.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f)) :
    HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
        ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
          HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (3) for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces with relatively representable relative diagonal is quasi-separated if and only if its base change to every affine scheme over the target is quasi-separated; the representability hypothesis is discharged for a source which is a formal algebraic space in `…hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, clauses (1) and (3) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN**, in
the source's own form: a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose
source is a formal algebraic space is quasi-separated exactly when its base change to every
affine scheme over the target is quasi-separated. The representability hypothesis of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange` is
discharged by **Stacks 0AIP** and **Stacks 0AN2** as before.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
        ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
          HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (3) for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN, in the source's form with no extra hypothesis: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces is quasi-separated if and only if its base change to every affine scheme over the target is quasi-separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_isQuasiSeparated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, clauses (3) and (4) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN.** A
morphism `f : X ⟶ Z` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose target is represented by
an affine scheme of the site and whose relative diagonal is representable by objects of the
site is quasi-separated exactly when the source `X` is quasi-separated as a single sheaf, in the
sense of clause (1) of Stacks 0AJ7 — that is, clause (3) of Stacks 0AJ5: the fibre product over
`X` of any two affine scheme-valued points of `X` has quasi-compact underlying scheme.

Both directions are the argument of the source read through the comparison of the two fibre
product descriptions
`U ×_X V = X ×_{Δ, X ×_Z X} (U ×_Z V)`, which is
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.pair_diagonal_square` in one direction and
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.diagonal_test_pair_square` in the other. The scheme-level inputs
are that a quasi-compact morphism into a quasi-compact scheme has quasi-compact source, and
conversely that a morphism from a quasi-compact scheme to an affine one is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_isQuasiSeparated {X : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    {Z : BigFppfOver B S hS} (hZ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z))
    (f : X ⟶ (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z)
    (hf : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f)) :
    HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f ↔ IsQuasiSeparated B S hS X
declarations.comment: clauses (3) and (4) for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces to an affine scheme with relatively representable relative diagonal is quasi-separated if and only if its source is a quasi-separated formal algebraic space; the representability hypothesis is discharged for a source which is a formal algebraic space in `…hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_isQuasiSeparated_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_isQuasiSeparated_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, clauses (3) and (4) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN**, in
the source's own form: a morphism from a formal algebraic space to a sheaf represented by an
affine scheme of the site is quasi-separated exactly when its source is a quasi-separated
formal algebraic space, quasi-separatedness of a single sheaf being read as clause (1) of
Stacks 0AJ7. The representability hypothesis of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_isQuasiSeparated` is discharged by
**Stacks 0AIP** and **Stacks 0AN2**.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_iff_isQuasiSeparated_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
    {X : FppfSheaf B S hS} {Z : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    (hZ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z))
    (f : X ⟶ (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z) (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f ↔ IsQuasiSeparated B S hS X
declarations.comment: clauses (3) and (4) for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN, in the source's form with no extra hypothesis: a morphism from a formal algebraic space to an affine scheme is quasi-separated if and only if its source is a quasi-separated formal algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_locallySurjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, the descent step of clause (5) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of
Stacks 0ARN.** Quasi-separatedness of a morphism of fppf sheaves whose relative diagonal is
relatively representable descends along a locally surjective morphism onto the relative
self-product. Quasi-compactness of morphisms of schemes is fppf local on the target by
**Stacks 02WH**, which is what the descent step consumes.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_locallySurjective {X Y W : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : W ⟶ pullback f f) (hb : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective b)
    (hrep : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f))
    (hbase : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage (@AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).relative (fppfYoneda B S hS)
      (pullback.snd (pullback.diagonal f) b)) :
    HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f
declarations.comment: the descent step of clause (5) for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN: quasi-separatedness descends along a single locally surjective morphism onto the relative self-product, which is the atlas clause with the covering of Definition 0AIM replaced by one locally surjective morphism, and is not the atlas form itself

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.exists_atlas_hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, clause (1) implies clause (5) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of
Stacks 0ARN, in the covering form.** If `Y` is a formal algebraic space and `f : X ⟶ Y` is
quasi-separated then there is a covering `{Y_j ⟶ Y}` as in Definition 0AIM along which every
base change of `f` is quasi-separated. The covering is the atlas of `Y` furnished by
Definition 0AIM; the base changes inherit the condition by **Stacks 0ARP**.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atlas_hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_pullback_snd {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hf : HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f) :
    letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) := Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y),
      (∀ j, IsAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS (Yj j)) ∧
      (∀ j, ∃ hgj : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS (g j).hom,
        Space.HasPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS
          (fun _ _ k ↦ Space.IsEtaleULift.{u + 1} B S hS k.hom) (g j).hom hgj) ∧
      Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g) ∧
      ∀ j, HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f (g j))
declarations.comment: clause (5) in the covering form of Definition 0AIM, necessity for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN: a quasi-separated morphism of formal algebraic spaces has quasi-separated base change to every member of some covering of the target as in Definition 0AIM

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_atlas
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, clause (5) implies clause (1) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of
Stacks 0ARN, in the covering form of Definition 0AIM.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of fppf
sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose relative diagonal is representable by objects of the
site. If there is a family `{Y_j ⟶ Y}` whose induced morphism from the coproduct is a surjection
of sheaves — the covering condition of Definition 0AIM — such that every base change
`Y_j ×_Y X ⟶ Y_j` of `f` is quasi-separated, then `f` is quasi-separated.

The hypothesis `hrep` is carried, and is discharged for a source which is a formal algebraic
space in
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_atlas_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`
below.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_atlas {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y)
    (hsurj : letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) :=
        Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
      Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g))
    (hrep : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f))
    (hqs : ∀ j, HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f (g j))) :
    HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f
declarations.comment: clause (5) in the covering form of Definition 0AIM, sufficiency for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces with relatively representable relative diagonal is quasi-separated as soon as its base change to every member of a covering of the target as in Definition 0AIM is quasi-separated; the representability hypothesis is discharged for a source which is a formal algebraic space in `…hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_atlas_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_atlas_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS, clause (5) implies clause (1) for the quasi-separatedness axiom of
Stacks 0ARN**, in the covering form of Definition 0AIM and in the source's own form: a morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose source is a formal algebraic space
is quasi-separated as soon as its base change to every member of some covering of the target as
in Definition 0AIM is. The representability hypothesis of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_atlas` is discharged by
**Stacks 0AIP** and **Stacks 0AN2**.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_atlas_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y)
    (hsurj : letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) :=
        Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
      Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g))
    (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hqs : ∀ j, HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f (g j))) :
    HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f
declarations.comment: clause (5) in the covering form of Definition 0AIM, sufficiency for the quasi-separated axiom of Stacks 0ARN, in the source's form with no extra hypothesis: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces is quasi-separated as soon as its base change to every member of a covering of the target as in Definition 0AIM is quasi-separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.separationAxiom_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARS.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S`. For
each of the two separation axioms `P` of Stacks 0ARN — quasi-separated (the relative diagonal
quasi-compact) and separated (the relative diagonal a closed immersion) — the following are
equivalent: (1) `f` is `P`; (2) every base change `Z ×_Y X ⟶ Z` along a scheme `Z ⟶ Y` is `P`;
(3) every such base change with `Z` affine is `P`; (4) for every affine scheme `Z ⟶ Y` the
formal algebraic space `Z ×_Y X` is `P` in the sense of Stacks 0AJ7; (5) there is a covering
`{Y_j ⟶ Y}` as in Definition 0AIM with every base change `Y_j ×_Y X ⟶ Y_j` being `P`.

The first conjunct is `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_tfae`, the second
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_tfae`.
declarations.statement:
theorem separationAxiom_tfae {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) :
    letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) := Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
    List.TFAE
      [HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS f,
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z ⟶ Y),
          HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f g),
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
          ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z ⟶ Y),
            HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f g),
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
          ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z ⟶ Y), IsQuasiSeparated B S hS (pullback f g),
        ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y),
          (∀ j, IsAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS (Yj j)) ∧
          (∀ j, ∃ hgj : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS (g j).hom,
            Space.HasPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS
              (fun _ _ k ↦ Space.IsEtaleULift.{u + 1} B S hS k.hom) (g j).hom hgj) ∧
          Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g) ∧
          ∀ j, HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS (pullback.snd f (g j))] ∧
    List.TFAE
      [IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f,
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z ⟶ Y),
          IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.snd f g),
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
          ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z ⟶ Y),
            IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.snd f g),
        ∀ (Z : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z) →
          ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z ⟶ Y), IsSeparated B S hS (pullback f g),
        ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y),
          (∀ j, IsAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS (Yj j)) ∧
          (∀ j, ∃ hgj : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS (g j).hom,
            Space.HasPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS
              (fun _ _ k ↦ Space.IsEtaleULift.{u + 1} B S hS k.hom) (g j).hom hgj) ∧
          Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g) ∧
          ∀ j, IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.snd f (g j))]
declarations.comment: in full: the five conditions are equivalent for each of the two separation axioms of Definition 0ARN, quasi-separated and separated, for any morphism of formal algebraic spaces

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasRelativeDiagonal_iff_forall_baseChange
declarations.doc:
A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` has relative diagonal `P`
exactly when, for every object `Z` of the site and every morphism from the sheaf it represents to
`Y`, the base change `Z ×_Y X ⟶ Z` of `f` has relative diagonal `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeDiagonal_iff_forall_baseChange (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.RespectsIso] {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P f ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
        HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (2): a relative diagonal condition holds for a morphism of formal algebraic spaces if and only if it holds for its base change to every scheme over the target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_iff_forall_baseChange
declarations.doc:
A morphism of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` is separated exactly when its base
change to every scheme over the target is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_iff_forall_baseChange {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS) (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
        IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (2) for separatedness: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces is separated if and only if its base change to every scheme over the target is separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasRelativeDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange
declarations.doc:
A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` has relative diagonal `P`,
for `P` a Zariski-local property of morphisms of schemes, exactly when its relative diagonal is
relatively representable and, for every *affine* object `Z` of the site and every morphism from
the sheaf it represents to `Y`, the base change `Z ×_Y X ⟶ Z` of `f` has relative diagonal
`P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [IsZariskiLocalAtTarget P] {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P f ↔
      (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f) ∧
        ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
          ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
            HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (3): a Zariski-local relative diagonal condition holds for a morphism of formal algebraic spaces if and only if its relative diagonal is relatively representable and the condition holds for the base change to every affine scheme over the target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_iff_forall_affine_baseChange
declarations.doc:
A morphism of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` is separated exactly when its relative
diagonal is relatively representable and its base change to every affine scheme over the target
is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_iff_forall_affine_baseChange {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f ↔
      (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f) ∧
        ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
          ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
            IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (3) for separatedness: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces is separated if and only if its relative diagonal is relatively representable and its base change to every affine scheme over the target is separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_iff_isSeparated
declarations.doc:
A morphism `f : X ⟶ Z` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose target is represented
by an affine scheme of the site is separated exactly when its relative diagonal is relatively
representable and the source `X` is separated as a single sheaf, in the sense of clause (2) of
Stacks 0AJ6: the fibre product over `X` of any two affine scheme-valued points of `X` is affine
with surjective comparison from the tensor product of their coordinate rings.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_iff_isSeparated {X : FppfSheaf B S hS} {Z : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    (hZ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z)) (f : X ⟶ (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f ↔
      (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f) ∧
        IsSeparated B S hS X
declarations.comment: clauses (3) and (4) for separatedness: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces to an affine scheme is separated if and only if its relative diagonal is relatively representable and its source is a separated formal algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_relativelyRepresentable_diag
declarations.doc:
A morphism of fppf sheaves whose source has relatively representable absolute diagonal is
separated exactly when its base change to every affine scheme over the target is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_relativelyRepresentable_diag
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (diag X)) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
        ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
          IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (3) for separatedness with no extra conjunct, generalized past the source: the binder `hX` asks only that the absolute diagonal of the source be relatively representable, which every formal algebraic space satisfies by Stacks 0AIP, so the source's own case needs no such binder and is proved outright in `…isSeparatedMorphism_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_iff_isSeparated_of_relativelyRepresentable_diag
declarations.doc:
A morphism to an affine scheme out of a sheaf with relatively representable absolute
diagonal is separated exactly when that sheaf is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_iff_isSeparated_of_relativelyRepresentable_diag
    {X : FppfSheaf B S hS} {Z : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    (hZ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z)) (f : X ⟶ (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z)
    (hX : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (diag X)) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f ↔ IsSeparated B S hS X
declarations.comment: clauses (3) and (4) for separatedness with no extra conjunct, generalized past the source: the binder `hX` asks only that the absolute diagonal of the source be relatively representable, which every formal algebraic space satisfies by Stacks 0AIP, so the source's own case needs no such binder and is proved outright in `…isSeparatedMorphism_iff_isSeparated_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose source is a formal
algebraic space is separated exactly when its base change to every affine scheme over the target is
separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
        ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
          IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (3) for separatedness, in the source's form with no extra conjunct: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces is separated if and only if its base change to every affine scheme over the target is separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_iff_isSeparated_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
A morphism from a formal algebraic space to a sheaf represented by an affine scheme of the
site is separated exactly when its source is a separated formal algebraic space, separatedness of
a single sheaf being read as clause (2) of Stacks 0AJ6.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_iff_isSeparated_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
    {X : FppfSheaf B S hS} {Z : BigFppfOver B S hS}
    (hZ : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Z)) (f : X ⟶ (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj Z)
    (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f ↔ IsSeparated B S hS X
declarations.comment: clauses (3) and (4) for separatedness, in the source's form with no extra conjunct: a morphism from a formal algebraic space to an affine scheme is separated if and only if its source is a separated formal algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasRelativeDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose source is a formal
algebraic space has relative diagonal `P`, for `P` a Zariski-local property of morphisms of
schemes, exactly when its base change to every affine scheme over the target has relative diagonal
`P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeDiagonal_iff_forall_affine_baseChange_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
    (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}) [IsZariskiLocalAtTarget P] {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X) :
    HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P f ↔
      ∀ (U : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U) →
        ∀ (g : (fppfYoneda B S hS).obj U ⟶ Y),
          HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P (pullback.snd f g)
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (3) for a relative diagonal condition, in the source's form with no extra conjunct: the condition holds for a morphism of formal algebraic spaces if and only if it holds for the base change to every affine scheme over the target

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasRelativeDiagonal_of_locallySurjective
declarations.doc:
A relative diagonal condition for an fppf-local property `P` of morphisms of schemes
descends along a locally surjective morphism `b` onto the relative self-product `X ×_Y X`: if the
base change of the relative diagonal of `f` along `b` has `P` relative to the site, and the
relative diagonal is relatively representable, then `f` has relative diagonal `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeDiagonal_of_locallySurjective (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.fppfPrecoverage]
    {X Y W : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (b : W ⟶ pullback f f)
    (hb : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective b)
    (hrep : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f))
    (hbase : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage P (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).relative
      (fppfYoneda B S hS) (pullback.snd (pullback.diagonal f) b)) :
    HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P f
declarations.comment: the descent step of clause (5): a relative diagonal condition descends along a single locally surjective morphism onto the relative self-product, which is the atlas clause with the covering of Definition 0AIM replaced by one locally surjective morphism, and is not the atlas form itself

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_of_locallySurjective
declarations.doc:
Separatedness of a morphism of fppf sheaves whose relative diagonal is relatively representable
descends along a locally surjective morphism onto the relative self-product.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_of_locallySurjective {X Y W : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (b : W ⟶ pullback f f) (hb : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective b)
    (hrep : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f))
    (hbase : (MorphismProperty.inverseImage
      (@AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).relative (fppfYoneda B S hS)
      (pullback.snd (pullback.diagonal f) b)) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f
declarations.comment: the descent step of clause (5) for separatedness: separatedness descends along a single locally surjective morphism onto the relative self-product, which is the atlas clause with the covering of Definition 0AIM replaced by one locally surjective morphism, and is not the atlas form itself

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasRelativeDiagonal_of_locallySurjectiveFamily
declarations.doc:
A relative diagonal condition for an fppf-local property `P` of morphisms of schemes
descends along a *family* `(b i : W i ⟶ X ×_Y X)` of morphisms onto the relative self-product
whose induced morphism out of the coproduct is a surjection of sheaves: if the base change of the
relative diagonal of `f` along each `b i` has `P` relative to the site, and the relative diagonal
is relatively representable, then `f` has relative diagonal `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeDiagonal_of_locallySurjectiveFamily (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.fppfPrecoverage]
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : Type (u + 1)) (W : I → FppfSheaf B S hS)
    (b : ∀ i, W i ⟶ pullback f f)
    (hb : letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) :=
        Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
      Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc b))
    (hrep : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f))
    (hbase : ∀ i, (MorphismProperty.inverseImage P (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS)).relative
      (fppfYoneda B S hS) (pullback.snd (pullback.diagonal f) (b i))) :
    HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P f
declarations.comment: the descent step of clause (5) for a covering family: a relative diagonal condition descends along a family of morphisms onto the relative self-product whose induced morphism out of the coproduct is a surjection of sheaves

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.exists_atlas_hasRelativeDiagonal_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
If `Y` is a formal algebraic space and the morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf
site of `S` has relative diagonal `P`, then there is a covering `{Y_j ⟶ Y}` as in Definition 0AIM
such that the base change `Y_j ×_Y X ⟶ Y_j` of `f` has relative diagonal `P` for every `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atlas_hasRelativeDiagonal_pullback_snd (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.RespectsIso] {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hf : HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P f) :
    letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) := Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y),
      (∀ j, IsAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS (Yj j)) ∧
      (∀ j, ∃ hgj : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS (g j).hom,
        Space.HasPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS
          (fun _ _ k ↦ Space.IsEtaleULift.{u + 1} B S hS k.hom) (g j).hom hgj) ∧
      Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g) ∧
      ∀ j, HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P (pullback.snd f (g j))
declarations.comment: clause (5) in the covering form of Definition 0AIM, necessity: a relative diagonal condition for a morphism of formal algebraic spaces holds for the base change to every member of some covering of the target as in Definition 0AIM

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.exists_atlas_isSeparatedMorphism_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
If `Y` is a formal algebraic space and `f : X ⟶ Y` is separated then there is a covering
`{Y_j ⟶ Y}` as in Definition 0AIM along which every base change of `f` is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_atlas_isSeparatedMorphism_pullback_snd {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (hf : IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f) :
    letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) := Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y),
      (∀ j, IsAffineFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS (Yj j)) ∧
      (∀ j, ∃ hgj : Space.IsRepresentableByAlgebraicSpacesULift.{u + 1} B S hS (g j).hom,
        Space.HasPropertyULift.{u + 1} B S hS
          (fun _ _ k ↦ Space.IsEtaleULift.{u + 1} B S hS k.hom) (g j).hom hgj) ∧
      Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g) ∧
      ∀ j, IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.snd f (g j))
declarations.comment: clause (5) in the covering form of Definition 0AIM, necessity for separatedness: a separated morphism of formal algebraic spaces has separated base change to every member of some covering of the target as in Definition 0AIM

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasRelativeDiagonal_of_atlas
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` and let `P` be a
property of morphisms of schemes which is stable under base change and local on the target for
the fppf topology. If there is a family `{Y_j ⟶ Y}` whose induced morphism from the coproduct is
a surjection of sheaves — the covering condition of Definition 0AIM — such that every base change
`Y_j ×_Y X ⟶ Y_j` of `f` has relative diagonal `P`, and the relative diagonal of `f` is
relatively representable, then `f` has relative diagonal `P`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeDiagonal_of_atlas (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.fppfPrecoverage]
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y)
    (hsurj : letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) :=
        Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
      Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g))
    (hrep : (fppfYoneda B S hS).relativelyRepresentable (pullback.diagonal f))
    (hP : ∀ j, HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P (pullback.snd f (g j))) :
    HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P f
declarations.comment: clause (5) in the covering form of Definition 0AIM, sufficiency for a relative diagonal condition: the condition holds for a morphism of formal algebraic spaces with relatively representable relative diagonal as soon as it holds for the base change to every member of a covering of the target as in Definition 0AIM

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.hasRelativeDiagonal_of_atlas_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
A morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S` whose source is a formal
algebraic space has relative diagonal `P` as soon as its base change to every member of some
covering of the target as in Definition 0AIM does.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasRelativeDiagonal_of_atlas_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace (P : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
    [P.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [P.IsLocalAtTarget Scheme.fppfPrecoverage]
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y)
    (hsurj : letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) :=
        Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
      Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g))
    (hX : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hP : ∀ j, HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P (pullback.snd f (g j))) :
    HasRelativeDiagonal B S hS P f
declarations.comment: clause (5) in the covering form of Definition 0AIM, sufficiency for a relative diagonal condition, in the source's form with no extra conjunct: the condition holds for a morphism of formal algebraic spaces as soon as it holds for the base change to every member of a covering of the target as in Definition 0AIM

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparatedMorphism_of_atlas
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S`. If there is a family
`{Y_j ⟶ Y}` whose induced morphism from the coproduct is a surjection of sheaves — which is the
covering condition of Definition 0AIM — such that every base change `Y_j ×_Y X ⟶ Y_j` of `f` is
separated, then `f` is separated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparatedMorphism_of_atlas {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (I : Type (u + 1)) (Yj : I → FppfSheaf B S hS) (g : ∀ j, Yj j ⟶ Y)
    (hsurj : letI : HasColimitsOfSize.{u + 1, u + 1} (FppfSheaf B S hS) :=
        Sheaf.instHasColimitsOfSize
      Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Sigma.desc g))
    (hsep : ∀ j, IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS (pullback.snd f (g j))) :
    IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS f
declarations.comment: clause (5) in the covering form of Definition 0AIM, sufficiency for separatedness: a morphism of formal algebraic spaces is separated as soon as its base change to every member of a covering of the target as in Definition 0AIM is separated

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsProper.isProperOnSchemeBaseChanges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (1) implies (2).** A base change of a proper morphism of formal algebraic
spaces over `S` along a scheme over `S` in the site is proper. This is the base change
stability of properness, which needs no hypothesis on the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsProper.isProperOnSchemeBaseChanges {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (hf : IsProper B S hS f) : IsProperOnSchemeBaseChanges B S hS f
declarations.comment: (1) implies (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProper_of_isProperOnSchemeBaseChanges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (2) implies (1).** A morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` all of
whose base changes along schemes over `S` in the site are proper is proper: the base change
along a scheme-valued point of the target, read at the identity point of its own target, is
that base change itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_of_isProperOnSchemeBaseChanges {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : IsProperOnSchemeBaseChanges B S hS f) : IsProper B S hS f
declarations.comment: (2) implies (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProper_iff_isProperOnSchemeBaseChanges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (1) is equivalent to (2).** A morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S`
is proper exactly when each of its base changes along a scheme over `S` in the site is
proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_iff_isProperOnSchemeBaseChanges {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsProper B S hS f ↔ IsProperOnSchemeBaseChanges B S hS f
declarations.comment: (1) is equivalent to (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsProperOnSchemeBaseChanges.isProperOnAffineBaseChanges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (2) implies (3).** The base change condition over all schemes over `S` in
the site restricts to the affine ones.
declarations.comment: (2) implies (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsProperOnAffineBaseChanges.isAlgebraicAndProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (3) implies (4).** If every base change of a morphism of formal algebraic
spaces over `S` along an affine scheme `Z` over `S` in the site is proper, then every such
base change is an algebraic space over `S` and its projection to `Z` is proper as a morphism of
algebraic spaces: both are the content of properness of that base change read at the identity
point of `Z`.
declarations.comment: (3) implies (4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsProper.hasProperFormalAtlas
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (1) implies (5).** A proper morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S`
has a covering of its target as in Definition 0AIM all of whose base changes of the morphism
are proper: any atlas of the target witnessing that it is a formal algebraic space will do,
properness being stable under base change.
declarations.comment: (1) implies (5)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsAlgebraicAndProperOnAffineBaseChanges.isProperOnAffineBaseChanges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (4) implies (3).** If every base change of a morphism of formal algebraic
spaces over `S` along an affine scheme `Z` over `S` in the site is an algebraic space over `S`
whose projection to `Z` is proper as a morphism of algebraic spaces, then every such base
change is proper as a morphism of formal algebraic spaces: over a scheme of the site the two
conditions agree, properness of morphisms of algebraic spaces being stable under base change
along a scheme-valued point.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsAlgebraicAndProperOnAffineBaseChanges.isProperOnAffineBaseChanges
    {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : IsAlgebraicAndProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f) :
    IsProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f
declarations.comment: (4) implies (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProperOnAffineBaseChanges_iff_isAlgebraicAndProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (3) is equivalent to (4).** Over an affine scheme of the site, properness
of the base change as a morphism of formal algebraic spaces and the conjunction of being an
algebraic space with properness of the projection as a morphism of algebraic spaces are the
same condition.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProperOnAffineBaseChanges_iff_isAlgebraicAndProper {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f ↔
      IsAlgebraicAndProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f
declarations.comment: (3) is equivalent to (4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsProperOnAffineBaseChanges.isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (3) implies (1).** A morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` all of
whose base changes along affine schemes over `S` in the site are proper is proper.

Condition (3) gives, at an affine point `Z ⟶ Y`, properness of the chosen base change as a
morphism of formal algebraic spaces; read at the identity point of `Z`
(**Stacks 0ART, (3) implies (4)**) that is exactly the hypothesis of
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProper_of_affine_base_changes`, namely that the base change is
an algebraic space over `S` proper over `Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsProperOnAffineBaseChanges.isProper {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : IsProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f) : IsProper B S hS f
declarations.comment: (3) implies (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProper_iff_isProperOnAffineBaseChanges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (1) is equivalent to (3).** A morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S`
is proper exactly when each of its base changes along an affine scheme over `S` in the site is
proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_iff_isProperOnAffineBaseChanges {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    IsProper B S hS f ↔ IsProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f
declarations.comment: (1) is equivalent to (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.HasProperFormalAtlas.isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, (5) implies (1).** A morphism of formal algebraic spaces over `S` admitting
*one* covering of its target as in Definition 0AIM all of whose base changes of the morphism are
proper is itself proper.

Properness is local on the target for a surjective étale covering by one object of the site, and
such a covering of each scheme-valued point of `Y` is assembled from the given covering: its
joint surjectivity puts every point of the scheme-valued point inside an affine étale
neighbourhood over which the point factors through one member of the covering, and the
coproduct of a `u`-small refinement of those neighbourhoods is the covering object.
declarations.statement:
theorem HasProperFormalAtlas.isProper {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (h : HasProperFormalAtlas B S hS f) : IsProper B S hS f
declarations.comment: (5) implies (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProper_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART, conditions (1), (2), (3) and (4) are equivalent.** For a morphism of fppf
sheaves on the big fppf site of `S`: being proper, having every base change along a scheme of
the site proper, having every base change along an affine scheme of the site proper, and having
every base change along an affine scheme `Z` of the site be an algebraic space over `S` proper
over `Z`, are the same condition.

The cycle is closed by (3) ⇒ (1). Condition (5) of the source asks nothing of `X` or `Y` in
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.HasProperFormalAtlas.isProper` but needs `Y` to be a formal
algebraic space to follow from the others, so it is added to the list separately in
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProper_tfae_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_tfae {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsProper B S hS f,
        IsProperOnSchemeBaseChanges B S hS f,
        IsProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f,
        IsAlgebraicAndProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f]
declarations.comment: (1), (2), (3) and (4) are equivalent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProper_tfae_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ART.** For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of fppf sheaves on the big fppf site of `S`
whose target is a formal algebraic space over `S`, the five conditions of the source are
equivalent: `f` is proper; every base change of `f` along a scheme of the site is proper; every
base change of `f` along an affine scheme of the site is proper; every base change of `f` along
an affine scheme `Z` of the site is an algebraic space over `S` proper over `Z`; and there is
one covering of `Y` as in Definition 0AIM all of whose base changes of `f` are proper.

The first four are `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProper_tfae`, which needs no hypothesis on
`Y`; the fifth is attached by `AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.IsProper.hasProperFormalAtlas`,
which reads an atlas of `Y` off the hypothesis, and by
`AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.HasProperFormalAtlas.isProper`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_tfae_of_isFormalAlgebraicSpace {X Y : FppfSheaf B S hS}
    (hY : IsFormalAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    List.TFAE
      [IsProper B S hS f,
        IsProperOnSchemeBaseChanges B S hS f,
        IsProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f,
        IsAlgebraicAndProperOnAffineBaseChanges B S hS f,
        HasProperFormalAtlas B S hS f]
declarations.comment: all five conditions are equivalent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isQuasiCompact_iff_isQuasiCompact_of_overIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARU.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S`, let `T ⊆ |X|` be
a closed subset and let `U ⊂ X` be the open subspace with `|U| = |X| ∖ T`. Let `f : X' ⟶ X` be
a morphism of algebraic spaces which is locally of finite type and such that `f⁻¹U ⟶ U` is an
isomorphism, and let `g : W ⟶ X_{/T}` correspond to `f` under the completion functor of
Stacks 0AR5, that is, be isomorphic over `X_{/T}` to `f_{/T} : X'_{/T'} ⟶ X_{/T}`. Then `f` is
quasi-compact if and only if `g` is quasi-compact.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiCompact_iff_isQuasiCompact_of_overIso
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hXN : Space.IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X)
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T)
    (M : Space.FiniteTypeModification B S hS (Space.openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS X Tᶜ))
    {W : FppfSheaf B S hS} (g : W ⟶ Space.completionSheaf B S hS X T)
    (e : Over.mk g ≅ Over.mk (Space.completionSheafMap B S hS M.obj.hom T)) :
    Space.IsQuasiCompact B S hS M.obj.hom ↔ IsQuasiCompact B S hS g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isQuasiSeparated_iff_hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_overIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARV.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S`, let `T ⊆ |X|` be
a closed subset and let `U ⊂ X` be the open subspace with `|U| = |X| ∖ T`. Let `f : X' ⟶ X` be
a morphism of algebraic spaces which is locally of finite type and such that `f⁻¹U ⟶ U` is an
isomorphism, and let `g : W ⟶ X_{/T}` correspond to `f` under the equivalence of Stacks 0ARB
(`isEquivalence_completionModificationFunctor`), that is, be isomorphic over `X_{/T}` to the
completion `f_{/T} : X'_{/T'} ⟶ X_{/T}`, the value at `f` of the functor
`completionModificationFunctor` of Stacks 0AR5. Then `f` is quasi-separated (Stacks 03HL,
part (3)) if and only if `g` is quasi-separated (Stacks 0ARN, part (2)).
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasiSeparated_iff_hasQuasiCompactDiagonal_of_overIso
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hXN : Space.IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X)
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T)
    (M : Space.FiniteTypeModification B S hS (Space.openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS X Tᶜ))
    {W : FppfSheaf B S hS} (g : W ⟶ Space.completionSheaf B S hS X T)
    (e : Over.mk g ≅ Over.mk (Space.completionSheafMap B S hS M.obj.hom T)) :
    Space.IsQuasiSeparated B S hS M.obj.hom ↔ HasQuasiCompactDiagonal B S hS g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isSeparated_iff_isSeparatedMorphism_and_isRigSurjective_diagonal_of_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0ARW.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S`, let `T ⊆ |X|` be
closed with open complement `U`, and let `f : X' ⟶ X` be a finite-type modification of `X`
outside `U` (Stacks 0AS2), corresponding to an object `g : W ⟶ X_{/T}` of the right-hand
category of Stacks 0AR5 — a rig-étale morphism with `W` a locally Noetherian formal algebraic
space — through an isomorphism over `X_{/T}` between `f_{/T}` and `g`. Then `f` is separated if
and only if `g` is separated (Stacks 0ARN) and its relative diagonal
`Δ_g : W ⟶ W ×_{X_{/T}} W` is rig-surjective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparated_iff_isSeparatedMorphism_and_isRigSurjective_diagonal_of_iso
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hXN : Space.IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X)
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T)
    (M : Space.FiniteTypeModification B S hS (Space.openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS X Tᶜ))
    (P : RigEtaleOverCompletion B S hS X T)
    (e : (Space.completionOverFunctor B S hS T).obj M.obj ≅ P.obj) :
    Space.IsSeparated B S hS M.obj.hom ↔
      IsSeparatedMorphism B S hS P.obj.hom ∧
        IsRigSurjective B S hS (pullback.diagonal P.obj.hom)
declarations.comment: the correspondence `f ↔ g` of Theorem 0ARB is rendered as an isomorphism over `X_{/T}` between the image `f_{/T}` of `f` under the completion functor of Stacks 0AR5 and an object `g` of the right-hand category of Stacks 0AR5; the equivalence of Theorem 0ARB itself is not used. Separatedness of `g` is the separatedness axiom of Stacks 0ARN, part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.FormalSpace.isProper_iff_isFormalModification_of_iso
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over `S`, let `T ⊆ |X|` be closed with open
complement `U`, and let `f : X' ⟶ X` be a finite-type modification of `X` outside `U`
(Stacks 0AS2), corresponding to an object `g : W ⟶ X_{/T}` of the right-hand category of
Stacks 0AR5 — a rig-étale morphism with `W` a locally Noetherian formal algebraic space — through
an isomorphism over `X_{/T}` between `f_{/T}` and `g`. Then `f` is proper if and only if `g` is a
formal modification (Definition 0GDK).
declarations.statement:
theorem isProper_iff_isFormalModification_of_iso
    {X : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hXN : Space.IsLocallyNoetherian B S hS X)
    (T : Set (Space.points B S hS X)) (hT : IsClosed T)
    (M : Space.FiniteTypeModification B S hS (Space.openSubspaceOfPoints B S hS X Tᶜ))
    (P : RigEtaleOverCompletion B S hS X T)
    (e : (Space.completionOverFunctor B S hS T).obj M.obj ≅ P.obj) :
    Space.IsProper B S hS M.obj.hom ↔ IsFormalModification B S hS P.obj.hom
declarations.comment: the correspondence `f ↔ g` of Theorem 0ARB is rendered as an isomorphism over `X_{/T}` between the image `f_{/T}` of `f` under the completion functor of Stacks 0AR5 and an object `g` of the right-hand category of Stacks 0AR5; the equivalence of Theorem 0ARB itself is not used

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_id_toSpecΓ_of_isOpenImmersion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ARY.** For an open immersion `U ⟶ V` between
quasi-affine schemes, the canonical morphism from `U` to the spectrum of its
global sections is the base change of the induced morphism on spectra along
the canonical morphism from `V`.
declarations.statement:
lemma isPullback_id_toSpecΓ_of_isOpenImmersion (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V)
    [IsOpenImmersion f]
    [U.IsQuasiAffine] [V.IsQuasiAffine] :
    IsPullback (𝟙 U) U.toSpecΓ (f ≫ V.toSpecΓ) (Spec.map f.appTop)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.completionSubtype_injective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ARZ, part (1).** The map from the completion of a
submodule to the completion of the ambient linearly topologized module is
injective.
declarations.statement:
public lemma completionSubtype_injective (N : Submodule R M) :
    Function.Injective (completionSubtype N)
declarations.comment: part (1), injectivity

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.exact_completionSubtype_completionQuotient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ARZ, part (1).** The image of the completed
submodule is the kernel of the map from the completed module to the completion
of its quotient.
declarations.comment: part (1), exactness

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.range_completionSubtype_eq_closure
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0ARZ, part (2).** In the completion of a linearly
topologized module, the image of the completion of a submodule is precisely the
closure of the image of that submodule.
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.completionQuotient_surjective_of_isCountablyGenerated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AS0, part (1).** For a linearly topologized module
with a countable fundamental system of neighborhoods of zero, the canonical
map from its completion to the completion of a quotient is surjective.
declarations.statement:
public lemma completionQuotient_surjective_of_isCountablyGenerated
    (N : Submodule R M) (hM : (nhds (0 : M)).IsCountablyGenerated) :
    Function.Surjective (TopologicalRing.completionQuotient N)
declarations.comment: part (1), surjectivity

declarations.name: TopologicalRing.completionQuotient_isOpenMap_of_isCountablyGenerated
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0AS0, part (3).** For a linearly topologized module
with a countable fundamental system of neighborhoods of zero, the canonical
map from its completion to the completion of a quotient is open.
declarations.statement:
public lemma completionQuotient_isOpenMap_of_isCountablyGenerated
    (N : Submodule R M) (hM : (nhds (0 : M)).IsCountablyGenerated) :
    IsOpenMap (TopologicalRing.completionQuotient N)
declarations.comment: part (3)
